m100009.――あぁっ！？\nゴブリン博士が飛行機械に乗って逃げていきますっ！: —Ah!? Goblin Doctor is fleeing on a flying machine!
m100009.――あっ、ピッキーさんが戻ってきましたよ！\nおーい！ お父さんはご無事でしたか: —Ah, Picky's back! Hey! Is dad alright!?
m100009.――あっ、ピッキーさんが戻ってきましたよ！\nピッキーさん、街の皆さんは……？:
—Ah, Picky's back!
Picky, how are the townsfolk…?
m100009.――いえ、奥から聞こえてくるこの音……。\nリッカさん、一機どころじゃないです！:
—No, that sound coming from deeper….
Rikka, it's not just one unit!
They're coming in huge numbers from ahead!
m100009.――この先が、生存者の方々が\n監禁されているという開発区ですか……。: ——So this is the Development Zone, where the survivors are being held captive…
m100009.――これで、ようやく鋼の都を\n魔物から奪還できましたね、王子。: —Now we've finally reclaimed the Steel City from the monsters, Prince.
m100009.――っ！？ バシラさんの矢は確かに当たったのに、\n変異したデーモンの傷が一瞬で: —!? Bashira's arrow definitely hit, yet the demon's wounds seal themselves instantly!
m100009.――フフッ、ソレはドウカナ？\n今回の件ハ想定の範囲内デアル！: —Heh, is that so? This whole thing is within my expectations!
m100009.――勝利？ 勝利ダト？\nフフッ、フフフッ、ファーッハッハッハッ！！\nお前タチ: —Victory? Victory, you say? Heh, heh, ha-ha-ha!! One day you'll learn what a true victor is!
m100009.――噂をすれば、というべきでしょうか。\n王子、通路の奥から\n変異種の集団が接: —Speaking of rumors, I should say… Prince, a group of mutants is approaching from deep within the tunnel.
m100009.…………。\n危うく吹き飛ばされるところでしたね……。:
……….
We almost got blown away there…
m100009.……あっ、『変異種』というのは、\n特定の種族のことではありませんよ？: …Ah, “Variants” isn't a specific race, you know?
m100009.……ここまで来たら、\nもう最深部まで進むしかありませんね。\n王子、ピッキーさ:
…We've come this far,
so we have to push to the deepest part.
Prince, let's go save Picky's dad!
m100009.……そう、ですよね。はい！\n皆さん、警備機械は不可視の防壁を展開していて、\n: …Right, that's it. Yes! Everyone, the guard machines are deploying an invisible barrier—any attack that doesn't exceed its strength gets blocked.
m100009.……そうか、街中にあふれていた緑の液体。\nあれはゴブリン博士の研究の跡だったと: …So the green liquid that flooded the town… it was the remnants of Goblin Doctor's research.
m100009.……そうですね、詳しくお話します。\n安全な場所まで案内しますので、\nひとまず: Right… I'll explain in detail. I'll guide you to a safe place, so for now, just follow me.
m100009.……推測の範囲は出ませんが、\nその可能性は高そうですね。: …I can't be sure, but that seems quite likely.
m100009.『開発区』はこの道を進んだ先です。\n足元に気をつけてくださいね。: The Development Zone is just ahead down this road. Watch your step.
m100009.あ、あの、それで、ひとつご相談なんですけど……。\n鋼の都を救っていただいたお礼: Um, I have a little request… As a thank-you for saving the Steel City, it might not be enough, but…
m100009.あたしを、仲間に加えていただけないでしょうかぁ！: Could you… add me to your party?
m100009.あっ、ピッキーさん！\n一人じゃ危ないですよ！ 私も行きますから！:
Ah, Picky!
It's dangerous alone! I'll go too!
m100009.あの、無理なお願いなのは分かっています。\nどうか、さらわれた皆を助けてもらえな: I know it's an unreasonable request, but could you please help rescue those who were taken?
m100009.あれは……サハギンか……？\nいや、それにしては様子がおかしいな。\n連中があん:
That… is a Sahagin? No, something's off about it.
I've never seen them glow that eerily.
m100009.あれは……！\nそんな、制御室まで奪われているなんて。\n間違いなく鋼の都の警備: That's…! They've even taken the control room. That's definitely a guard machine from the Steel City!
m100009.いえ、あれは……！！\nこの都市に配備されていた歩行機械です！\nゴブリン用に改:
No, that's…!!
It's a walking machine deployed in this city!
It's been modified for goblins, though…!!
m100009.いずれも元の魔物が変異したやつらで、\n鋼の都では総称としてそう呼んでいるんです: They're all just monsters that have mutated, and we just call them that in the Steel City.
m100009.うぅ、これはもうダメかも……。\n一人の時に変異種と遭遇するなんて……。: Ugh, this might be hopeless… Running into a mutant when I'm alone…
m100009.うぅん、間違いないです。\nこっちに向かってきています！: No doubt about it. They're heading this way!
m100009.うん……ゴブリン博士の仕業に間違いないよ。\nもしかしたら変異種も、博士の仕業か:
Yeah… it's definitely the work of Dr. Goblin.
Maybe the mutants are his doing too…?
m100009.えぇぇぇっ！？\nあんな砲塔を構えた機械が何機も？\nそれにあのキラキラしたの、:
Wha—!?
So many machines with turrets?
And that sparkling thing—that's the barrier, right!?
m100009.えっ、そ、そんな簡単に？\n本当に良いんですか？ 良いんですかっ！？: Eh, that easy? Is it really okay? Is it okay!?
m100009.えっ？ この地区にはもう、誰もいないはずです。\n警備機械も全部機能停止している: Huh? There shouldn't be anyone left in this area. All the guard machines should be offline…
m100009.お、大型防衛機械まで！\n皆さん、アイツを倒したら\nすぐに避難して下さい！: Whoa, even a large-scale defense machine! Everyone, once we take it down, evacuate immediately!
m100009.おいおい。\nこれは怪しいなんてモンじゃないぜ。\n港にも街にも誰もいないなんて: Hey, hey. This isn't some shady trick. There's nobody in the harbor or the town.
m100009.おっと、今は対処が優先だ。\n驚いてる暇はないぜ。: Whoa, dealing with this comes first. No time to be startled.
m100009.おや……？\n我々をご存知なのですか？: Oh…? Do you know who we are?
m100009.お願いします、王子の旦那っ！\n力を貸してください……！！: Please, Prince's husband! Lend us your strength…!!
m100009.ここから先は何が出てくるか分かりません。\n王子、より一層慎重な采配をお願いしま: We don't know what lies ahead. Prince, please command with even greater caution!
m100009.これから向かう鋼の都へは、\nこうして海路を使わなければ辿り着けませんから。\n:
We can't reach the Steel City without using this sea route.
Just a little more patience, okay?
m100009.これで開発区への道が開きました！\nあ、あたし監禁されていた人達を助けてきます！:
Now the path to the Development Zone is open!
I'll go rescue the people who were locked up!!
m100009.これまでは海路と言っても、\n王国近海や内海ばかりだったからな。\n不安になるの:
Up until now, “sea route” meant only the kingdom's coastal waters or inland seas.
It's understandable to feel uneasy.
m100009.そ、そんな事が可能なんですか！？\n……いや、そうしなくちゃいけないんですよね…: C-can that even be done?! …No, we have to do it, right…!
m100009.その上、最近は魔物が、\n生存者を連れ去って『開発区』に、\n監禁しているみたい: On top of that, the monsters have recently been kidnapping survivors and imprisoning them in the “Development Zone.”
m100009.その後も魔物達は、\n水源をあの緑色の薬品で汚染して、\n鋼の都の状況は悪化の一: Since then the monsters have been contaminating the water source with that green chemical, and the city's condition keeps worsening.
m100009.その鋼の都が、\nそろそろ見えてくるはずなんだけど……って、\n何か海中で明滅し: The Steel City should be coming into view soon… Wait, is something flashing beneath the water…?
m100009.それじゃ、王子の旦那、\n準備が整ったら、さっそく『開発区』へ向かいましょう。\: Then, Prince, once we're ready, let's head straight for the Development Zone. Of course, I'll handle the navigation!
m100009.それでは、\nこの都に何が起きたのか、説明させてくださいね。: Now, let me explain what happened to this city.
m100009.それならば、ここを押し通るしかありませんね。\n王子、戦闘の準備をお願いします！: Then we have no choice but to push through. Prince, prepare for battle!
m100009.それに水路から漏れている、緑色の液体……。\n何らかの魔物の力によるものなのでし: And that green liquid leaking from the canals… it must be some monster's power.
m100009.だが、あんな強力な警備機械がいても、\n魔物の侵攻を防ぎきれなかったとはな……。: But even with such a powerful guard machine, we still couldn't stop the monster invasion…
m100009.だがこれほど肉体に負荷をかけているんだ。\n再生能力も無限ではないんだろう？\n: But it's putting such a strain on the body. Its regeneration isn't infinite, right? It should degrade over time.
m100009.で、でも、さっきのデーモンも倒せたんです。\nこのデーモンだって攻撃し続ければ―: B-but we did defeat that demon earlier. If we keep attacking this one—!!
m100009.でもここまで来たら、後はゴブリン博士を倒して、\nピッキーさんのお父さんを救出す: But now that we're this far, all that's left is to defeat the Goblin Doctor and rescue Picky's father! Let's do it for the Steel City!
m100009.とはいえ、周囲に陸地が全く見えない船旅は、\nわくわくもしますけど、ちょっと怖い: Still, a voyage where you can't see any land at all is… exciting, but also a little scary…
m100009.ど、どうしましょう……！？\nあの機械は砲弾が発射できるタイプですから、\nいっ:
W-what should we do…!?
Those machines fire shells, so if a lot come, the blast will be disastrous!
m100009.どうしたら良いのでしょうか……。\n変異種と化した魔物相手に、\n人の手だけで勝: What are we supposed to do…? We can't possibly beat these mutated monsters with just our own hands…
m100009.どうにか変異したデーモンを倒せましたが、\nこれが失敗作、ですか……。: We managed to take down the mutated demon, but this was a failed experiment…
m100009.な、何がおかしいんですかっ！\nもう包囲されているっていうのに――: Wh-what's so funny! We're already surrounded—
m100009.な、何ですかあれ！？\nゴブリンがくぐつに乗ってますよ！？:
W-what's that!?
A goblin's riding a…?
m100009.なっ……ッ！\nあいつら、受けた傷が勝手に治っていくぞ……！？: Wh—! Those things are healing their wounds on their own…!?
m100009.なんだって？\nそれじゃあどうしたらいいんだ？: What? So what do we do then?
m100009.は、はい。あたし、ピッキーっていいます。\nあ、あの、間違っていたらごめんなさい: Y-yes. I'm Picky. Um, sorry if I'm mistaken… Are you from the kingdom, perhaps?
m100009.はぁ……はぁ……。\nた、助かりましたぁ。\n本当にありがとうございます……。: Huff… huff… I… I'm saved. Thank you so much…
m100009.はい……元々は都市の発展のために、\n色んなものの新開発を担っていた場所です。: Yes… It was originally a place for new developments to support the city's growth.
m100009.はい。鋼の都との連絡が途絶えて、\n既にかなりの時間が過ぎてしまっています。\n:
Yes. Contact with the Steel City has been cut off for quite some time now.
The main goal of this voyage is to check on the situation.
m100009.はいっ！ それはもう！\nさっそく父さんに話してきまーすっ！: Yes! Already! I'll go tell Dad right away!
m100009.はいっ！！ ゴブリン博士の研究に、\n無理やり協力させられていたそうですけど、\: Yes!! I was forced to cooperate with Goblin Doctor's research, but I'm fine now!!
m100009.はい！ 小型機の比じゃない威力ですよ！\n倒したら周囲の皆さんはすぐに避難して下: Exactly! Its firepower is on a whole other level compared to the small ones. When it falls, everyone nearby should get out right away!
m100009.ふぅ、どうにか排除できたわね。: Phew, we managed to clear them out.
m100009.へっ、なら防壁とやらじゃ防げねぇ位、\n重い攻撃をぶち込みまくってやろうぜ王子！: Heh, then let's hammer them with attacks so heavy the so-called barrier can't block them, Prince!
m100009.まだまだ私達の戦いは続きますが、\n一歩一歩、平和な世界を目指して進んでいきまし: Our battle isn't over yet, but step by step, let's move toward a peaceful world!
m100009.まだ国交のあった頃ですね……。\nあれからいったい、この都に何が起きたのですか？: That was back when we still had diplomatic ties… What on earth has happened to this city since then?
m100009.ようやく鋼の都を制圧したというのに……。\nフンッ、ヤハリ我ラの邪魔ヲするノカ！: We finally seized the Steel City… Hmph, you dare stand in the way of Yaharigara!
m100009.ゴブリンに操られ、知能も失うなんて。\n哀れなものですわね……。: To be controlled by a goblin and lose one's intellect… How pitiful.
m100009.ゴブリンクイーン様、生命科学の真髄と、\n機械技術を習得したワタクシが、\n今御: Goblin Queen, having mastered the essence of life science and mechanical tech, I shall now return to your side…!!
m100009.ゴブリン博士、もう退路はありませんよ！\n大人しく投降して、\nピッキーさんのお: Goblin Doctor, you have no escape route! Surrender peacefully and free Picky's father!
m100009.ゴブリン博士、投降してください。\nもはやそちらに勝機は――: Goblin Doctor, surrender now. There's no chance left for you—
m100009.ゴブリン博士が向かったのは\nこの通路の奥でしたね。\n王子、警戒しつつ先を急ぎ: The Goblin Doctor went deeper down this passage. Prince, stay on guard and hurry forward!
m100009.ゴブリン博士もいなくなりましたし、\n父さんも帰ってきましたし、\n全部、全部王: The Goblin Doctor's gone, Dad's back, and it's all thanks to everyone in the kingdom!
m100009.サァ！ ソノ強靭ナル肉体によっテ、\n王子タチを蹂躙するがヨイ！！: Come on! With those sturdy bodies, we'll crush you, Prince, and the rest!!
m100009.フッフッフ……。\n強気でいられるノモ今のうちデアル……。: Hehehe… I can still be bold while I have the chance…
m100009.マズはその失敗作と遊んでイルがイイ！！\nワタクシは多忙ナノデナ！\nお前タチの: It's more fun to play with the failures! I'm busy, so I have no time to deal with you lot!
m100009.レヴィアタンの活動が止まり、\n魔界の影響が弱まったおかげじゃろう。\n魔物の活:
Thanks to the Leviathan's activity stopping,
and the demonic influence weakening, monster activity overall seems to be on the decline.
m100009.人間用の機械をゴブリンが扱えるように改造……。\nこんなことができる魔物なんて…:
Goblins modified a human-type machine so they can use it….
I never imagined a monster capable of something like this…
m100009.今は周辺の警備や食料調達、\n生存者の方の捜索で手一杯、という状況です。: Right now we're swamped with perimeter security, food gathering, and searching for survivors.
m100009.今は我々がついています。\n一刻も早く、囚われている人達を助け出しましょう。: We're here now. Let's free the captives as quickly as possible.
m100009.今は魔物がうじゃうじゃといて、\n皆を助けに行くどころか、\n偵察にも来れなくな: Now monsters swarm it, and we can't even send scouts, let alone go rescue anyone…
m100009.以前に……と言っても、\n魔物が復活するより前の話ですけど、\n港でお見かけした: I saw you before… well, before the monsters revived, I think. I spotted you at the harbor…
m100009.住人に話を聞ければいいんだがな。\nどこかに無事な者がいれば――: I wish we could talk to the residents. If there's anyone still safe somewhere—
m100009.先の個体は失敗作ダト言ったハズ。\nこの個体こそ、生命力の限界を突き詰めた\n我: I thought the previous specimen was a failure, right? This one, however, pushes the limits of vitality—my ultimate masterpiece, the Super-Mutated Demon Swordsman!!
m100009.先程は助けていただいて、\nほんっとーに、ありがとうございました！: Thank you so much for rescuing us earlier—really, thank you!
m100009.割れた培養槽の中から何かが――\n――あ、あれはっ、さっきのデーモン！？:
Something's coming out of the cracked culture tank—
—Ah, that's the demon from earlier!?
m100009.包囲？ 否！\n誘い込まれたノハ、お前タチのほうダ！！: Surrounded? No! It's you who were lured in!!
m100009.可能性は捨てきれませんね……。\n王子、上陸後も気を抜かずに進みましょう。: We can't rule out that possibility… Prince, let's stay on guard even after we land.
m100009.変異種、警備機械、ともに沈黙しました。\n王子、私達の勝利です！: Both the mutants and the guard machines have fallen silent. Prince, it's our victory!
m100009.大型の防衛機械ですか……！\n大型と言う事は、当然その自爆も……！: A huge defense machine…! That means its self-destruct will be massive too…!
m100009.大変です、あっちで女の子が襲われてます！\nそれにこの足音の数、\n多数の敵に追: This is bad—there's a girl being attacked over there! And look at all those footsteps—looks like they're being chased by a horde of enemies!
m100009.始まりは、魔物が復活したあの日のことなんです。\nこの都は大規模な魔物の襲撃を受: It all began on the day the monsters revived. This city was hit by a massive monster assault…
m100009.我が物顔で海を回遊していた、\n大型の魔物も姿を見なくなったしね。\n今までより:
Even the huge sea monsters that used to roam the ocean like they owned it have vanished.
We can sail much more safely than before ♪
m100009.手早く削りきらねば自己再生してしまう、か。\n高い火力か、あるいは一撃で、\n致:
If we don't chip them away fast, they'll regenerate.
High firepower or a single, fatal blow might be the way to go.
m100009.技術研究者だった父も、\n最初の襲撃の時に捕まってしまったみたいで……。: My father, who was a technology researcher, seems to have been captured during the initial raid…
m100009.普通のサハギンとは明らかに別物だったな。\nあんな不気味なヤツ、今まで見たことな:
That wasn't a normal Sahagin at all.
Never seen anything that creepy before.
m100009.本当に、もう誰も住んでいないんですね。\n街も静まり返って――って、\nあれ、機: Really, nobody lives here anymore. The town's completely silent—wait, do I hear the sound of machinery moving…?
m100009.次から次に変異種が出てきますね……。: Mutants keep appearing one after another…
m100009.汚染が進むに連れて、魔物が変異した存在、\n『変異種』の数も爆発的に増えていった: As the contamination spreads, the number of mutated monsters—“Variants”—has exploded.
m100009.泣いてる場合じゃないですよね。\nさらわれた皆を助けるために、\n態勢を整えて『: We don't have time to cry. Let's get ready and head for the Development Zone to rescue everyone who was taken…!
m100009.浮かない顔だな。\n……防壁が解除されるまで待ってたら、\nコチラがやられちまう: You look downcast. …If we just wait for the barrier to drop, we'll get taken out.
m100009.海路だけでなく、封鎖されていた陸路も\n使えるようになって大助かりです。\nこれ:
Not only the sea route, but the land route that was sealed off is now usable, which is a huge help.
Looks like we can expand our trade routes even further.
m100009.無事で良かったよ。\n君はこの都の住人なのかい？: Glad you're okay. Are you a resident of this city?
m100009.王国を襲撃した魔物の規模に匹敵する、\n大軍勢が鋼の都を襲ったのですね……。: The monster force that assaulted the kingdom was on a scale that matched a massive army, and it laid siege to the Steel City…
m100009.王子、こ、こいつを倒せば、\n鋼の都は取り戻せるんですよね……？: Prince, if we take this thing down, we can reclaim the Steel City, right…?
m100009.王子、そろそろ陸地が見えてくるそうですよ。\n魔物の襲撃もない、穏やかな船旅でし:
Prince, they say land is about to appear soon.
It's been a calm voyage with no monster attacks.
m100009.王子、十分に警戒しつつ迎撃しましょう。\n魔物を引き連れて入港するわけにはいきま:
Prince, stay on guard and intercept them.
We can't let those monsters drag us into the harbor!
m100009.王子、変異したデーモンを打ち破り、\nゴブリン博士を追いますわよ！: Prince, defeat those mutated demons and we'll chase after the Goblin Doctor!
m100009.王子、急いであの子を助けましょう！: Prince, let's hurry and rescue her!
m100009.皆さん、警備機械は、\n破壊された時に自爆するように設定されてます。\n撃破時の: Everyone, the guard machines are set to self-destruct when destroyed. Watch out for their explosions!
m100009.皆の閉じ込められていた牢は解放してきました！\n……でも、父さんが……うぅぅ。\:
I freed everyone from the cells!
…But my dad… *sniff*
He was taken to the deep lab…
m100009.知ったコトカ！\n再生能力が失われる前に全滅させれば良いノダ！: Exactly! Just wipe them out before that regeneration fades!
m100009.研究所に繋がる通路はここだけです。\n避けては通れそうにないですね……。: This is the only passage leading to the lab. There's no way to avoid it…
m100009.研究所の入り口が近いということでしょう。\nそろそろゴブリン博士に気付かれても\:
Since the lab entrance is close, we might soon be spotted by Dr. Goblin.
We should proceed carefully.
m100009.肉体強化ヲ行う緑ノ薬液は完成シ、\nソノ成果として我ラは強力な変異種ヲ手に入れた: The green serum that enhances the body is complete, and thanks to it we've obtained powerful mutants!
m100009.艦に取り付かれる前に、\n早く迎撃してしまいましょう！ えぇいっ！！: Before they latch onto our ship, let's take them down quickly! Come on!!
m100009.落ち着けピッキー、リッカ。\n要は爆風の影響を最小限に抑える陣形を組んで、\n防:
Calm down, Picky, Rikka.
We need to form a formation that minimizes blast impact and strike harder than the barrier. Right, Prince?
m100009.落ち込むには早いぜ。\n警備機械はいなくても、代わりに俺達がいるさ。\n――な、: It's too early to get downcast. Even without the guard machines, we've got each other. —Right, Prince?
m100009.見ヨ！ この驚異的な回復能力！\nコレこそが、実験に実験ヲ重ねて生み出シタ、\n: Look! This astonishing regenerative ability! This is the effect of the green body-enhancing serum we created by layer upon layer of experiments…!!
m100009.警備機械も数で勝る魔物には敵わなくて、\nあたしや他の皆は、下水道や地下に、\n: Our security machines couldn't stand up to the sheer numbers, so I and the others barely managed to escape into the sewers and underground…
m100009.身体強化の薬液に、機械の改造技術……。\nゴブリン博士は\nまだゴブリンクイーン: The enhancement serum, the mechanical upgrades… Is Goblin Doctor still planning to strengthen the Goblin Queen…?
m100009.鋼の都……。確か、工業が発展した先進国だと\n聞いた事があります。魔物の復活以前:
The Steel City… I've heard it's a technologically advanced nation.
Before the monsters returned, it was a city-state that had close ties with the kingdom.
m100009.鋼の都の兵器をゴブリンが改造するなんて……。\nで、でも一機だけなら――:
Goblins modifying the steel city's weapons….
But if it's just one unit—
m100009.鋼の都の戦力は、警備機械が頼りでしたから、\nあたしみたいに戦える人間も、\nほ: The Steel City's forces relied on security machines, so only a handful of people like me can actually fight, and rescues haven't been going well.
m100009.鋼の都の技術を手当り次第に奪ったみたいですね。\nもう少しここへ来るのが遅かった: It looks like they stole whatever technology they could from the Steel City. If they'd arrived a bit later, who knows how far they'd have advanced…
m100009.鋼の都を奪還できるとすれば、\nあたしたちの守りの要だった、\n警備機械達だけだ: If we could retake the Steel City, it would have been just the guard machines that formed our line of defense…
m100009.防壁自体は延々と展開し続けることは出来ないんです。\n時間が経てば、いずれ解除さ: The barrier can't stay up forever. It'll eventually deactivate after some time, I think…
m100009.陸地も近いというのに、\nこんな魔物が出現するなんて……。\nもしや鋼の都に何か:
Land's so close, yet monsters like this show up…
Could something be wrong with the Steel City?
m100009.魔物との戦いはまだ終わらない以上、\n協力していただける方はいつでも歓迎ですから: Since the fight with the monsters isn't over yet, we always welcome anyone willing to help. But make sure you get your father's permission first, okay?
m100009.黒幕の予想がついたとは言っても、\nこちらが後手に回っている状況は覆しようがない:
Even though we can guess the mastermind, we're still on the back foot.
We have no choice but to advance cautiously.

m300348.――さて、プルラルクルスは、\nエネルギーを一定量貯蔵したことで\n現在、復活直: Now then, Pluralculus has stored a certain amount of energy, so it's currently in a dormant state right before revival.
m300348.――それで、一応事件は解決したってことでいいの？\nこっちの世界に現れた、\nえ: ――So… can we say the incident's resolved? The being that appeared in our world, Eirian, was said to be affected by a dimensional lifeform…
m300348.――ですから、まずはそれらの問題を解決しましょう。\n然る後に、全戦力をもって、: —So first, let's resolve those issues. Then, with all forces united, we'll strike down the dimensional lifeform Pluralculus.
m300348.――では、配置につきましょうか。\nみっつの世界を守るために、\nここでプルラル: —Well then, let's take our positions. To protect the three worlds, we'll defeat Pluralculus right here!
m300348.――ふっふっふ、\n偶然異世界に放り込まれた前回とは一味ちがうでぇ。:
Heh heh heh—
This time's different from the last time we were tossed into another world by chance.
m300348.――ん、そこの女神さまは\n後方腕組み彼女面せんでええんか？: —Hmm, can that goddess over there keep her arms crossed like that?
m300348.――記憶操作って、忘れさせられていることまで\n認識できなくなるんですか……。\: ――So memory manipulation can make you unable to even recognize things that have been erased from your mind…? The ancient civilization really had amazing technology.
m300348.……ですが、もしかしたら、なのですが、\n今回は完全な討伐も可能かもしれません。: …But perhaps, just perhaps, a complete extermination might be possible this time.
m300348.……可能なのでしょうか。\nかつて、英雄王とその軍をもってしても、\n封印するの: …Is that even possible? Even the Hero King and his army could only manage to seal it, nothing more.
m300348.……皆の力を束ねて、すごい砲弾を撃ちます。\n絶対に負けない、勝利をつかむための:
…We'll pool everyone's power and fire a massive projectile.
One that guarantees we won't lose—a shot for victory.
m300348.あかんやないかい！\nで、どうしたらええんや？: That's not good! So, what should we do?
m300348.あっ、オキューさんここにいたんですね。\n彼と一緒に、花火でもしようかと――: Ah, Okyu-san, you were here! I was thinking of setting off fireworks with you—
m300348.あれ、花火苦手でしたか……？: Oh, you're not good with fireworks…?
m300348.い、いえ、お待ちを！\nそのためには、もっと多くの戦力が必要です！: N-no, hold on! We'll need far more forces for that!
m300348.いえ、そう断言できない状況です。\nプルラルクルスの封印自体は無事なのに、\n他: No, I can't say that for certain. The seal on the Pluralculus is intact, but the wave affecting other dimensions hasn't subsided.
m300348.いえ、それが私の任務でしたから。\n英雄王とも、互いにプルラルクルス討伐と、\n: No, that was my mission. It was a contract between the Hero King and us to cooperate until we defeated both the Pururarkulus and the Demon King.
m300348.うふっ、お祭りだからって呼ばれて、\nわざわざ世界を渡ってきたかいがあったわぁん: Hehe, being called to a festival and crossing worlds was totally worth it♪ Seeing Okyu's face like that♪
m300348.うんうん、ひとつの世界では限界があったけど、\n今回はみっつの世界が集っているか: Right, we hit limits in a single world, but now three worlds are united.
m300348.うんうん、今回はやる気ばっちり！\nみんなでプルラルクルスをぶっ飛ばすんだよね！:
Yeah, yeah, we're totally fired up this time!
We're gonna blast that Pluralculus together!
m300348.え、エフトラっ、その説明じゃ伝わらないと思うよ？: Uh, Ephtra, that explanation isn't really getting through, you know?
m300348.えぇと、お名前をうかがっても？\n戦いになったのは誤解だったわけですし。: Um, may I ask your names? The fight was just a misunderstanding, after all.
m300348.えっ、えぇと、せめて同時にではなく順番に――: Huh? Um, maybe not all at once—one after another—
m300348.えっ、魔力なんて持ってないよ……？\nアイドル力とかでもいいかな？:
Huh, I don't have any magic...?
Could I use my idol power instead?
m300348.えっ？ ふふ、アピールの仕方はそれぞれだから。\n私はカッコイイ王子を見られれば: Huh? Everyone has their own way to make an impression. If I get to see the dashing Prince—wait, Okyu, what are you saying?!
m300348.おぉ、これが後方腕組みシビラさん。\n急に「お祭りだから」と連れてこられた時に、: Ah, that's the classic crossed-arms Sybilla. When you were suddenly brought here for the festival, you struck that dignified pose just as Sorasu described!
m300348.おっと、そうだね。\n私はスズ、よろしくね。: Right, I'm Suzu. Nice to meet you.
m300348.おーおー、気合でぶっ飛ばすってことやな！\nそういうのなら得意分野や！: Oh yeah, so we just blast it away with spirit! That's right up my alley!
m300348.きゅうし？\nばばーんと復活しないんかや？: What? So it won't just burst back to life?
m300348.けれど、それを表に出さず、\n自然体で叩いているように見せるあの技量、\n王国の: Yet you hide it, making it look effortless. That skill, Prince of the kingdom, is anything but ordinary.
m300348.ここにいる全員の力があれば、必ず。: With everyone's power here, we can definitely do it.
m300348.さすがは王子ね、あの腰の入り方、\nきっと毎晩練習していたに違いないわ。: As expected of the Prince—that hip movement, you must've practiced it every night.
m300348.すみません、プルラルクルスは何が封印解除の\n原因になるかも分かっていなくて、\: Sorry, we don't even know what can trigger the seal's release on the Pururarkulus, so just remembering it was dangerous.
m300348.そうそう！\nぽーいって異世界の扉に投げ込まれちゃって\nほんっとーに大変だった: Exactly! I got tossed through that weird portal—‘po-i'—and it was a total nightmare!
m300348.そしてこちらは、日ノ本の城娘さんたちです。\n以前に何度か共闘したことがありまし: And these are the castle maidens from Nippon. We've teamed up with them a few times before.
m300348.そのために、時間稼ぎをお願いしたいのです。: For that, I'd like to ask you to buy us some time.
m300348.そのまさかです。\nみっつの世界が繋がっている今なら、\n封印装置の出力を上げ、: That's exactly it. With three worlds now linked, we could boost the seal device's output and aim for total annihilation…
m300348.その原因が、強すぎるとか、硬すぎるとかでなく、\n影響範囲が広すぎて\n手の出し: The problem wasn't that it was too strong or too hard, but that its influence spread too far, making it impossible to reach.
m300348.それぞれの世界で呼び名は異なるかと思いますが、\n基本的には、誰もが持っているも: The name might differ across worlds, but basically everyone has it.
m300348.それで、この子たちは？\n獣人……というには見慣れないような……。: And these kids? They're beast-people… but they don't look like any I've seen.
m300348.それで、千年戦争の後に、\n私たちの記憶まで消していったんですね？: So after the Millennium War, they even wiped our memories, huh?
m300348.それらの力を束ね、仮想砲身を構築、\n互いに魔力を拮抗させることで\n砲身と砲弾: We'll combine those powers to build a virtual barrel, balance the magic within it, and sustain both the barrel and the projectile—
m300348.ちょいまちー！\nその前にな、一個頼みたいことがあるんや。:
Hold on a sec!
Before that, I've got a favor to ask.
m300348.ちょっと、大丈夫ですか？\n――あっ、わたくしは大坂城です！: Hey, are you alright? — Ah, I'm Osaka Castle!
m300348.ですが、皆さんの世界は、\n現在それぞれの緊急事態が発生しているはず。\n討伐の: However, each of your worlds is currently dealing with its own emergencies. It's not a time to ask for help in a hunt.
m300348.と、殿っ……その、浴衣姿、ど、どう――: Um, my lord… uh, that yukata, how…
m300348.どうやら、ゲシュペンス島に異界の門が開き、\nそこからこちらへ迷い込んでしまった: It seems an otherworldly gate opened on Gesupens Island, and they got lost and ended up here.
m300348.どうりで、討伐した後にも、\nずっと何かを忘れてる気がしてたわけだ。: No wonder I've been feeling like I've been forgetting something ever since the hunt.
m300348.なぁんだ、じゃあお互いに\n遊びに行きやすくなるってこと？: So… does that mean it'll be easier for us to visit each other?
m300348.なので、我々は超広域での戦闘に備え、\n万全の布陣を展開した状態で\nプルラルク: So we can meet Pluralculus head-on, with a full-scale deployment ready for a battle that spans dimensions.
m300348.なるほど、では援軍は私が担当しま――: I see, then I'll take charge of the reinforcements—
m300348.は、花火やてぇ！？\nそれってパチパチドッカンするやつか！？: Fireworks!? You mean the ones that go *pop* and *bang*!?
m300348.はどー？ 他の世界に影響が及んでるってことぉ？: Huh? So it's affecting other worlds too?
m300348.ふっふっふ、案外ちょろいなぁ♪\nさぁて、他にも恋する乙女は――っとわぁ！？\n: Heh heh heh, surprisingly easy♪ Now, where are the other lovestruck maidens… what the—!?!
m300348.まだひとり、合流できてない子がいて……。\nたぶん海辺にいると思うんだけど……。:
There's still one person we haven't linked up with...
I think they're probably at the beach...
m300348.もぐもぐ……すふぉい迫力らねぇ……。\nお腹の奥までどんどん響いてくるよぉ。: Mmm… such a powerful swoosh… It reverberates all the way to my gut.
m300348.よし、そうと決まれば出撃ですね！\nどどーんとぶちかましてやりましょう！: All right, if that's decided, let's sortie! Let's smash it to pieces!
m300348.わかりやすいがや！\nそういう事なら任せておくだに！: Got it, crystal clear! If that's the case, leave it to me!
m300348.わたしはリンだよぉ。\n……王子くん、スライムをあまりいじめちゃだめだよ？: I'm Rin! …Prince, don't be too hard on the slimes, okay?
m300348.んっ、もしかして異界の門が開いたのは――: Hmm, could it be that the gate to the other realm opened—
m300348.イムラウ……いいえ、\n私はいつも、前向きに物事を考えています。:
Imlau… No.
I'm always looking on the bright side.
m300348.ウチらはさっき自己紹介したさかい、\n簡単でええかな？ オキューいうんや、よろし: We already introduced ourselves, so keep it simple, okay? I'm Okyu, nice to meet ya!
m300348.エフトラ、えーふーとーら。\n今、あんまりよくない考え事してたね？:
Ephtra, Ephtra.
You've been brooding over something not so great, huh?
m300348.セレンだ。\n王国にはドラゴンが大勢いるんだなぁ！: I'm Selen. The kingdom's got a ton of dragons, huh!
m300348.プルラルクルスが完全に目覚めると、\n時空同士の壁が曖昧になるのです。\nこれは: When the Pluralculus fully awakens, the walls between space-time become blurred. This might be a sign of that…
m300348.プルラルクルス本体の破壊は、どうするの……？: How are we going to destroy Pluralculus's core?
m300348.二個ずつくらいなら余裕余裕……だよ♪\nさぁ祭りの輪の中へ突撃～♪:
Two at a time is easy peasy…
Come on, let's charge into the festival circle!♪
m300348.何か秘策でもあるのか？\nたとえば……私たちも協力するとか。: Do you have some secret strategy? Like… us lending a hand?
m300348.前回の再封印時に、プルラルクルスの\n肉体は大幅に損壊させましたから。\n現在は:
When we resealed it last time, we severely damaged its body.
It's supposed to be rebuilding itself now.
m300348.名古屋城です。\nここで会ったのも何かの縁、よろしくお願いしますね！: Nagoya Castle here. It must be fate we met here—pleased to make your acquaintance!
m300348.封印銃を用いた儀式を改変し、\n膨大な負荷をかけることで、プルラルクルスの\n完: We've modified the sealing-gun ritual and cranked up the load so that, on paper, we can achieve total annihilation of Pluralculus.
m300348.嵐の前の静けさ、といったところでしょうか……。\nけれど、陣を構えられるのは心強: It's like the calm before the storm... but it's reassuring to have our formation ready.
m300348.彦根城、です……。\nけほっ、こほ……さっきの着陸のショックがまだ……。: Hikone Castle… *cough* *cough* The shock from the landing is still…
m300348.彼女らはゲシュペンス島のモンスター娘たちですね。\n直接会話をするのは、私も初め: They're the monster girls from Gesupens Island. This is the first time I've spoken with them directly.
m300348.戦友のことを忘れていたとか、\nすっごい申し訳ない気分になりますねぇ。: Forgetting about comrades… that makes me feel terribly apologetic.
m300348.戦場ではあんなにカッコイイ戦士だったのに、\nお祭りでは民のために太鼓を叩くなん: He was such a cool warrior on the battlefield, yet at the festival he drums for the people… The Prince really is amazing.
m300348.本当かなぁ……。\nよし、じゃあ前向きに、太鼓に混ざって花火にも混ざって、\nつ:
Is that true…?
Alright, then let's stay positive—join the drums, the fireworks, 
and while we're at it, dance, play goldfish-catch, and eat caramel apples.
m300348.海辺、海辺ですか……。\nでは王子、まずは行方不明者の捜索ですね。:
The beach, huh...?
Then, Prince, our first priority is to search for the missing person.
m300348.王子、私にも太鼓を叩かせてください！\n古代文明式の祭り太鼓、見せてあげますよ！:
Prince, let me play the drum too!
I'll show you an ancient-civilization style festival drum!
m300348.王子は見えないように努力をする天才だから。\nでもほら、隠しきれない情熱が、\n: The Prince is a genius who works unseen. But see, the passion you can't fully conceal creates the slightest tremor in the sound…
m300348.異世界にまで干渉する強大な妖物、\nどうにかここで、トドメを刺したいところですね:
A monstrous entity that even reaches into other worlds—
We'd love to finish it off right here.
m300348.私の封印銃が受け持ちます。\n皆さんから魔力を少しずつわけてもらい、\nプルラル:
I'll handle it with my sealing gun.
I'll have each of you contribute a bit of magic, and we'll forge a projectile to pierce Pluralculus.
m300348.端的に言えばそのとおりです。\nゲシュペンス島にも、日ノ本にも、\n次元自体に悪: In short, that's right. Both Gespens Island and Nippon should be suffering adverse effects on the dimensions themselves.
m300348.簡単に世界を渡ってしまうから、\n封印して、居場所を常にはっきりさせておきたい、: Because it can cross worlds so easily, the Hero King wanted to seal it and keep its location fixed—that was his plan.
m300348.行き来は簡単になりますが、\nその代わりに、プルラルクルスが\n万遍なく世界を滅: Travel will be simpler, but in exchange the Pluralculus will likely start wiping out worlds across the board…
m300348.諸悪の根源を叩く――しかないのでは？\nつまり次元生命体プルラルクルスを\n直接: We have no choice but to strike at the source of all evil—directly hit the dimensional lifeform Pluralculus.
m300348.趣味が悪いな……。\nいや、人の趣味にまで口出しはしないが。:
Your taste is terrible…
No, I don't usually meddle in other people's hobbies.
m300348.（何しろ、今の私には、\nみっつの世界の戦友ができてしまったんだから！）: (After all, I now have comrades from three worlds!)
m300348.（次は、何を目的に生きれば――）: (Now, what purpose shall I live for next—)
m300348.（祭りには、終わりが来る。\nどんな戦いにも、いずれ、きっと）:
(All festivals must end.
So does every battle, eventually.)
m300348.（私の戦いは、ようやく終わった……。\n長い時間がかかったけれど、終わらせること:
(My own battle has finally ended…
It took a long time, but I saw it through.)
m300348.（私も、もう少しだけ、戦ってみよう。\n今度は使命のためではなく、戦友のために）:
(I'll fight a little longer, too.
This time not for duty, but for my comrades.)

m320227.――ダーク王子の一件は、\nおそらく異界召喚士による策略だろうとの事です。: —As for the Dark Prince incident, it appears to have been a scheme by the otherworld summoner.
m320227.――王子、魔王軍の策略は恐ろしいものでした。\nけれど、どうしてでしょうか、違う: —Prince, the Demon King's army's scheme was terrifying. Yet I can't help but wonder—if we'd met under different circumstances, perhaps we could have walked the same path as the Dark Princes.
m320227.……あっ、ところで王子。\nアイギス神殿の前に、この剣が落ちていました。: …Ah, by the way, Prince. A sword was found in front of the Aegis Temple.
m320227.この剣を共に連れていってやりたい、と？\nなるほど、王子がそう仰るのであれば……: You want to take this sword with you? I see, if that's what you say, Prince…
m320227.そうすれば、もしかしたら、\nダーク王子が力を貸してくれるかもしれません。: Then perhaps the Dark Prince will lend you his power.
m320227.ダーク王子の剣を振るう時には、\n『闇の英雄』の称号を選択してください。: When you wield the Dark Prince's sword, choose the title “Hero of Darkness.”
m320227.去り際の笑顔だけは、\n少しだけ王子に似ていた気がします。: Only his parting smile seemed a little like yours.
m320227.微かにですが、ダーク王子の意志が\n宿っているようにも感じられます。\n彼らの生: I can faintly feel the Dark Prince's will lingering within it. Perhaps it's a testament to his existence…?
m320227.性格こそ王子とは似ても似つかない青年でしたが……。: His personality was nothing like yours, Prince, but…
m320227.王子、私達はこれからも先へ進み続けましょう。\n彼らが目指した先を、忘れることな: Prince, let's keep moving forward, never forgetting the destination they sought.

m320493.――ところが、そう上手くはいかぬ、ということだな。: —But that's not going to be that easy, is it.
m320493.――まさか、木人が動き出して、\nその上、反乱まで起こすとは……。: —No way, the wooden dummies actually started moving, and now they're even rebelling...
m320493.……分かってきたぜ。\nあの木人たちは、王子の仲間たちの剣を、\n誰よりも近くで: …I get it now. Those wooden dummies have been bathed in the swords of the Prince's comrades more closely than anyone else.
m320493.うむ。見取り稽古は軽視されがちだが、\n本物の達人を間近で見られるなら、話は別じ: Yes. Mitori-gyō is often underestimated, but if you can see a true master up close, that's a different story.
m320493.こちらの功夫服をどうぞ。\n着替える時には、称号を\n「練り上げた功夫」に変えて: Take this kung-fu outfit. When you change into it, be sure to update your title to “Refined Kung Fu.”
m320493.このまま放置するわけにもいきません。\nできれば、迅速に事態を収拾したいのですが: We can't just leave it as is. If possible, I'd like to resolve this quickly...
m320493.そう、地上最強と言ってよい。: Exactly, they're the strongest on earth.
m320493.どちらかというと、模様替えでは、という気もしますね。: I'd say it's more like a redecoration, actually.

m320493.まっ、わらわがへし折ってやってもいいのじゃが――: Well, I could snap them myself, but—

m320493.ソーマさん、オスカーさん、\n現状はどうなっていますか？: Soma-san, Oscar-san, what's the current situation?

m320493.王国の皆が待っています。\nさぁ、行きましょう！:
The kingdom's folks are waiting.
Come on, let's go!

m400322.あの大軍と闘うのはたしかに怖いけど、でも\n王子と一緒なら頑張れる気がする！\n: Fighting that massive army is definitely scary, but with you by my side, Prince, I feel like I can push through! Let's all work together and take down as many foes as we can!
m400322.お願い、王子！\nたくさんの魔物たちを倒してきた王子の力を\n私に貸してほしいの: Please, Prince! Lend me the power of the Prince who has slain countless monsters!
m400322.これで一通り話した感じかな？\nそれじゃあこれで説明はおしまい！\nじゃあ王子、: I think that covers everything. That's the end of the briefing! So, Prince, let's go knock those goblins out together!
m400322.こんなにゴブリンたちが怖く感じるのは\n初めてだから、私、どうしたらいいのか……: I've never been this scared of goblins before, so I don't know what to do...
m400322.じゃなくて！ 危ない危ない。それよりも私、\n王子に大事なことを伝えにきたんだっ: No, wait! That's dangerous, dangerous. More importantly, I've come to tell you something important, Prince!
m400322.その場合は、それまでに倒した敵の数もカウントされて\n戦果として記録されるみたい: In that case, the number of enemies you've taken down counts toward your battle record, so you might as well just focus on slaying as many as possible.
m400322.それじゃあ気を引き締めて！\n今回の戦いについて説明するね。: Then tighten your resolve! Let me explain the battle ahead.
m400322.ただ、今回出撃コストが時間経過で\n回復しないから注意してね。: Just a heads-up: your deployment cost won't recover over time in this sortie.
m400322.だから、ライフが0になってもクリアになるのよ。: That means you can still clear the mission even if your life hits zero.
m400322.だからどうかお願い！ 王子の力を貸してください！: So please, I beg you—lend me your strength!
m400322.だから自軍の被害を抑えるよりも、\nどれだけたくさんの敵を倒すかっていうのが\n: So it looks like the focus is on how many enemies you can defeat, not on keeping your own casualties low.
m400322.ちょっと前から少しずつゴブリンたちが\n不穏な動きをするようになってきたって、\: The clan elders have been saying that the goblins have been acting more ominously lately...
m400322.なのに、今回のゴブリンたちの進攻は、\nとてもじゃないけど私たちだけじゃ\n抑え: Yet this goblin invasion is so overwhelming that we couldn't possibly hold it back on our own...
m400322.もしかしたら千年戦争の時に魔界に逃れた\nゴブリンの指導者が、地上界に戻ってきた: Some even whisper that the goblin commander who fled to the demon realm during the Millennium War may have returned to the surface.
m400322.今回の戦いは、とにかく敵をたくさん倒すことを\n目的とした『大討伐ミッション』な: This fight is a "Grand Hunt Mission"—the goal is simply to defeat as many enemies as possible.
m400322.倒すことに夢中になって部隊をどんどん展開して\nいっちゃうと、戦況が急に変わった: If you get carried away and keep sending out troops, you might not be able to place units when the battle suddenly shifts, so watch out for that.
m400322.別に私たちドワーフが弱いわけじゃないんだよ？\n私の知る限り、ドワーフ族がゴブリ: It's not like dwarves are weak. As far as I know, we've never once been outright beaten by goblins!
m400322.大討伐ミッションの最大の目的は\n『敵を撃破すること』！: The ultimate goal of a Grand Hunt Mission is to crush the enemy!
m400322.大討伐ミッションは、通常のミッションとは\nいくつか違う点があるから注意してね。: Grand Hunt Missions differ from regular missions in several ways, so stay alert.
m400322.嬉し、い……。\nうぅ……ぐしゅ……本当にありがとう……。: I'm so happy... *sniff* ...Thank you so much...
m400322.実は今、ゴブリンの大軍が王国に進攻しようと\nしているの！: The truth is, a massive goblin army is about to march on the kingdom!
m400322.王子の強さは私たちドワーフの里にまで\n知れ渡ってるくらいだし、一緒に闘ってくれ: Your strength is known all the way to our dwarf village, and if you fight alongside us, we couldn't ask for a more reliable ally.
m400322.私の故郷のドワーフ族は、とっても昔から\nゴブリンたちと戦ってきたんだけど……。: My dwarf clan has been fighting goblins since ancient times, but I've never seen them this swarmed up before.
m400322.私はドロシー。\n背は小っちゃいけど、これでもドワーフ族の戦士なんだよ。\n大地: I'm Dorothy. I'm short, but I'm still a dwarf warrior. Some even call me a earth fairy!

m400472.――王子、此度は白の帝国、王国共同で行う\n軍事演習への申し入れに快諾頂いたこと: —Prince, I want to express my gratitude once more for your gracious acceptance of the joint military exercise between the White Empire and the Kingdom.
m400472.そうだな、形式としては普段の\n魔物討伐の任とは違い『大討伐ミッション』\nとい: Right, unlike our usual monster-hunting quests, we'll be using a “Grand Hunt Mission” format for this.
m400472.それでは『大討伐ミッション』開始とさせて頂く！: Then, let the Grand Hunt Mission begin!
m400472.たとえライフが０になってもクリアとなり、\nそれまでに倒した数はカウントされ\n: Even if your life reaches zero, the mission counts as cleared, and the number of enemies you've slain will be tallied as your battle record.
m400472.つまり、自軍の被害を恐れるよりも\n少しでも多くの相手を打ち倒す事に\n専念する: In other words, focus on killing as many opponents as possible rather than worrying about your own casualties.
m400472.まず大討伐ミッションでは\n『敵を撃破すること』\nそれのみが唯一の目的となる。: First, the sole objective is simple: defeat the enemies.
m400472.また敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできない。\n: Moreover, defeating enemies won't grant EXP, gold, or drops. Remember that.
m400472.今回の演習は帝国と王国、互いの戦力を知り\n共闘を学ぶ良い機会だ、貴公の国の兵も: This drill is a great chance for the Empire and the Kingdom to learn each other's capabilities and how to fight side-by-side. Your troops will also take part.
m400472.兎に角一人でも多く相手を倒す、\nそれこそが最も重要だ。: In short, the more foes you take down, the better—that's what matters most.
m400472.出撃コストが時間経過で回復しない事も留意しておけ。\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ: Also note that deployment cost does not recover over time. Make sure to include someone with the “Call Reinforcements” skill and a Valkyrie in your sortie team.
m400472.場所については当帝国の領土内、\n新設した防衛拠点にて行う事になる。: The location will be within our empire's territory, at a newly established defensive outpost.
m400472.大討伐ミッションでは通常のミッションとは違い\n幾つか異なる点がある事に注意して: Keep in mind that a Grand Hunt Mission differs from a regular mission in several ways.
m400472.有事の際には貴国の力を借りる事もあるだろう。\nその際に互いの力を知らない、\n: In times of crisis we may call upon your aid. It would be problematic if we didn't know each other's strength or couldn't coordinate.
m400472.此度の演習、王国帝国双方にとって\n意義のある演習となることを願っているぞ。: I hope this drill proves meaningful for both the Kingdom and the Empire.
m400472.此度の演習の目的は、我が帝国軍の\n軍力向上、並びに貴国との連携の強化にある。: The purpose of this exercise is to improve our imperial forces and to strengthen cooperation with your nation.
m400472.演習とは言え、こちらとしても拠点の効果の程を試す\n絶好の機会だ。全力で当たらせ: Though it's an exercise, it's also a perfect chance for us to test the outpost's effectiveness. We'll give it our all, so don't let your guard down either.

m400487.――っと、その前に、\n今回の戦いについて、\n私から重要なことを説明させていた: Ah, but before that, let me explain something important about this battle, shall I?

m400487.そして、それをもとに私が抗体を作りましたので\n今回は魔界アリの女王に操られるこ: Using that data, I created an antidote, so this time we won't be controlled by the demonic ant queen. All the men can fight alongside you.

m400487.それでは出陣しましょう、王子！\n『大討伐ミッション』スタートです！: Then let's march out, Prince! The “Grand Annihilation Mission” begins!

m400487.つまり、自分達の仲間の被害を抑えるよりも、\nどれだけたくさんの敵を\n倒せるか: In other words, the focus is on how many foes you can take down, not on minimizing casualties among our own.
m400487.ですので、傷つくことを恐れずに、\n一体でも多くの魔物を倒すことを考えてください: So, don't fear getting hurt—just try to slay as many monsters as you can.

Also, this time we have to respond to a sudden enemy invasion, so we can't deploy troops as usual.

m400487.更に、今回のミッションにおいては\nライフが0になってもクリアとなり、それまでに: Moreover, this mission counts as cleared even if our life gauge hits zero; the number of enemies slain up to that point is recorded as our achievement.
m400487.王国領内に魔界アリの大軍が侵攻を始めています……！: A massive army of demonic ants is invading the kingdom's lands...!
m400487.王子！ 私です、テルマです！\n突然、執務室に入ってしまって、すみません。\nで: Prince! It's me, Thelma! I'm sorry to barge into the office like this, but it's an emergency...!
m400487.錬金術で作った秘薬は、\n魔界アリの硬い甲殻も軟化させる事ができるので、\nきっ: The elixir I brewed with alchemy can even soften the hard shells of those demonic ants, so I'm sure it'll be useful!
m400487.錬金術の素材を集める為に\n今まで何度も渓谷を訪れているのですが、\nあんな数の: I've visited the canyon countless times to gather alchemical ingredients, but I've never seen a swarm like this before...

m400563.『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ者やワルキューレ等\n出撃コストを増加させる能力を持っ: I recommend including troops with the "Request Reinforcements" skill or Valkyries and others who can increase deployment costs in your team.
m400563.さまざまな兵種が増え、戦略に幅が出るのは\n良いことではありますが……それらの影: It's good that we have more unit types and a broader strategy, but if that ends up lowering the soldiers' morale, it'll be counterproductive.
m400563.そこで今回は、戦力の底上げを図るべく\n王子軍大演習を開催しようかと思っています: So, I'm thinking we should hold a large-scale drill to boost our combat effectiveness.
m400563.それでは、今回の演習の説明に移ります。: Now, let me explain the drill.
m400563.それではこれより『大討伐ミッション』を開始いたします。: With that, the Grand Annihilation Mission will now commence.
m400563.それと敵を倒してもＥＸＰやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできませんの: And keep in mind that defeating enemies won't grant any EXP, gold, or item drops.
m400563.ただ、そのような事態になっているにもかかわらず\n我が軍は山賊や海賊など、正規の: Yet, despite that, our ranks are swelling with bandits, pirates, and others who've never had proper training, and discipline is starting to slip.
m400563.はっきり申しまして、我が軍はたるんでいると思います！: Frankly, our army has become complacent!

m400563.また、出撃コストは時間経過で回復いたしません。: Also, deployment costs do not recover over time.
m400563.ライフが０になってもクリアとなり\nそれまでに倒した敵の数がカウントされ\n戦果: Even if your life reaches zero, the mission counts as cleared, and the number of enemies you've slain will be tallied as your battle record.
m400563.今回の演習では、緊張感を取り戻し更なる力を得ることを\n目的としております。成果: This drill aims to restore our sense of urgency and gain extra strength. Depending on the results, we might be able to turn future battles to our advantage.
m400563.今回は敵を倒すことだけを目的とした\n『大討伐ミッション』という演習方式をとらせ: We'll be using a "Grand Annihilation Mission" format, where the sole objective is to defeat the enemy.
m400563.今後、魔物の軍勢との戦いが激化することは明白……。: It's clear that battles against their forces will only intensify from here on out...

m400563.大討伐ミッションは、通常のミッションと\nいくつか異なる点がありますのでご注意を: The Grand Annihilation Mission differs from regular missions in several ways, so please take note.
m400563.王子。ここ最近の魔物たちが、以前と比べて強さを\n増している事実、すでにお気付き: Prince, you've already noticed that the monsters have been getting stronger lately.
m400563.自軍の被害を抑えるよりも\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかを重要視いたします。: We prioritize killing as many foes as possible over minimizing our own casualties.

m500119.あのまま暴れられていては、\n自然そのもののバランスが\n崩れてしまう可能性があ: If he had kept rampaging, the very balance of nature could have collapsed.
m500119.ありがとう王子。\n魔神アガレスが出現してから、\n動物たちが怯えていて可哀想だ:
Thank you, Prince.
Since Agares appeared, the animals have been terrified and pitiful.
m500119.そうだったのか……。\n自然を司るエレメンタルが変貌すると、\n動物たちも棲みづ: I see… When elementals that govern nature transform, the animals can't live there comfortably either.
m500119.その上、魔界のデーモンを引き連れているなんて……。\nまさかとは思いますが……、: And to think they're bringing demons from the demon realm… It seems unlikely, but… the soldiers' testimonies all point to the same monster…
m500119.ただでさえ危険な魔物の感情を引き出し、\n戦わせるなんて、危険な存在であることに: Even without that, drawing out a monster's dangerous emotions and making them fight still makes him a perilous being.
m500119.アースエレメンタルは、\n自然物に宿るエネルギーが具象化した存在で、\nそう簡単: Earth elementals are beings that embody the energy residing in natural objects, so they shouldn't be so easily controlled…
m500119.伝承では、巨大な魔物を意のままに操り、\n魔界一の魔物使いとして君臨している魔神: According to legend, he manipulates massive monsters at will and reigns as the supreme monster tamer of the demon world.
m500119.伝説の魔神アガレスです……。: It's the legendary demon god Agares…
m500119.兵士の鍛錬やチーム編成の見直しといった\n十分な準備をした上で戦いに挑まれること: I recommend you thoroughly prepare—retrain the troops, revise team compositions—before you take on the battle.
m500119.兵達の報告によると、\n多数のデーモンとアースエレメンタルが渓谷に現れ、\n領内: According to the troops' reports, numerous demons and earth elementals have appeared in the valley and are advancing into our territory.
m500119.斥候部隊が発見し、魔物を止めに入りましたが、\n魔物に少し外傷を負わせたところ、: The scouting unit engaged them and managed to wound the monsters a bit, but they transformed into beasts that ravage the battlefield at demonic speed.
m500119.王子、強大な戦闘能力を持った魔物の出現が\n確認されました。: Prince, we've confirmed the emergence of a monster with tremendous combat power.
m500119.王子、討伐に向かうのであれば、\n魔物を攻撃するタイミングを見極め、\n注意して: Prince, if we go on a hunt, we must discern the right moments to strike and proceed with caution.
m500119.王子、魔神アガレスが後退していきます！: Prince, Agares the demon god is retreating!
m500119.自然を救い、魔神アガレスを撃退出来て\n本当に良かったです……。\nそれでは帰還: I'm so glad we were able to save nature and defeat the demon god Agares... Let's head back now.
m500119.迎撃にあたった部隊も全て壊滅してしまい、\n生き延びた兵士の証言によりますと、\: All the units that tried to intercept were wiped out, and surviving soldiers say a small old man was leading the monsters.
m500119.魔物の内に宿る憎悪や憤怒を操り、\n少し傷つけられただけで、激昂状態にさせ、\n: He manipulates the hatred and fury within monsters, and even a slight injury throws them into a frenzy, making them swift.
m500119.魔神アガレスは、意思のない\nアースエレメンタルさえコントロールして、\n危険な: Agares can even control mindless earth elementals and turn them into dangerous monsters.
m500119.魔神アガレスを止めてくれて\n本当にありがとう、王子。: Thank you for stopping Agares, Prince. Truly grateful.

m500422.――あっ、実際に体験するのは無理ですけど、\nもしかしたら、\n夢の中で仮想体験:
――Ah, actually experiencing it is out of the question, but
perhaps
we could simulate it in a dream.
m500422.――ほう。\nまだ抗うだけの意志が残っているのか。:
――Hm.
You still have the will to resist.
m500422.――みなさん？\n軍議が終わってからにしましょうね？:
――Everyone?
Let's wait until the war council is over, shall we?
m500422.――クロノシア、貴様の命、\n余さず未来のために使うと約束しよう。:
――Chronosia, I promise you
I will use your life to the fullest for the sake of the future.
m500422.――ッ！ はぁ、はぁ、はぁ……！\nふぅ……や、やばかったぞ、おい……。:
――! Haa, haa, haa……!
Phew…… that was close, man…….
m500422.――大神ディアス。\nこの世界を、お前の好きにはさせない。:
――Great God Dias.
I will not let you have your way with this world.
m500422.……ああ。\n何があっても、戦える力を。:
……Yeah.
No matter what happens, we need the strength to fight.
m500422.……あの、ここは執務室ですよ？: ……Um, this is the office, you know?
m500422.……ッ……くそ……ディアス、お前を、殺してやる……！: ……Gh…… Damn it…… Dias, I'll kill you……!
m500422.……モーティマさん？\n時をむやみに操るのは禁忌ですよ？:
……Mortimer?
Manipulating time carelessly is forbidden, you know?
m500422.あぁ、なるほど。\nレーヴ嬢の力を使って、\nクロノシア様の想定した戦場を皆に伝:
Ah, I see.
So you're using Miss Reve's power
to show everyone the battlefield Chronosia foresaw?
m500422.あの場にいた、誰かひとりでも欠けていたなら、\n確実に、より過酷な状況となってい:
If even one person who was there had been missing,
the situation would have certainly been far more dire.
m500422.えぇ、今後のためにもぜひ、\n詳しく知りたいところですね。:
Yes, for our future's sake,
we really do want to know the details.
m500422.えぇ。ここで手を放せば、\n世界は致命的に壊れてしまう。\n命をかける価値は、こ:
Yes. If we let go here,
the world will be fatally broken.
It is worth risking our lives for this.
m500422.えっ、あの、みなさん？\nどうして興味のありそうなお顔を？:
Ehh? Um, everyone?
Why do you all have such interested looks on your faces?
m500422.お、おいランシェ、まさか――: W-wait, Lanche, you can't be serious――
m500422.そんなことな――くっ、\nあぁ、もういい！ そうだ、ぼくは君が嫌いだ！:
I wouldn't go that far――ugh.
Fine, forget it! Yes, I hate you!
m500422.でも、君にはぼくを殴る権利がある。\nさぁ殴れ、思いっきり！:
But you have every right to hit me.
Go on, hit me. As hard as you can!
m500422.でもよぉ、今後は色々楽になりそうだな。\n何しろクロノシア様の時間操作で、\nど:
But hey, things should be a lot easier from now on.
With Chronosia's time manipulation,
we can beat any powerful enemy!
m500422.とはいえ、ディアスと戦えるだけの実力をつけるのは、\n確かに、目下最優先の課題と:
Still, building up the strength to face Dias is certainly
our top priority right now……
m500422.ならば、この要塞宮殿の力をもって、\nお前たちに神罰の雷を下そう。:
Very well. I shall use the power of this fortress-palace
to bring the thunder of divine punishment down upon you.
m500422.はぁ……はぁ……くっ……。\n王子くん、どうか、逃げてください……。\n私たちで:
Haa…… haa…… ugh…….
Prince, please, run…….
We will buy you some time…….
m500422.はい！ あの、もしできれば、なのですけど……。: Yes! Um, if it's possible, I was wondering if……
m500422.ふっふっふ、皆さんいい心がけですね！: Fu, fu, fu. You all have such admirable spirits!
m500422.ふふ、勉強熱心なのは良いことです。\nそれでは、少しだけ協力しましょうか。:
Heh, it's good to see such eagerness to learn.
Then, let us lend a little of our help.
m500422.ふふっ、それに、そんな簡単なことでもないのですよ？\n私の権能を用いた場合ですが:
Hehe, and it's not that simple, either.
When I use my authority, even if we go back in time,
we'll inevitably end up at the same conclusion.
m500422.ふふっ、私もあとでお説教をしてあげないと。\n夢経由で時の女神の未来視を覗いてい:
Hehe, I suppose I'll have to give him a lecture later.
Peeking into the future through dreams using the Goddess of Time's foresight…
Ikol really is a naughty one, isn't he?
m500422.へぇ……あれより過酷な戦場か。\nちょっと興味あるな。:
Hm… A battlefield harsher than that one.
That sounds a bit interesting.
m500422.またそうやって！\nそんなに私のこと嫌いですか！？\n顔も見たくないってことです:
You always say that!
Do you hate me that much!?
You don't even want to look at me, do you!?
m500422.もしあの場の誰か、ひとりでも欠けていれば、\n先程の光景が実際に発生していたこと:
If even one person from that scene had been missing,
the scene we just witnessed would have become reality.
m500422.もしもの戦場、『大神降臨ディアス』へ。: To the hypothetical battlefield, "The Great God's Descent: Dias."
m500422.よく吠えるものだな。勘違いをするな。\nまだ死んでいないのではない。\n殺さぬよ:
You bark loudly. Don't get your hopes up.
You are not dead yet.
I am merely holding back so as not to kill you.
m500422.ガード……イコルさんが、\n色々と先読みして行動していたの、\nクロノシア様の力:
Guard… Ikol was
anticipating events and acting accordingly because
he was secretly using Chronosia's power, I see…
m500422.ハリンヘイムこそ、どうしてこんな場所にいるんだ。\n大人しく後方へ引っ込んでいれ:
Harinheim, why are you in a place like this?
If you had just stayed back where you belong――
m500422.レーヴさん、ここまで他者の夢に介入できるとは。\n随分と修行を積んでこられたので:
Miss Reve, to intrude into another's dream to this extent.
You must have undergone quite a bit of training.
m500422.人類の、物質界の可能性、か……。: The potential of humanity, of the material world…….
m500422.今ここに、創造神は帰還を果たす。\n余こそ、創造神を継ぐ者――大神ディアスなり。:
Here and now, the Creator God has returned.
I am the one who inherits the Creator God――the Great God, Dias.
m500422.今のは夢とはいえ、\n実際に私が観測した、未来の可能性のひとつです。:
Though it was a dream,
it is one of the possible futures I actually observed.
m500422.今回の結果は、神獣との親和性の高いアンナさんの存在や、\n聖剣を手にしたシビラさ:
The outcome this time was due to Anna's high affinity with the Divine Beast,
Sibyl wielding the Holy Sword,
and the Prince's strong will all coming together perfectly.
m500422.修行というか……その……。\n毎年色々ありまして……。:
Training, you say…… well, um…….
A lot has happened every year…….
m500422.夢……夢？ これ本当に夢？\n大丈夫ですか？ 私生きてます？:
A dream…… a dream? Is this really a dream?
Are you okay? Am I alive?
m500422.後日談というのは、いつだってこんなものですよ。\nまだ事態は終息していないとはい:
Epilogues are always like this, you see.
Even if the crisis isn't entirely over,
it's important to work through these strained relationships.
m500422.来い、王子！\n貴様の思い描く未来が偽物だと教えてやろう！:
Come, Prince!
I will show you that the future you envision is a lie!
m500422.王国にはですね、歓迎の模擬戦！\n仲直りの模擬戦！ 宴会後の模擬戦等々、\n愉快:
You see, the Kingdom has a whole host of delightful traditions!
Welcome spars! Reconciliation spars! Post-banquet spars, and so on!
m500422.王子……。\n分かった、君がまだ、立ち上がるというのなら……！:
Prince…….
I see. If you are still willing to stand……!
m500422.王子……そう、よね。\n諦めないと、そう誓ったんだもの。:
Prince…… that's right.
We swore we wouldn't give up.
m500422.王子、今後も気を抜かず、\n着実に訓練を積んでいきましょう！:
Prince, let's keep pushing ourselves and
train steadily from here on out!
m500422.王子、着弾地点から兵を退避させてください！\nとんでもない威力の雷撃が来ますよ！:
Prince, withdraw your troops from the impact zone!
A strike of tremendous power is coming!!
m500422.良いだろう。\n世界を書き換えるまで、まだ幾分か時間がある。\n王子よ、貴様の最:
Very well.
I still have some time before I rewrite the world.
Prince, show me your final battle.
m500422.見よ！ これこそが！\n悪を剪定する原初の雷撃だ！:
Behold! This is
the primordial thunderbolt that prunes away evil!
m500422.言いましたね。\nでは全力で――ッ！！:
You heard that.
Then I'll go all out――!!
m500422.話を大げさにするな！\n王子も武具の準備を始めるんじゃない！:
Don't exaggerate!
And don't start gearing up, Prince!

m920052.……え。\nまさかあなたが……団長なのですか？: …What? Could it really be you… the leader?
m920052.……しかし、肝心のユーノさんの姿が見当たりません。\n一体どこに……。: …But Yuno is nowhere to be seen. Where could she be…?
m920052.……なーんて我輩が言うとでも思ったか！\n愚か者め！: …Did you really think I'd say that?! Fool!
m920052.あ、こら動くでない！ くすぐったいだろう！！: Hey, don't move! It's ticklish, you know!!
m920052.あなたの野望もここまでです。\n降参してください。: Your ambition ends here. Surrender now.
m920052.ありがとう、ございます。\nなんてお礼を言ったらいいか……。: Thank you… I don't know how to thank you.
m920052.ありがとうございます。\n本当になんてお礼を言ったらいいか……。: Thank you. I really don't know how to thank you…
m920052.ありがとうございます！\nすみません、お力を貸していただくはずが、\n助けてもら: Thank you! I'm sorry—I was supposed to lend you my aid, but I've only been rescued and can't do anything…
m920052.い、嫌ですっ！ 離してください！: I… I don't want this! Let me go!
m920052.いいえ、ご無事で何よりです。\nそれよりも彼らは一体何者なんですか？: No, I'm just glad you're safe. More importantly, who are they?
m920052.ぅう……っ。闇の力を間近に感じるっ……。\n早くここ、から……出なければ……ッ。: Ugh… I can feel the darkness up close… I have to get out of here quickly…!
m920052.おい。そこの者。貴様にはこいつを支給してやろう。\nこの新しいワンドを使えば、強: Hey you over there. I'll equip you with this. With this new wand you can cast powerful magic and even gain resistance to spells!
m920052.おのれ！！\n我輩の邪魔をしおって……！: Damn it!! You keep getting in my way…!
m920052.お姉ちゃん……、力がうまく出せない……！\nどうして……。: Big sis… I can't get my power out…! Why…?
m920052.お断りします。\n私はあなたたちの言いなりになんてなりません！: I refuse. I won't be your puppet.
m920052.お願いします王子。\nどうか私にお力をお貸しください！: Please, Prince. Lend me your aid!
m920052.このままでは、私は自分の手で沢山の人を不幸に\nしてしまう……。: If this continues, I'll end up causing countless people misery with my own hands…
m920052.このまま街へ向かい、\nあの女の力を利用して住民どもに\n暗黒騎士団の怖さを思い: We'll head to the town and use that woman's power to show the townsfolk the terror of the Dark Knights.
m920052.この先には民家もあります。\nここで迎え撃ちましょう、王子！: There are houses ahead. Let's meet them here, Prince!
m920052.これでユーノさんの中に封印されていた闇の神官も、\n葬ることができましたね。: Now we've been able to lay to rest the dark priest sealed inside Yuno.
m920052.これはっ、闇の力……！\n身体の奥から……、\n闇の力があふれてきて、いますッ…: It's… the power of darkness! From deep within my body… the darkness is overflowing, it's…!
m920052.さぁ団員たちよ、我輩から素敵な武器を支給しよう。\n鎧に身を包む我々が飛び道具を: Come now, comrades, let me equip you with splendid weapons. If we, clad in armor, take up projectiles, burying the Prince will be a breeze.
m920052.さっすが王子だ！ \nこうなっては我輩も降参せざるをえないな。: That's the Prince for you! In this case, I have no choice but to surrender as well.
m920052.それでは王子、お城に戻りましょうか。: Then, Prince, shall we head back to the castle?
m920052.どうやら闇の力の影響で、癒し手の力が抑えられて\nいるようです。お気をつけくださ: It seems the darkness is suppressing the healers' power. Please be careful.
m920052.なにかカラクリがあるのかもしれません。\nお気を付けください。: There may be some trick behind this. Please be careful.
m920052.なんだか、癒しの力が奪われていきます……。: Somehow, the healing power keeps getting stolen…
m920052.なんだその疑いの眼差しは！ 無礼な奴だ！！\nいいだろうっ！ 我輩の強さを見せて: What's with that doubtful stare! You insolent fool!! Fine then! I'll show you my strength!
m920052.なんとか無事に退けることができましたね。: We managed to drive them off safely, it seems.
m920052.はい。新しく作っていただいた団長の証のおかげです。: Yes. Thanks to the newly forged symbol of my command.
m920052.はい！ 必ずやご期待に応えて見せましょう。: Yes! I'll certainly live up to your expectations.
m920052.ふっ。目の前にいるではないか。: Heh. He's right in front of you.
m920052.ふははは！ どこだろうなぁ？\n我輩にもわからんなぁ。: Hahaha! I wonder where… I have no idea myself.
m920052.ふふっ。私たちと一緒にいれば、\n闇の神官の魂が覚醒することもないはずです。: Hehe. As long as you're with us, the dark priest's soul won't awaken.
m920052.ふふふ。楽しみにしているよ。: Hehehe. I'm looking forward to it.
m920052.ふむふむ。うまくやっているようだね。\n新団長のデシウス君。: Hmm, hmm. Looks like you're doing well, new commander Decius.
m920052.ほう、もう来たのか。さすが英雄の末裔の王子。\n重装の暗黒騎士の足止めをものとも: Ah, they've arrived. As expected of the hero's heir, the Prince. To think you could hold back heavily armored Dark Knights. But I still have a trump up my sleeve.
m920052.まさか、また狙われることになるなんて……。\n彼らの狙いは、おそらく私の身に封印: I never imagined they'd target me again… They're probably after the soul of the “Dark Priest” sealed within me.
m920052.まったく。君には期待していたんだけどね。\nこれ以上失敗が続くようなら……。わか: Honestly, I had high hopes for you. If you keep failing… you know what'll happen, right?
m920052.もう闇の力に共鳴することがなくなるのですね……。\nこれで安心できます。: I won't resonate with dark power any more… Now I can finally feel safe.
m920052.よろしければ、事情を聞かせてください。: If you'd like, please tell us what happened.
m920052.よろしければ私たちの仲間になりませんか？\nこれからは王子と一緒に行動を共にしま: If you'd like, would you join us? From now on we'll act together with the Prince.
m920052.わざわざ我輩自ら迎えに来てやったのだぞ。\n大人しくこちらに来てもらおうか！: I even came personally to fetch you. Come quietly, will you!
m920052.ユーノさんが危ない……！\n王子、急ぎ神殿まで戻りましょう！: Yuno is in danger…! Prince, let's hurry back to the temple!
m920052.ユーノさんに封印されていた闇の魂が、\n暴走しているのかもしれません。: The dark soul that Yuno sealed may be running amok.
m920052.以前、闇の神官が私の住む街を強襲してきました。\n私は仲間達とともに敵に立ち向か: The Dark Priest once launched a raid on my hometown. My companions and I fought back, but we fell just short against that overwhelming darkness…
m920052.先ほどは助けていただいて、ありがとうございます。\n私はユーノと申します。: Thank you for rescuing me earlier. My name is Yuno.
m920052.先ほど私を襲ってきたのは\n暗黒騎士団の手の者です。: The ones who attacked me just now were members of the Dark Knight Order.
m920052.前線からの報告によると、分厚い鎧に身を固めた、\n新手の暗黒騎士がいるようです。: Reports from the front say there's a new Dark Knight clad in heavy armor. We should be careful.
m920052.力が出ない……。闇の力の影響か\n癒し手の力がかなり削がれています……。: I can't use my power… The dark influence is draining my healing abilities.
m920052.卑劣なことばかりしようとするから、\n天罰が下ったのです。: Because you keep doing such despicable things, divine punishment has befallen you.
m920052.報告！ 先ほど伝令が参りました。\n領内に新手の暗黒騎士団が現れたようです！: Report! A messenger just arrived. A new Dark Knight Order has appeared in the territory!
m920052.報告！ 暗黒騎士団の団長だと\n名乗る者が現れました！: Report! Someone claiming to be the leader of the Dark Knight Order has appeared!
m920052.報告！ 魔物がこちらに向かってきています！: Report! Monsters are heading this way!
m920052.実は以前、暗黒騎士団に囚われていたことがあったんです……。\n団長が不在になり騎: Actually, I was once captured by the Dark Knight Order… When their leader vanished and the order fell apart, I seized the chance to escape…
m920052.彼らはその闇の神官の力を使って、\n世界を滅ぼそうとしています。: They intend to use the Dark Priest's power to destroy the world.
m920052.心なしか体も軽くなったような気がします。: I feel… lighter, as if my body's weight has lifted.
m920052.新生暗黒騎士団団長デシウス自らが\n貴様らの相手をしてやろうぞ！: I, Decius, the newly appointed leader of the Dark Knight Order, will handle you myself!
m920052.暗黒騎士デシウスの\n闇の力に長く触れていたせいでしょうか？: It must be because she's been exposed to Decius's dark power for so long.
m920052.暗黒騎士団のような闇の力を持つ者に近づくと、\n魂が共鳴し、闇の神官の魂を抑えら: When I get close to someone wielding darkness like the Dark Knight Order, our souls resonate and I can't suppress the Dark Priest's soul.
m920052.王子、あそこに襲われている女性が！\n急ぎ助けましょう！: Prince, there's a woman being attacked over there! Let's rescue her quickly!
m920052.王子、ユーノさんを救う事が出来て\n本当に良かったですね。: Prince, I'm truly glad we could save Yuno.
m920052.王子、癒し手の力が弱まっています。\nどこかにユーノさんが捕らわれているのは\n: Prince, the healers' power is weakening. Yuno must be captured somewhere, that's for sure…
m920052.王子どもは我輩の陽動にまんまと騙されました。: The prince was easily fooled by my diversion.
m920052.王子！ お気を付けください。\n暗黒騎士団の者が何やら新しい武器を\n手にしてい: Prince! Be careful. The Dark Knights seem to have acquired some new weapons…!
m920052.王子！ なんとか間に合ったようです。\n暗黒騎士団襲撃の一報を受け、\n急ぎ駆け: Prince! It looks like we made it in time. We received word of the Dark Knight Order's raid and rushed here, so it was worth it.
m920052.王子！ 暗黒騎士がユーノさんを連れて\n森の中へ逃げていきます！ なんて卑劣な…: Prince! The Dark Knight took Yuno and fled into the forest! How despicable…!
m920052.申し訳ございません……っ。\n次こそは必ずや王子を倒します！！: I'm sorry…! Next time I'll definitely defeat the Prince!!
m920052.私でよければ……。是非よろしくお願いします。: If that's alright… I'd be honored. Please take care of me.
m920052.自分の身にその邪悪なる魂を封じるのが精一杯でした。\n普段は、この闇の神官の魂を: All I could do was seal that evil soul inside myself. Usually I can keep the Dark Priest's soul suppressed. But…
m920052.闇の力に共鳴してしまう以上、\n彼らには絶対に近づかないほうがいいです。\n神殿: Since we resonate with the darkness, it's best to stay far away from them. Hide and stay concealed in the temple.

How… how could you have a sword…!?
Are you… actually planning to fight?!
m920090.どうやら魔物が現れたようですね。\n王子、戦いのご準備をお願いします。: Looks like the monsters have shown up. Prince, please prepare for battle.
m920090.なるほど……ふむ、\n特に魔力等は感じませぬな。\nあの剣に何か特殊な力が？: I see… Hmm, I don't sense any magic or anything. Does that blade have some special power?
m920090.はい。それにあの口ぶり、近いうちに\nまた襲撃がありそうです。\nしばらくは警戒: Yes. And from the way it sounded, I suspect another raid is coming soon. We'll need to stay on guard for a while.
m920090.はい。王子、ひとまずは都市に向かい、\n魔物が接近していることを報せましょう。: Understood. Prince, let's head to the city and inform them that monsters are drawing near.
m920090.はい！ エレーヌさん、\nその時は是非よろしくお願いしますね！: Yes! Elene, when that time comes, please count on us!
m920090.ふふ。これは神の創造物が一つ、天使像。\n地上を滅ぼすための破壊の権化。巨人族と: Heh. That's not a giant—it's a divine creation, an Angelic Statue. A living embodiment of destruction, meant to wipe the world clean. To speak of it as equal to the giants… you're truly foolish.
m920090.ふん、知性の低いサイクロプスの連中と\n一緒にするな。我らは巨人族の中でも\n高: Hmph, don't lump us together with those low-IQ cyclops. We are the Gigars, the high-rank giants among our kind.
m920090.まさか街の地下にこのような道があったとは。: I never imagined there'd be a tunnel like this beneath the city.
m920090.まずは簡易ではありますが、\nこの国近辺での戦闘行為を\n許諾頂く協定が先ほど結: First, a provisional agreement was just signed authorizing combat actions in this region.
m920090.また、サイクロプスはこちらの姿を認識したものの、\n進行方向を変えず、そのまま進: Also, the cyclopes saw us but didn't change course—they're just marching on. If the kingdom's forces keep moving, they'll run into the enemy herd!
m920090.みんな……そっか……ううん、そうだよね。\nここで逃げ出しちゃったら、街の皆が…:
Everyone… right… no, that's it.
If we run now, the townsfolk…
m920090.みんな、天使像は巨人達にも劣らない\n強力な攻撃力を持っている。気を付けて。: Everyone, Angelic Statues pack a punch that rivals the giants. Stay on guard.
m920090.もしあの規模での襲撃が今後も続いたら、\n流石に厳しいかも…………うん？\n何だ: If attacks of that scale keep coming, it'll get really tough… huh? It sounds like there's a lot of noise outside…
m920090.もしそうなら……なんとかしなきゃ。\n奴ら、剣を破壊して全ての巨人族の\n封印を: If that's the case… we have to do something. They're planning to destroy the sword and break every giant's seal… I think.
m920090.もしよろしければ、その伝承について\n聞かせて貰ってもよろしいでしょうか？: If it's alright, could you tell us about that legend?
m920090.や、やっぱり怒ってるよね……\nで、でもとーちゃんから人間は敵だって\n聞いてる: Y-yeah, you're still mad… But Dad told me humans are enemies… Wh-what should I do…?
m920090.やった！ やりましたよ！\nギガース達を倒しましたよ、エレーヌさん！: We did it! We beat the Gigars, Elene!
m920090.やはり……戦うしかないようですね！: So… it looks like we have no choice but to fight!
m920090.よろしくお願いします。\n私達も微力ではありますが、\n防衛に協力させて頂きます: Thank you. We'll do what we can to help with the defense.
m920090.イロハ殿、それに王国の方々も！\nご尽力感謝致します！: Lady Iroha, and the kingdom's folk as well! Thank you for your efforts!
m920090.エレーヌさん、決して一人ではありません！\nその剣の力と私達の力、皆で協力し\n: Elene, you're not alone! With the sword's power and ours combined, let's all work together and protect this place!
m920090.エレーヌさん。私達の力で守り切れるかは\n判りません……ですが、\nやれるだけの: Elene… We don't know if we can hold them with our strength… but we'll do everything we can!
m920090.シノさん……はい、\nどうかよろしくお願いします。: Shino-san… yes, please take care of it.
m920090.ニエルさん、ありがとうございます。\n王子、適切なご指示をお願いします。\nどう: Thank you, Niel. Prince, please give us proper orders. Stay safe.
m920090.モーティマさん、まずは\n戦闘の準備をお願いします。: Mortimer, please start preparing for battle first.
m920090.人間達よ、そこを退きなさい。\n我らが神に、その剣を献上するのです。: Humans, step aside. We will present that sword to our god.
m920090.今ので魔物達は全て討伐できたようです。: It looks like we've cleared all the monsters now.
m920090.何とか、敵は退ける事が出来たようですね……。: It seems we managed to push the enemy back somehow…
m920090.何故妖怪達が都を襲撃など……いや、\n今は考え事をしている場合ではないか。: Why would the youkai attack the capital... No, now's not the time to ponder.
m920090.保管してあった剣、持って来た。\n天使も、巨人もこの剣を恐れてた……。\nこれが: I brought the sealed sword we kept. Both angels and giants feared this blade… With this, surely….
m920090.先ほどの巨人、ギガースが再び街へ\n接近を試みているとの連絡がありました。\nま: We just got word that the giant Gigaars are trying to approach the town again, and several other Gigaars have been spotted.
m920090.先遣の部隊だけでは敵を\n抑えきれず、\n敵は目前に迫っているとの事。: The forward units can't hold them back, and the enemy is closing in.
m920090.剣を奪われる訳には参りません。\n王子、迎撃の準備をお願いします！: We won't let them take the sword. Prince, prepare to intercept!
m920090.助けられるだけじゃなくて、助ける側として。\n今度は私達もちゃんと力を貸すように: Not just being helped, but as those who help. This time we'll properly lend our strength as well.
m920090.千年戦争の折、剣の力で封じられてしまったが……\n……我らが目覚めたと言う事は、: During the Millennium War we were sealed by the Sword's power… but our awakening means the Sword's seal is weakening. This is a perfect chance—let's raze this city along with everything else.
m920090.協定はつい先ほど結ばれたばかりですが、\n王子、いかがいたしましょうか？: The agreement was only just made, Prince—what shall we do?
m920090.喋らないでください！\n今、治療しますので！！: Please don't speak! I'll heal you now!!
m920090.報告ではこの辺りみたいだけど。\n……上空から見回してみた限りじゃ、\n巨人の姿: The report says it's around here, but from what I saw from the sky, I didn't spot any giants.
m920090.多分、天使像を呼び出す\n準備をしていたんじゃないかな。: He was probably preparing to summon the Angelic Statues.
m920090.天使が欲するとは、やはりこの剣には、\n何らかの力があるのでしょうか……。: If the Angel wants it, there must be some power in it…
m920090.巨人達がいなくなってからは、大きな砦も\n必要なくなったから、都市を守る部分だけ: Since the giants vanished, massive forts became unnecessary; only the defenses protecting the city remained, and the rest of the walls were taken down.
m920090.巨人達に対する切り札になるかもと\n思いましたが……残念ですね。: I thought it might become a trump card against the giants… What a disappointment.
m920090.強力な雷を操る妖怪の娘だヨ！\n雷に打たれて\n焼き焦げてしまうといいネェ！: She's a yokai girl who commands powerful lightning! I hope she gets struck and burned to a crisp!
m920090.彼女を一人で戦わせてしまう訳には参りませんね。\n……怪我をしている者には一旦後:
We can't just leave her to fight alone.
…Those who are wounded should fall back for now; those who can fight, continue defending. Please issue the orders!
m920090.思ったより進軍が早かったようですね……。\nエレーヌさん、あちらだけでなく\n複: Their advance is faster than we expected… Elene, it looks like enemies are coming not just from that side but from multiple directions.
m920090.急ぎ街の方々に、\n敵が迫っていることを伝えましょう！: We should hurry and tell the townsfolk the enemy's coming!
m920090.感謝されるにはまだ早いかと。\n妖の群れはすぐそこに\n迫ってきてるでござる！: It's still too early for thanks. The monster horde is right on the brink!
m920090.我々がこの国の防衛に対して協力することも、\nひとまず問題ないかと思います。\n: I think it's fine for us to cooperate in defending this country—for now, at least. That's good news.
m920090.抵抗をやめてしまえば、楽に滅ぼしてあげますよ。\n……まぁ、貴方達には幾ら説いて: If you stop resisting, I'll destroy you with ease… Though, trying to reason with you is pointless. Come, let me deliver judgment upon these foolish humans.
m920090.敵の敵は味方……とは\nなってくれそうにはないですね。: “The enemy of my enemy is my friend”… doesn't seem to apply here.
m920090.敵の狙いは未だ不明……とは言え、\n都市の方々に魔物が近づいている事は\n伝えた: The enemy's intentions are still unknown… but we should probably warn the city that monsters are approaching.
m920090.普段は小型の魔物程度の報告しか\nない地域……それだけ魔物達の動きが\n活性化し: Usually we only get reports of small monsters here… So perhaps the monsters are becoming more active.
m920090.来なさい、荘厳なる神のしもべ達よ。: Come forth, majestic servants of the gods.
m920090.案内ご苦労様です。\n引き続き周囲の警戒に\n当たって貰えればと思います。: Thanks for the guidance. I hope you'll continue to keep watch around us.
m920090.気が付いたか。もしやとは思ったが、\nお前、雷神様の娘のラミィであろう。: So you've realized. I suspected it, but you must be Ramii, the Thunder God's daughter.
m920090.無事に魔物達は退けたようですね。\nお疲れ様で――: It seems we've safely repelled the monsters. Good work—
m920090.無駄だ、我らが長の力は何者をも恐れぬ\n勇猛なる闘志。剣の力に頼ろう等と弱き意志: It's useless. The power of our chief knows no fear, a brave fighting spirit. Relying on the sword's power is a weak will—our chief's power won't answer that!
m920090.王国……聞いた事はあるけど……。\nそれで、どうかしたの？\nこの国に何か用事…: The kingdom… I've heard of it, but… So, what brings you here? Any business in our country?
m920090.王子、今は彼女を信じ\nこの場を守り抜きましょう！: Prince, now is the time to trust her and hold this ground!
m920090.王子、剣の力がギガースに効いている様です！: Prince, the sword's power seems to be affecting the Gigars!
m920090.王子、奴らの強力な攻撃にはくれぐれもご注意を。\n近づかれる前に、しっかりと敵の: Prince, be especially careful of their powerful attacks. It might be best to whittle down their health before they get close.
m920090.王子、巨人達がなだれ込んできます！\n確かに危機的な状況です。撤退という事も\n:
Prince, the giants are barreling toward us!
It's certainly a dire situation. Retreat might be an option, but… what shall we do?
m920090.王子、此度の激戦お疲れ様でした。\n今は戻りゆっくりとお休みになってください。\: Prince, thank you for the fierce battle. Please take a good rest now.
m920090.王子、決して気が抜けない戦いです。\n全力で迎え撃ちましょう！: Prince, this battle won't let us drop our guard. Let's meet them with everything we've got!
m920090.王子達の前に現れた巨人……本当に\nギガースなら、きっと剣の力が弱まってる。: The giants that appeared before you, Prince… if they're truly Gigaars, then surely…
m920090.申し遅れました、私達は王国の者です。\n私は政務官のアンナ、\nこちらは王子にな: Sorry for the delay—we're from the kingdom. I'm Anna, the minister, and this is the Prince.
m920090.皆さんご無事で何よりです。\n……それにしても、ケラウノス様はこの場で\n一体何: I'm just glad everyone's alright. …But what on earth was Keraunos doing here?
m920090.知らない……そういう伝承があるだけ。\n使われた事なんて、一度もない。: I don't know… It's just a legend. It's never actually been used.
m920090.神の意思に逆らうとは、愚かな人間達です。\n退かぬというなら仕方ありません。\n: Defying the will of the gods makes you foolish humans. If you won't retreat, then so be it. You'll learn the god's judgment with your own bodies.
m920090.私は、この国を守る戦士なんだ……。\n私は、この国に心臓を捧げたんだ……！\n剣: I'm a warrior protecting this country… I've given my heart to this land…! Even without the sword's power…!!
m920090.粗暴な巨人族の連中が復活したようなので、\n物質界に降りてみましたが……巨人族よ: The brutish giants seem to have revived, so I descended to the material realm… but before dealing with them, let's thin your forces first.
m920090.色々試したって聞いてる。\n煮たり、焼いたり、食べ……てはないけど。\nでも、何: I've heard you tried everything—boiling, roasting… not eating, of course—but nothing worked.
m920090.行ったか……雷神様がこの地で\nやった所業については存じています。ですが、\n彼: She's gone… I know of the deeds the Thunder God committed here. But I've heard she didn't take part in the battle.
m920090.街の城壁、ちょっとやそっとじゃ壊れないけど\n……でも、きっと昔程頑丈でもない。: The city walls aren't something you can just tear down… but they're probably not as solid as they used to be. Some sections are still under repair.
m920090.連中、随分と気合が入ってやがんな。: Those guys are really fired up.
m920090.魔物への対応は自国の戦力で賄えるので、\n我々の手助けは必要ないと\nあまり交流: They've been handling monsters with their own forces, so we haven't had much contact—they didn't need our help…

m920143.――あれ？ ちょっと待ってください。\n何かがこちらへ向かってきているような……:
――Wait a moment.
Something is heading our way…
m920143.――い、いや待てアンナ！\n向こうから突撃してくるのは――デシウスじゃないか！？:
――N-no, wait, Anna!
The ones charging toward us are――Decius?!
m920143.――おぉ、おぉ、なんと素晴らしきことか……！\n麗しきあの御方の為に戦えるとは！: ――Oh, oh, how wonderful……! To be able to fight for that beautiful one!
m920143.――くふふ、いまさら気付いても遅いわ。\n同族の命を何よりも重んずる王国のあり方:
――Kufufu. It's too late to notice now.
In a kingdom that values the lives of its own above all else,
you wouldn't be able to flee, leaving the immobilized behind.
m920143.――くふふ、良い見世物であった。\n雄とは実に容易く支配されるものよなぁ。:
――Heh heh, what a fine spectacle.
Males are so easy to dominate, aren't they?
m920143.――こちらも片付いたようですね。\nフェロモンのサンプルは、\nあなたに渡せば良:
――It looks like we're done on this side.
Should I hand the pheromone samples over to you?
m920143.――この先は、\n確かオークさんの集落でしたよね。:
――The place ahead,
is that the orc settlement?
m920143.――そして、王子……殿下……？\nいや、王子と呼ぶ不敬を許してはもらえまいか。\:
――And, Prince…… Your Highness……?
No, please forgive my impudence in calling you "Prince."
It just feels more familiar to me.
m920143.――た、大変だ！！\n村の男達が突然暴れだしたぞ！！:
――H-help!!
The men in the village have suddenly gone wild!!
m920143.――なるほど、村人が暴れだしたのは、\n魔界アリの女王が放つフェロモンのせいだっ:
――I see. So the villagers' rampage
was caused by the pheromones of the Demon World Ant Queen.
m920143.――はぁ……はぁ……っ。\nどこまでもしつこい連中ですね……！:
――Haa…… haa……
These are such persistent opponents……!
m920143.――アンデッドの軍勢、沈黙しました！: The undead army has fallen silent!
m920143.――デシウスさんや、\n今日も畑仕事に精が出ますなぁ！:
――Mr. Decius,
the farm work feels so much easier today!
m920143.――フェロモンを克服するための、\n対抗ポーションも強化できるってわけだ！:
――we can strengthen the counter-potions
needed to overcome the pheromones!
m920143.――レティシアよ、よくぞ王子と合流した。\n開拓村を、我らが同胞達を、必ず救って:
――Leticia, you did well to reunite with the Prince.
Please save the pioneer village and our kin……!!
m920143.――ヴァンパイアがこんな攻勢を\n仕掛けてくるなんて、いったいどうなってんですか:
――For the Vampires to launch an offensive like this……
what on earth is going on?!
m920143.――ヴァンパイアスフィンクスの\n実地試験のつもりだったのだが、\n王子達と遭遇:
I intended to conduct a field test on the Vampire Sphinx,
but running into you princes was a stroke of luck.
m920143.――世界樹の魔物化は順調な様子ですね。\n貴重な『神の楔』を\n打ち込んだ甲斐が:
――The World Tree's transformation into a monster is proceeding smoothly.
It was worth the effort of driving in that precious "Wedge of the Gods."
m920143.――以上で、魔界アリに関する報告は終わりです。\n姿を消した女王アリは行方が知れ:
――That concludes my report on the Demon Ants.
The Queen Ant has vanished without a trace, but…….
m920143.――可憐な女の子が！\n助けてくまさんと空に叫ぶなら！！:
――A lovely girl in distress!
If you call out to the bear and the sky for help, then――!!
m920143.――大天使長、報告です。\n王子率いる部隊がこちらへ進軍しています。\n妨害いた:
――Archangel, a report.
The unit led by the Prince is advancing toward us.
Shall we intercept them?
m920143.――妾のフェロモンは甘かろう？\nくふ、くふふふ……精強なオークも形無しよなぁ。:
――Was my pheromone sweet enough?
Kuf, kufufufu... Even the strongest orcs are rendered useless.
m920143.――改めて、助けていただき\n本当にありがとうございました。: ――Once again, thank you so much for your help.
m920143.――敵襲！ 敵襲！\n敵はフェロモンで男を操ってくるぞ！:
――Enemy attack! Enemy attack!
They're using pheromones to control the men!
m920143.――王子、村の男性たちが暴れだしたと\n報告があったのはこの辺りです。: ――Prince, the reports of the villagers losing their minds came from around here.
m920143.――王子、潜入してきたが街の中は酷い有様だった。\nどうやら守備兵は全員操られて:
――Prince, I've infiltrated the town, and the situation is dire.
It seems every guard has been put under control.
m920143.――開拓村に到着しましたが、随分と静かですね。: We've arrived at the frontier village, but it's far too quiet.
m920143.――魔界アリ、討伐完了です。\nお疲れさまでした、皆さん。:
――Demon Ant, eradication complete.
Good work, everyone.
m920143.…………もしかして。\n村の内部へ私たちを招き入れるのも、\n女王アリの戦術だと:
……Wait a moment.
He said that inviting us inside the village
was part of the Queen Ant's strategy, didn't he?
m920143.…………？\n待つですレティシア。誰もいない村で、\n一人でふらふらしてるなんて:
…………?
Wait, Leticia. It's strange for someone to be wandering around alone
in an empty village.
m920143.……うむ。\n望まぬ戦いを強いられることほど、\n我々の誇りを傷つけるものもない:
...Mm.
There is nothing that wounds our pride more
than being forced into a battle we do not desire...
m920143.……くっ、か、身体が熱い。\nジェイク、王子、意識を強く持ってください……！:
……Grrr, my body is burning up.
Jake, Prince, stay conscious…!
m920143.……そうか、武人でありながら、\n魔界アリのフェロモン如きに操られるとは……。:
...I see. To be controlled by the pheromones of the Demon Ants,
despite being warriors...
m920143.……そっか。\n今は、あの村にいるの？:
……I see.
Are you staying in that village now?
m920143.……それでは、開拓村の救援に\n手を貸していただけるのですか？: ……So, you will lend a hand in rescuing the Frontier Village?
m920143.……なるほど、虫らしい姑息な考えです。\nですが、女王の首を落とせば済む話でしょ:
……I see. A cunning, insect-like trick.
But if we cut off the Queen's head, it should be over.
m920143.……ふざけないでください。\n虫の魔物はすべて、私がこの世界から抹殺します。:
……Don't be ridiculous.
I will exterminate every insect monster from this world.
m920143.……ふふ、お前にしては、上手い冗談だ。\nだが、そうだな。腕利き農夫だったのだろ:
……Heh. Not a bad joke, for you.
But I suppose so. You were probably a skilled farmer, after all.
m920143.……オークが、人を襲ったことを謝るのですか。: ...The orc is apologizing for attacking people?
m920143.……オークの武人よ、\n私たちはこの先をまっすぐ抜ける予定です。:
...Orc warrior,
we intend to push straight through this area.
m920143.……オークの集落とも交流があるのですか？: ...We have exchanges with the orc settlement as well?
m920143.……ガオレオン様は、\n声は大きいのに言葉が足らないんです。\nすみませんレティ:
……My Lord Gaoleon has a loud voice,
but he doesn't always say what he means.
I'm sorry, Leticia-san……
m920143.……ソーマ、下がれ。\nこいつ、様子がおかしいぞ。:
...Soma, step back.
This one is acting strangely.
m920143.……フェロモンに操られず、\n王国への伝令に向かわせるために、ですか？:
……To ensure I wouldn't be controlled by the pheromones,
so I could send word to the Kingdom, is that it?
m920143.……兵を麻痺させる、ですか？ まさかそれは――: ……Paralyzing the soldiers, you say? Could it be――
m920143.……女王アリ様に、栄光あれ！\n我らの武技は！ 全て女王アリ様のために！:
...Glory to the Queen Ant!
Our martial skills! All for the Queen Ant!
m920143.……王子、そろそろ先を急ぎましょう。\nそれではデシウス、\n村の皆さんによろし:
……Prince, we should press on.
Now then, Decius, please give our regards to the villagers.
m920143.……確かに、確かにガオレオンの開拓村では、\n人間と魔物が共存しているようにも思:
……Yes, I suppose it did look like humans and monsters
were coexisting in Gaoleon's frontier village.
m920143.……神獣スフィンクスの欠片から、\nヴァンパイアを生み出したってことですか？:
……Are you saying they used the Sphinx's fragment
to create the Vampires?
m920143.『闇夜』をもたらす力といい、\n黒幕はヴァンパイア公爵に間違いないだろうな。:
Given the power that brings the "Dark Night,"
there's no doubt the mastermind is the Vampire Duke.
m920143.あ、あの、少しくらい王子を休ませて――っと、\nあらら、行ってしまいました……。:
A-Actually, we should let the Prince rest a little――
Oh dear, she's already gone…
Well then, let us return to our investigation.
m920143.あぁ……もう駄目だ……意識が……っ。: Ah… I can't… my consciousness is…
m920143.あっ、最後にひとつだけ良い？\nデシウス、星の声は、聞こえる？:
Ah, just one last thing, okay?
Decius, can you hear the voice of the stars?
m920143.あっ！ そうです。クソ獣人――ではなくて、\n開拓村の彼が言っていました。\nも:
Oh! That's right. Not the "damn beastman," but
the man from the frontier village said this:
if things go wrong, rely on the "Star of the New Era."
m920143.あなたは……！\n良かった、女王アリの\nフェロモンから逃れていたんですね！:
You…!
Thank goodness, you were escaping the Queen Ant's
pheromones!
m920143.あのクソ獣人……！\n事件が終わったら覚えてなさい……ッ！！:
That damn beastman…!
I won't forget this when the dust settles…!
m920143.ありがとうございます、王子殿、皆さん……！\n開拓村の皆に代わってお礼を……！: Thank you, Prince, and everyone……! Please accept my thanks on behalf of everyone in the Frontier Village……!
m920143.いいえ、直接手を下すまでもないでしょう。\n我々には為すべきことが数多くあるので:
No, there is no need for us to act directly.
We have much else to attend to.
m920143.いえいえ、ご無事で何よりです。\nそれでは私は、操られていた方々の\n傷の治療に:
Please, you're safe, and that's what matters.
I'll go treat the wounds of those who were under control.
m920143.いえいえ、我らも記憶喪失のままですので。\nそれより畑の手入れを済ませてしまいま:
No, sir, we are all still suffering from amnesia.
Besides, let's finish up the field maintenance.
We're gathering wild greens in the forest this afternoon!
m920143.いったいどういう――お、王子殿っ！？\nどうしたのですか！？:
What on earth is— Oh, Your Highness!?
What's wrong!?
m920143.いや、このフェロモンの効力、\n以前よりも強力なものになっています。\nこのまま:
No, the potency of these pheromones
is stronger than before.
At this rate, every soldier in this town will――
m920143.いやいや、これも記憶を失った我輩を、\n受け入れてくれた村の皆への恩返しなのだ。:
Oh, please, this is merely a way to repay the village
for accepting me after I lost my memory.
Please don't hesitate to ask for our help!
m920143.いやいや、世界樹がしゃべるわけ――\nって、あれ？ 本当に何か音が聞こえるような:
Oh, come now, the World Tree doesn't talk――
Wait, is that a sound? I can actually hear something.
Could this be…… the Griffins and Spider monsters!?
m920143.うぅぅ……女王さま……。\n女王さまのために、戦わねば……！:
Ugh… Queen…
I have to fight… for Her Majesty…!
m920143.うっ……それは謝りません。\n毎朝夜明け前に雄叫びをあげるものだから、\n本当に:
Ugh……. I won't apologize for that.
You roar before dawn every single morning,
and it was truly a nuisance!
m920143.うむ、そうだな！\nふふふ、村の皆の喜ぶ顔が目に浮かぶようだ！:
Yes, that's right!
Heh heh, I can already picture the village's joyful faces!
m920143.うむ、任された。\nそれでは達者でな、王国軍の皆よ。:
Aye, it is entrusted to me.
Then take care, everyone of the Royal Army.
m920143.うむ、皆働き者で、心の温かな良い村だ。\n畑仕事も随分と上達したが、\nさてはか:
Yes. Everyone is hardworking, and it's a village with a warm heart.
I've gotten quite good at farm work, too.
So, was I a skilled farmer in my past life?
m920143.うむッ！ 次に姿を現した時には、\n我が滅多打ちにしてやろうともッ！！:
Hmph! The next time she shows her face,
I shall beat her to a pulp!!
m920143.うわーん！ アンナさんがベアッカの台詞とった～！\nこうなったら戦闘でカッコイイ:
Waaah! Anna stole Bearca's lines~!
Well, in that case, I'll have to show off my cool moves in battle!
m920143.うんうん、これでよーし♪\nさぁレーレンちゃん先生、急いで対抗ポーション作るよー:
Mm-hm, that should do it♪
Alright, Lehren-chan-sensei, hurry up and make the counter-potion!
m920143.えぇ、この恩は必ず、形にして返しますね。:
Yes, I will surely repay this kindness
in a tangible way.
