m920143.えぇ、そのガオレオンの村です。\n対魔物を専門にしている傭兵である私が、\n元魔: Yes, it's Gaoreon's village. It's a strange feeling for a mercenary specializing in monster hunting to be employed by a former high-ranking officer of the Demon King's army, but……
m920143.えぇ。あとは開拓村に向かうだけ――: Yes. All that's left is to head to the pioneer village—
m920143.えぇ。さぁこれを飲みなさい。\n戦うことは出来ないでしょうが、\nこれで操られる:
Yes. Here, drink this.
You won't be able to fight, but
this should free you from the control.
m920143.えぇ。魔物はすべて滅ぼすべきとは思っていますが、\n虫の魔物は特に、絶対に赦すわ:
Yes. While I believe all monsters should be destroyed,
insect-type monsters in particular are ones I can never forgive.
m920143.えぇい、つまらぬ！ 実に不快よ！\n大人しく妾の下僕となっていれば良いものを！:
Tsk, how tedious! Most unpleasant!
You would do well to submit and become my servant!
m920143.えぇい黙れっ！！\n我が下僕の分際でいつまで喋っておるか！！:
Silence, you insolent one!!
How long will you keep talking, mere servant that you are!!
m920143.えっ、え、あの、これは……？: E-eh? I-I mean, what is this...?
m920143.えーっと、無理やり引き抜いたら\nもっと大変なことになるってこと？:
So, you're saying that if we forcibly pull it out,
things would get even worse?
m920143.おう！ やってやろうぜニコルちゃん先生！\n待ってろよ王子、すぐに調合してやるか:
You got it! Let's do this, Nicole-chan-sensei!
Hold on, Prince. I'll have it mixed up in no time♪
m920143.おぉ……恩に着る……。\n王子よ、そしていと強き女戦士よ……。\nどうか仲間達を:
Oh... I owe you one...
Prince, and you, mighty warrior woman...
Please save my comrades...!
m920143.おぉ、ありがたい！\nそれでは王子と呼ばせてもらおう！:
Oh, thank you!
Then I shall call you "Prince"!
m920143.おぉ、やはりそうか！\nではかつての我輩に恥じぬよう、\n気合をいれて畑の世話を:
Oh, so that's how it is!
Then I must put in my best effort to tend the fields,
so as not to disgrace my former self!
m920143.おぉ、村長殿！\n畑も野菜も気合十分、今年はきっと豊作だぞ！:
Oh, Village Chief!
The fields and the vegetables are full of vigor. This year will surely be a bumper crop!
m920143.おのれ、謎の軍隊め！\n我輩が真相を問い詰めてくれよう！\n暗黒騎士団、抜剣！:
You wretched, mysterious army!
I shall demand the truth from you!
Dark Knights, draw your swords!
Prepare to charge……!!
m920143.きっと、王子とはいつか、\nどこかで会ったことがあるのだろう。\nかつての我輩に:
I'm sure I must have met you once, Prince,
somewhere along the way.
In place of my former self, I shall pray for your long and prosperous fortune.
m920143.くぅぅ、フェロモンの濃度が上がっていく！？\nこれじゃ対抗ポーションの調合も間に:
Kuuu, the pheromone concentration is rising!?
I won't be able to mix the counter-agent in time!?
m920143.くくくっ……何だ、鋭いじゃないか。\nだがもう手遅れだ！ わざわざ女王アリ様の\:
Kukuku… Well, well, sharp eyes.
But it's too late for you! I've lured you right to the heart of
the Queen Ant's nest!
m920143.くくっ、そう簡単に行くかな……？\n我ら、女王アリ様のために！！:
Kukuku, do you think it's that simple…?
We, for the Queen Ant!
m920143.くっ……だが、まだ身体が動かない……。\nこの先には……他の仲間たちが……いると:
Ugh... But my body still won't move...
And my comrades... are out there...
m920143.くっ……まだ意識を保っているとは。\n妾しか見えぬようにしてくれる……ッ！！:
Tch…… So you still retain your consciousness.
I will make sure you see nothing but me……!!
m920143.くっ……何だこのフェロモンの濃度は！？\n対抗ポーションの効果が無かったら\n一:
Ugh... What is with the concentration of this pheromone?!
If the counter-potion hadn't worked,
I would have lost consciousness in an instant!
m920143.くっ、我々には以前の戦いでできた\nフェロモンへの耐性があるはず！\n皆、気を強:
Damn it, we should have developed a resistance
to pheromones from our previous battles!
Everyone, hold your nerve…!
m920143.くふふ、こやつは実に素直な猫であるぞ？\nお前を逃がすために、フェロモンにさらさ:
Kufufu. That one is a remarkably honest cat, isn't she?
It was quite amusing to see you charge at me alone,
enduring my pheromones just to let her escape.
m920143.くふふふっ！ 威勢のよい小娘よ！\nさぁ妾のガオレオンよ、余興はこれくらいにして:
Kufufufu! What spirited words from a little girl!
Now then, my Gaoleon, let's call it a day.
Take her to my nest.
m920143.くまさんアーマー出力全開！\nいま華麗に！ ベアッカ出撃ー！！:
Bearca Armor output at maximum!
Now, let's make a grand entrance!
Bearca, deploy!
m920143.ぐ……ッ、ぐわぁぁぁぁッ！！\n女王アリ様……ッ、万歳……ッ！！\nい、いざ、女:
Grr……! Grrrrr!!
Queen Ant……! Long live……!
N-now, to the Queen Ant's nest of love……!
m920143.ぐぉぉ……ッ！！\nレティシアよ、お前は見事、使命を成し遂げた……ッ！:
Grrr……!!
Leticia, you have truly accomplished your mission……!!
m920143.ぐっ……うおぉぉぉっ！\n戦士の魂を汚すとは……卑怯な……！！:
Ugh... Uoooh!
To defile the soul of a warrior... How cowardly...!!
m920143.ぐっ……すま、ない……王子、よ……。\nこんな無様な姿を……見られる、とは……。:
Ugh... I'm sorry... Prince...
To be seen... in such a disgraceful state...
m920143.けれど、敵の戦力は想定以上でした。\n大規模な魔物の群れの襲撃に加えて、\n巨大: However, the enemy's strength exceeded our expectations. In addition to a large-scale monster swarm attack, the village's men were also being controlled by a giant Demon Realm ant……
m920143.こちらには負傷者と、\nフェロモンによって動けない殿方たち。\nもしや女王アリは:
We have the wounded here,
and the men who can't move because of the pheromones.
Could it be that the Queen Ant was counting on this……?
m920143.このフェロモンの中では男性は戦えません……。\nレティシアさん、手分けをして対処:
Men can't fight under the influence of these pheromones…
Leticia, let's split up and handle this.
m920143.この前の火災と『神の楔』のせいで、\n世界樹の枝もめちゃくちゃになっちゃったから:
Between that fire and the "Wedge of the Gods,"
the World Tree's branches have been completely wrecked.
With it all so scorched, the World Tree must be in pain……
m920143.こやつから聞いたぞ？\n妾の襲撃に抗するために雇われた傭兵らしいではないか。\n:
I heard from that one?
You were hired as a mercenary to repel my assault.
And yet, you were saved and fled. How delightful.
m920143.これだけ大規模に人間を操るとは……。\nやはり、女王アリは許しがたい存在ですね…:
To control humans on such a large scale…
The Queen Ant is truly an unforgivable existence…
m920143.これで開拓村の皆は救出できましたが……。\n女王アリとガオレオン様はどこにいるの:
That's everyone in the frontier village saved, but….
Where are the Queen Ant and Gaorion now?
m920143.こんなところで寄り道をする暇はないのに、\n私はもっと多くの魔物を滅ぼさないとい:
I don't have time to take detours like this…
I need to be out there, culling more monsters!
m920143.さて、次なる一手を考えねばな。\nより強大なる戦力を備えたのちに、\n目障りな王:
Well, I suppose I need to plan my next move.
Once I've built up a stronger force,
I'll crush that annoying Prince……
m920143.しかし、何か大切なことを\n忘れているような気がするのだがなぁ……。\nお前、何:
However, I have a feeling I've forgotten something important…….
Have you remembered anything, perhaps?
m920143.しかし我々は以前の事件で\nフェロモンの誘惑は克服している。\n助けを求める先と: However, we have overcome the temptation of pheromones since that previous incident. Seeking the Kingdom's help was the right call.
m920143.しばらく前のことですが、ピラミッドが\n大規模なヴァンパイアの軍勢に\n破壊され:
It was a while ago, but I heard
that a pyramid was destroyed by a large-scale Vampire army.
m920143.じょ、女王アリの姿が変わっていきます！\n皆さん、気をつけてください！！:
Th-the Queen Ant's form is changing!
Everyone, be careful!!
m920143.すっかり操られてるし、話も通じないし、\nでもそろそろ何とかしないといけないし…:
They're completely under control, and I can't reason with them, but I can't just keep doing nothing forever……
Honestly, this isn't worth even double the reward……!
m920143.ぜぇ……はぁ……何故謝るのだ、レティシアよ。\n我のことをクソ獣人と罵ったことか:
Wheeze……. Haah……. Why apologize, Leticia?
For calling me a filthy beast-man?
m920143.そ、そうか……俺達が近付くのを待ってから、\nフェロモンを解放しやがったな……！:
S-So that's it… They waited until we got close,
then released the pheromones…!?
m920143.そう、ですね……。\n世界樹の魔物化なんて、絶対に許すわけにはいきません。:
Y-Yes, that's right……
We absolutely cannot allow the World Tree to be turned into a monster.
m920143.そういえば、レティシアは\n虫の魔物に個人的な恨みがあるって言ってたっけか。:
Come to think of it, Leticia,
you once mentioned having a personal grudge against insect-type monsters.
m920143.そうですね、何から話せば良いのか……。\nちょっと私もまだ、よく理解できていなく:
I see… I'm not sure where to start…
I'm still a bit confused about the whole situation myself…
m920143.そうね、確かに多数の足音が聞こえるわ。\nあれは――大変、女の子が追われているみ:
Yes, I can hear a lot of footsteps.
Oh no… it looks like a girl is being chased!
m920143.そこには神獣スフィンクスの内の一体の、\n欠片が埋葬されていると、\n小さい頃に:
I was told in a story when I was young
that a fragment of one of the Divine Beasts, the Sphinx,
was buried there……
m920143.そこを探るのも、私達の仕事よね。\nさぁフーリ、情報収集に出かけましょ。:
Figuring that out is our job.
Come on, Khuri, let's go gather some intel.
m920143.そのとーりです♪\nほら、世界樹もそうだそうだーって言ってますよ？:
Exactly right♪
Look, the World Tree is saying so too, isn't it?
m920143.その可能性も模索はしたんですけどね……。\n魔力の乱れを読み取ってみると、\n『:
We did consider that possibility…
However, reading the fluctuations in magical energy,
it appears the "Wedge" has already infiltrated the entire World Tree.
m920143.その大声で説明もちゃんとしてほしいです……。\nレティシアさんの実力を認めたから:
Please explain yourself properly, even if you have to shout……
You should just admit that you trusted me with this dangerous mission
because you recognized my abilities……?
m920143.それこそ枯れてしまうかもしれませんね。\n『神の楔』の情報を得るためにも、\n天:
The World Tree might wither and die.
To obtain information on the "Wedge of the Gods,"
it would be best if we could travel to the Celestial Realm.
m920143.それに、次は傭兵ではなく、\n軍人に仕官しようと思っているので……。:
Besides, next I'm thinking of enlisting
as a soldier, rather than working as a mercenary…….
m920143.それに最前線から上がってきた報告だと、\n不可視の怪物が兵を軒並み麻痺させてるら:
Besides, reports from the front line say
invisible monsters are paralyzing the soldiers en masse.
How are we supposed to fight something we can't even see?
m920143.それはフェロモンに抵抗できるように\nなってから言ってください。まったく……！: Please say that after you've learned to resist the pheromones. Honestly……!
m920143.そんな、対抗ポーションが効いてないなんて！？\n女王アリはさらに進化したってこと:
What? The antidote isn't working!?
Does that mean the Queen Ant has evolved further!?
m920143.ですから、そういう褒め言葉は\n他人に自慢するのではなく、\nちゃんと本人に言っ:
So, instead of bragging about such praise
to other people,
please say it to her directly……?
m920143.でもこれだけ操られた人がいるなら、\nサンプルもたっぷり採取できそうだね。\nそ:
But with this many people under control,
we should be able to collect plenty of samples.
And once we have enough samples――
m920143.となれば、貴殿の仲間がいるという場所も、\nその道中ですから……ついでに……。:
Which means the place where your comrades are
lies along our path... so we may as well...
m920143.ともかく、これでこの森のオークさんたちは、\n無事にフェロモンの影響から解放でき:
In any case, the Orcs in this forest have been
safely freed from the pheromone's influence!
m920143.ともかく、これで開拓村での\n私の仕事も終了しました。\n晴れて自由の身というわ:
In any case, my work at the frontier village
is now complete.
I'm officially a free woman again.
m920143.どうやらここのオーク達は、\n進化した女王アリのフェロモンを\nより高濃度で与え:
It seems the Orcs here have been
dosed with an even higher concentration
of the evolved Queen Ant's pheromone...
m920143.どうやらグリフィンも蜘蛛の魔物も、\n『神の楔』の力に影響されているようですね…:
It seems both the Griffins and the Spider monsters
are being influenced by the power of the "Wedge of the Gods"…
m920143.なっ……まだ妾のフェロモンに抗うか！？\nオスであれば何者も逆らえぬこの力に！！:
Wha……. You still resist my pheromones!?
Against this power that no male can defy!!
m920143.なるほど、つまりは兵士の皆さんを無力化し、\nフェロモンのサンプルを回収すれば良:
I see. So we just need to neutralize the soldiers
and retrieve the pheromone samples, then?
m920143.は、はいっ！\n痕跡が消える前に調査ですね！:
Y-Yes, ma'am!
We need to investigate before the evidence disappears!
m920143.はぁ……はぁ……。\n助かりました……ありがとうございます……。\nそれに傷の治:
Haa… haa…
Thank you for saving me…
And for tending to my wounds, too…
m920143.ふぅ、やっと追いつきましたー！\nふたりとも暗い顔してちゃだめですよー？\n今日:
Phew, I finally caught up!
You two mustn't look so gloomy~?
We came here today to investigate how to save the World Tree♪
m920143.ふふ、戦闘好きのあいつらのことだ、\nここを通りたくば我らと腕試しをせよ、\nな:
Fufu. Given that they love a good fight,
they'll probably say something like, "If you want to pass through, prove your strength against us."
That would be quite a predicament in our current situation.
m920143.ふふっ、ありがとうございます王子殿。\n――今回のことで、私は己の未熟さを知りま:
Heh, thank you, Your Highness.
――This incident has shown me how inexperienced I am.
I still need to become much stronger.
m920143.ふふん、ある時は鋼の都の警備部隊、\nある時はくまさんアーマーの担い手、\nしか:
Fufu, at times I am a guard of the City of Steel,
at other times the bearer of the Bearca Armor,
and yet my true identity is――
m920143.ふんふん。レティシアちゃんとしては、\nちょっと納得がいかないって感じなのかな？:
Mm-hm. So, Leticia-chan,
you're still a little unconvinced, I take it?
m920143.まさか本当に、ヴァンパイア化した\nスフィンクスが出てくるなんてね……。: I can't believe a Vampirized Sphinx actually showed up……
m920143.まだまだ情報が足りませんね……。\n天使、そして天界の動向には、\n今後も目を光:
We still lack sufficient information…
We must keep a close watch on the movements of the angels
and the Celestial Realm from now on.
m920143.まったく、オークともあろう者が不甲斐ない。\nガツンと目を覚ましてやらないとねぇ:
Honestly, it's shameful for Orcs to be so helpless.
I suppose it's time to shake them awake with a good jolt.
m920143.む、誰かと思えば討ち漏らした小娘ではないか。\nおなごに興味は無いが、中々の武勇:
Hm, so it's the little girl we let slip.
I have no interest in females, but that was quite the display of valor.
m920143.むぅぅぅ、世界樹も獣も虫も可哀想だよぉ。\n世界樹の幹に突撃したらさ、\n『神の:
Mmm, the World Tree, the beasts, and the insects are all so pitiful.
If I charged straight into the World Tree's trunk,
maybe I could rip the "Wedge of the Gods" out?
m920143.むぐっ！？ ごく……ごく……。\nうっ……お、俺はいったい何を……。:
Gulp!? Gulp… gulp….
Ugh… what… what did I…
m920143.もう大丈夫ですよ。\n今対抗ポーションを持ってきますから！:
It's okay now.
I'll go get the antidote right away!
m920143.もとよりそのつもりです。\nここは任せました。私はあちら側を！\n王子殿、しばし:
That was my intention from the start.
Leave this side to me. I'll take care of that side!
Your Highness, please hold on for a little longer!
m920143.やはり、あなたもそう考えますか。\n私も個人的に恨みのある、\n虫の魔物を殺せる: I see, you think so too. I took this job because I hoped I might get the chance to kill the insect monsters I hold a personal grudge against.
m920143.よぉし、それじゃあ『神の楔』の\n調査をぐいぐい進めちゃおう！\n王子さま、こっ:
Alright, then let's push forward with the investigation
of the "Wedge of the Gods"!
Prince, this way, this way! Hurry up!
m920143.よぉし、急いで調合終わらせちゃおう！\n王子さま、ちょっとだけ待っててね！:
Alright, let's finish this alchemy quickly!
Prince, please wait just a moment!
m920143.わ、わかりました……。\nごりごり……ぐりぐり……。:
Y-Yes, I understand...
Grind, grind... Grind, grind...
m920143.わ、わー！？ 急いで王子さまに報告しないとー！\nたっ、たすっ、助けてください～:
W-Wha!? I have to report this to the Prince right away!
P-Please… help us~!?
m920143.わぁっ！？\nい、いきなり出てきたらびっくりしますよぉ！:
Waaah!?
D-Don't just pop out of nowhere like that!
m920143.ん、どうしたのアサル？\n何か心当たりがあるの？:
Hm, what's wrong, Asar?
Do you know something?
m920143.ガ、ガオゥ……。\nだが王子を見てみよッ！\nしっかりと頷いているではないかッ！:
G-Gaou…….
But look at the Prince!
Isn't he nodding firmly!?
m920143.ガ、ガオゥ……。\nムゥゥ、難しいことを言うな、サオシュよ……ッ！！:
G-Grrraaah……
Mmmph, don't say such complicated things, Saoshu!!
m920143.ガオレオン……。\nまったく、いつもの押し付けがましく\n暑苦しい態度はどこへ行:
Gaoleon…….
I can't believe it. Where did that usual pushy, smothering attitude of yours go?
m920143.ガオレオン様の遠吠えが聞こえない開拓村とか、\nこの上なく不気味です。\n完全に:
A frontier village where I can't hear Gaorion howling…
It's incredibly eerie.
Have they been completely controlled…?
m920143.ガオーッ！ かしこまりました、我が女王よッ！\n……くっ、うぉぉっ、で、ですが、:
GAOOON! As you command, my Queen!
……Guh, ugh, b-but,
my Queen, just one word…… please allow me……!
m920143.ガオーッ！ それは女王アリ様の美しさゆえにッ！！: Gaooon! It is because of the Queen Ant's beauty!!
m920143.ガオーッ！！\n声が大きいのは良いことではないかッ！！:
Grrraaaah!!
Is having a loud voice such a bad thing?!
m920143.ガオーッ！！\n女王アリ様のおなりであるッ！！:
Gaooh!!
The Queen Ant has arrived!!
m920143.ガオーッ！！ それは良いッ！！\n王子よ、レティシアは実に素晴らしい戦士だぞッ！:
Gaooh!! That's a good idea!!
Prince, Leticia is a truly magnificent warrior!!
m920143.クゥイルちゃーん！！ どこですか～！？ \nクゥイルちゃんが迷子になったんですけ:
Quill-chan!! Where are you~!?
Quill-chan has gotten lost!
m920143.デシウスさんと暗黒騎士団の皆さんが\n色々と手伝ってくれているおかげですとも。:
That is thanks to you and the Dark Knights
lending us a hand with everything.
m920143.ヌ……我輩を知っているのか？\nすまない、記憶が無くてな……。:
Nuu…… Do you know me?
I'm sorry, but I've lost my memory……
m920143.ヌゥ……っ。\n我輩が止めに――\nいや待て、向こうに見えるのはいったい何だ？:
Nuu……
I'll go stop them――
No, wait. What exactly is that over there?
m920143.ヌゥ、それは済まないことをした。\nその上、村人を元に戻すポーションを分けてくれ:
Nuu, I'm terribly sorry for that.
And to top it off, you're even sharing the potion
that restores the villagers. I can never thank you enough.
m920143.フンッ、もとよりレティシアひとりに\n女王アリの討伐を任せようとは思っておらぬぞ:
Tsk. I never intended to leave the Queen Ant's eradication
to Leticia alone in the first place!!
m920143.ムッ、このまま開拓村にて、\n護衛として暮らしても良いのだぞッ！？:
Hmph, you could stay in the frontier village
and live as a bodyguard, you know!?
m920143.事あるごとに叫びますからね、あの男は。\nともあれここまで来たら、\nあとは女王:
That man is always yipping and barking.
Anyway, now that we're here,
all that's left is to defeat the Queen Ant. Let's get inside the village—
m920143.交流というか、\nそれぞれの文化を尊重しているというか……？:
It's more than just exchanges.
I suppose you could say they respect each other's cultures...?
m920143.人間と共存する魔物、ですか……。\nにわかには信じがたいことではありますが……。:
Monsters coexisting with humans, you say…
It's hard to believe that, but…
m920143.以前にも同じことはあっただろう。\n公爵め、まるで何かの実験でもしているようだな:
It has happened before, hasn't it?
That Duke is treating this like some kind of experiment……
m920143.何しろ目の前で、優れた指揮能力と、\n類まれな武技を見せつけられてしまったんです:
After all, I was shown outstanding command skills
and unparalleled martial arts right before my eyes.
So, would the kingdom be willing to hire me?
m920143.何じゃと！？ いったいどうしたんじゃ！？:
What do you mean?!
What on earth is going on?!
m920143.何と素晴らしい肉体美なのだ！\n女王アリ様に栄光あれ！ 女王アリ様こそ美の化身！:
What magnificent physical beauty!
Glory to the Queen Ant! She is the incarnation of beauty!
m920143.何にせよ、この軍勢を退けるのが最優先だ。\n王子、敵は『闇夜』の間には動きが機敏:
Regardless, repelling this army is our top priority.
Prince, the enemy should move with heightened agility during the "Dark Night."
Please give your orders to the troops with caution.
m920143.可能性は否定できないわね……。\n現にそんな化け物がすぐそこまで迫ってるんだから:
I can't rule out that possibility……
Especially since those monsters are closing in on us right now.
m920143.向こうに……？ おや、あの顔ぶれは。\nデシウス様、あれは王国軍の部隊ですよ。:
Over there……?
Oh my. That lineup.
Lord Decius, that's a Royal Army unit.
m920143.否、この場の誰であっても、\nひとりであの軍勢全てを相手取ることはできまいッ！: No! Not a single person in this room could have faced that entire army alone!
m920143.哀れなる人の子よ。\nゆるやかな滅びに身を任せ、決して\n神々の争いに関わろうな:
Poor children of men.
Surrender yourselves to a slow, gentle extinction,
and never think to involve yourselves in the quarrels of the gods……
m920143.女王アリ、ガオレオン、撤退していきます……。\nまさか、彼があれほどまでに操られ:
The Queen Ant and Gaoleon are retreating…….
I never imagined he would be controlled to such an extent…….
m920143.女王アリに操られていたんですよ！\nはい、この対抗ポーションを早く早く！:
They were being controlled by the Queen Ant!
Here, take this counter-potion, quickly!
m920143.女王アリの影響は、ここまで及んでいたんですね。\nしかし、王国兵の皆さんにも、\:
So the Queen Ant's influence has reached this far…
But I would have thought the kingdom's soldiers
had developed some resistance to pheromones by now.
m920143.女王アリの軍団が来ます。\n皆さん、不利な状況ではありますが、\n村の皆さんを守:
The Queen Ant's army is coming.
It's a disadvantageous situation, but
we must prepare to defend the villagers!
m920143.女王アリはここまで勢力を……。\n王子殿、お気をつけください！ 敵が来ます！:
The Queen Ant's influence extends this far...
Your Highness, be careful! The enemy is coming!
m920143.姿を見せないのが不気味ですね……。\nいったい何を企んでいるのでしょうか。:
It's unsettling that he keeps hiding in the shadows……
What exactly is he scheming?
m920143.嫌です。夜明け前から\n叩き起こされる生活はうんざりですから。:
No, thank you. I'm tired of being woken up
before dawn.
m920143.巨大な魔界アリに、男を操るフェロモン……。\nそいつは魔界アリの女王に間違いない: A giant Demon Realm ant, and pheromones that control men…… That must definitely be the Queen of the Demon Realm ants.
m920143.恨みつらみがあるなら難しいかもしれないけど、\n魔物が全部悪いヤツっていうわけじ:
If you have that kind of grudge, it might be difficult,
but not all monsters are bad guys, you know.
You mustn't accidentally attack the kingdom's monsters, okay?
m920143.所詮、男は妾の下僕よ。\n妾のもとへ憎き王国の者がたどり着かぬよう、\n歓喜に打:
In the end, men are but my servants.
So that the people of that hated kingdom can't reach me,
fight while trembling with ecstasy.
m920143.承知しました。\nそれでは『神の楔』の影響を受けた\nグリフィンと蜘蛛を放ってお:
Understood.
Then I shall release the Griffins and Spiders
affected by the "Wedge of the Gods."
m920143.操られたままでは兵の皆さんが可哀想です。\n王子、急ぎフェロモンの効果を解いてあ:
It's a shame the soldiers are being forced to do this.
Prince, let's hurry and break the pheromone's hold on them!
m920143.操られてようがなんだろうが、\nガツンと正気に戻してやれば良い話だぜ。\nさぁ王:
Controlled or not,
a good smack should snap them out of it.
Come on, Prince, let's wrap this up quickly――
m920143.散発的な攻撃じゃなくて、\nひとつの軍団として攻めてきてるわね。\nどう見ても本:
This isn't a sporadic attack.
They're advancing as a unified legion.
It doesn't look like a raid driven by instinct at all.
m920143.斯様な玩具にも飽いたわ。\n疾く道を開けい、人の分際で妾の道を阻むでない！:
I am tired of playing with such toys.
Step aside at once, you mere human. Do not block my path!
m920143.暴れだしたというよりは、\n何だか操られているみたいですわね……。:
It's less that they're rampaging
and more that they seem to be under some kind of control…
m920143.武人たることをよしとする連中だからな。\n激突することも多いが、\n決して会話が:
They are a people who value martial prowess.
While clashes are common,
it's not as if we can't communicate with them at all.
m920143.民を守る剣には、まだまだほど遠いのです。\nですから私は、もっともっと強くなりま:
I am still far from being a sword that protects the people.
So I will grow stronger, and stronger.
Your Highness, please continue to watch over me.
--- scene: The Queen and the Beast King (battle, start) ---
m920143.無事に世界樹が魔物と化せば、\nたとえガリウスを討った王子達とはいえ、\n天界の:
Once the World Tree has fully become a monster,
even the Princes who slew Garius
will have no leisure to intervene in the heavens' conflict.
m920143.特にグリフィンなんてバサバサしてて素早いから、\nきっとベアッカ大活躍しちゃうよ:
Especially those Griffins, with their flapping wings and speed,
I'm sure Bearca will really shine!
Let's give it our all together!!
m920143.王国……軍？\nはっ、まさかあの軍が、\n村の男達に毒か何かを盛ったのではないか:
The Royal…… Army?
Hah, could it be that they
poisoned the village men or something?!
m920143.王国でも、以前男性がフェロモンで\n操られる事件がありましたね……。\n思い出す: There was a similar incident in the Kingdom before, where men were controlled by pheromones…… It's a bitter memory just to recall.
m920143.王国軍と共にッ、女王アリと戦うべくッ、\nこの村を救うべく戻ってくれた……ッ！！:
You returned with the royal army to fight the Queen Ant,
to save this village……!!
m920143.王子……よ……。\n来ては……ならん……ぞ……。:
Prince... you...
Must not... come here...
m920143.王子、この付近でも女王アリが目撃されたようです。\nフェロモンの影響がないか、一:
Prince, a Queen Ant has been spotted in this area as well.
Let's check to make sure we're not affected by her pheromones――
m920143.王子、事態は一刻を争うようです。\n急ぎ出立の準備を整えましょう！: Prince, the situation seems urgent. Let's prepare to depart immediately!
m920143.王子、嗚呼、王子よ。\n記憶は無いが、この呼び名には何故か、\nひどく強い心の昂:
Prince. Ah, my Prince.
Though I have no memories, for some reason,
this name stirs a powerful surge within my heart.
m920143.王子、開拓村ではより激しい戦いとなりそうです。\n十分に準備を整え、この先へ進み:
Prince, the battle at the pioneer village is likely to be even fiercer.
Let us prepare thoroughly and move forward.
m920143.王子さま、ベアッカに忘れずに指示を出してね？\nくまさんアーマーの連射性能なら、:
Prince, please don't forget to give Bearca her orders, okay?
With the Bearca Armor's rapid-fire capability,
we can just mow them all down in a flash!
m920143.王子よ、王国の歴史もここで終わりよ。\n歓喜に打ち震えながら、妾の下僕となるがよ:
Prince, the history of your kingdom ends here.
Tremble with joy, and become my servant!
--- scene: The Queen and the Beast King ---
m920143.王子殿、オーク達は高濃度のフェロモンで、\n大幅に凶暴化しているようです。:
Your Highness, the Orcs appear to be
significantly more violent due to the high-concentration pheromone.
m920143.王子殿、私はあちらの路地へ向かいます。\nこの辺りはお任せしても良いですか？:
Prince, I'll head over to that alley.
Is it all right if I leave this area to you?
m920143.神獣のヴァンパイア化には、\nまだいくつも課題が残されているということか。:
It seems there are still several issues to resolve
regarding the Vampirization of Divine Beasts.
m920143.私が謝りたいのは、女王アリ討伐の\n傭兵として雇われながら、\nこうして開拓村を:
What I want to apologize for is that,
despite being hired as a mercenary to slay the Queen Ant,
I put this frontier village in danger.
m920143.私の通った天界の門も、\n今は閉ざされていますからねぇ。:
The gate to the Celestial Realm that I once passed through
is now sealed off as well.
m920143.私はレティシア。開拓村に臨時で雇われた傭兵です。: My name is Leticia. I'm a mercenary hired on a temporary basis by the Frontier Village.
m920143.耐性を上回る程のフェロモンの変異か。\nどうやら女王アリはさらに進化したみたいだ:
It looks like the pheromones have mutated
beyond the limits of their tolerance.
It seems the Queen Ant has evolved further.
m920143.詳しく聞くのは仲良くなってからにしようかな。\nというわけで、仲良くなるために\:
I'll save the details for when we're closer friends.
So, to get us started, could you give me a hand with some alchemy? ♪
m920143.調合の手伝いだって言っただろ？\n心が曇ってる時は、無心になって\n乳鉢ゴリゴリ:
I told you it's alchemy, didn't I?
When your mind is clouded, I recommend grinding away in the mortar with all your might. ♪
m920143.迷子になったのはシュシュの方です！\nとはいえ、迷うのも仕方ないかもしれませんが:
It's Shushu who's lost!
Then again, I suppose it's no wonder you'd get lost……
m920143.鋼の都から援軍に来てくださったベアッカさんです。\n皆さんご無事ですか？\nいま:
I am Bearca, who has come to you from the City of Steel as reinforcements.
Is everyone safe?
The Prince's main force should be arriving shortly!
m920143.開拓村……ガオレオンさんと、\n元魔王軍の方々が切り拓いている集落ですね。: The Frontier Village…… the settlement being developed by Gaoreon and the former members of the Demon King's army, is it?
m920143.開拓村では、ここ数日\n男性が行方不明になる事件が多発していました。\nその対処: Over the past few days, there have been numerous cases of men going missing in the Frontier Village. I was hastily hired to deal with the situation.
m920143.開拓村とは色々と縁がありますからね。\nそれに、魔界アリの女王が動き出したなら、: We have quite a few ties to the Frontier Village. Besides, if the Queen of the Demon Realm ants has started moving, we cannot simply turn a blind eye.
m920143.頭を垂れ、恭順を誓うのであれば、\n妾の巣の飾りくらいにはしてやっても良いぞ？:
If you bow your head and swear your allegiance,
I might allow you to serve as an ornament in my nest.
m920143.魔物だけでなく、\n操られた方にも追われていたようですが、\n事情を聞かせてもら:
It seems you were being chased by both monsters
and the controlled individuals.
Could you tell us what happened?
m920143.魔物だけなら躊躇いなく滅ぼせるのに、\n操られた人間が紛れているなんて……。: If they were just monsters, I could annihilate them without hesitation, but there are controlled humans mixed in……
m920143.魔界アリの女王のフェロモンのことは、\n以前の会合にて政務官殿から聞いていたッ！:
I was briefed by the Chief Secretary at our previous meeting about the Queen Ant's pheromones!
That is precisely why I brought you along, Leticia!!
m920143.（それを思えば、こんな日常が終着地点というのも、\nデシウス様の言う星の導きなの:
(Thinking about that, perhaps this everyday life is the final destination,
just as Master Decius calls it the guidance of the stars.)
m920143.（以前のデシウス様は、\nずっと死に場所を求めているかのようでした。\n使命を果:
(The Decius of before
seemed to be constantly seeking a place to die.
As if he had fulfilled his mission and lost his purpose.)

m920174.――あの、ディアナ様、\n冥界軍との戦いも続いている中で、\nパレードに協賛して:
――Um, Diana-sama,
with the war against the Netherworld Army still ongoing,
do we really have the luxury of sponsoring a parade……?
m920174.――い、いえ、謹んでお受けします。\nすぅ、はぁ……ちょっと心配ですが……。:
――N-no, I humbly accept.
*sniff* *huff*……I'm a little nervous, though……
m920174.――いやぁ、見事見事。\nこれが白の帝国の女傑たちの武技。\nいやはや、おみそれ:
—Ah, splendid, truly splendid.
So this is the martial skill of the Empire's heroines.
I am awed by you.
m920174.――お、おい。\nあれマサカ、天才符術士のアキラジャねぇカ！？:
――H-hey.
Isn't that Akira, the genius talisman master!?
m920174.――おぉ、おぉ、なんと……！\nやはり先日の人気闘兵は夢ではなかったのか……！:
――Oh, oh, what is this……!
So the Popular Fighter Tournament from the other day wasn't a dream……!
m920174.――これが、英傑の力。\nいやはや、鬼刃姫様は\n大変な軍で戦っているのですね。:
――So this is the power of a hero.
I see. Lady Kibahime,
you truly command a formidable army.
m920174.――ところで、あやつら何故\nぷるぷる震えながら並んでおるのだ？:
――By the way, why are they
standing in a line, trembling like that?
m920174.――なるほど、これが当代のパレードか。\nどうにも懐かしい気分になってしまうもの:
――I see. So this is the parade of the current era.
It certainly stirs up some nostalgic feelings.
m920174.――ははは、見てください。\nパレード本番前から、\n元気に模擬戦をしているよう:
――Hahaha, look at that.
Before the parade even starts,
they're already energetically having a sparring match.
m920174.――みんなー！ 写真館の店主さんが来たわよ！: —Everyone! The Photo Studio Owner has arrived!
m920174.――ようやく、王国に帰ってきましたね。\n世界各地を回って、とても長いパレードで:
――We have finally returned to the Kingdom.
We've traveled the world, and it has been a very long parade……
m920174.――タツミさま？\n聞いていなかったのですか？\n私たちもこの後に演説をするので:
――Tatsumi-sama?
You didn't hear?
We are also giving a speech after this?
m920174.――大人気でしたね、ホルテウス。\n何というのか、教団――いえ、ファンクラブです:
――You were very popular, Horteus.
How should I put it… a sect? No, a fan club?
m920174.――殿下！ 王子殿下ぁー！\nうぉー！ 殿下が俺を見てくれたー！:
――Your Highness! Prince!
Wow! He's looking right at me!
m920174.…………。\nあなた、王子に影響されたんじゃない？:
………….
You're being influenced by the Prince, aren't you?
m920174.…………あいつも変わりましたナァ。\nジゼル嬢が祝祭を開いてくれたオカゲで、\n:
…………He's changed too.
Thanks to the festival Miss Jisel put on,
the village, and the dragonkin, are starting to look outward…….
m920174.…………えっ、わ、私ですか！？\nそこは王国の方がした方が――:
…………Eh? M-me?!
The Kingdom should be the one to give the speech—
m920174.……ああ、となると、\nアルタは天界から派遣された者代表か。:
……Ah, I see.
Then you must be the representative of those dispatched from the Celestial Realm.
m920174.……ああ、トラムの剣は、\n竜人に授けていったのでしたね。:
……Ah, right. Tram's sword
was given to the Dragonkin.
m920174.……あの、でも手遅れみたいですよ？\nほら、あの子たち、トラムを見ていますし。:
……Um, but it seems it's already too late?
Look, those kids are staring right at Tram.
m920174.……あの子は、後継者ではなく、\n私の補佐官となってもらう予定なので。:
……She is not to be my successor,
but my aide.
m920174.……ありませんね。\n余裕はまったくありません。:
……No, we don't.
We have absolutely no spare capacity.
m920174.……いや、いいことだけどマズイよ！\n非戦闘員が巻き込まれないように\n急いで警:
……No, it's a good thing, but it's a problem!
I need to set up a security perimeter right away
to make sure no non-combatants get caught up in it!
m920174.……おぬし、ういトコあるのぉ。\nちょっとドキっとしてしまったぞい。:
……You really do have a way with words.
That gave me quite a start.
m920174.……ずいぶん可愛がっているのね。\n後継者にでもするつもりなの？:
……You dote on her quite a bit.
Are you planning to make her your successor?
m920174.……そういうケイティさんも、\n澄ました顔してますけど、さっきから横目で\nずー:
...And you, Katie, who talks so confidently,
have been staring at Buleria out of the corner of your eye this whole time, haven't you?
m920174.……つまり、小規模でも、\n色々な仕事が生まれる祭りを開いていくといい、と？:
Her Majesty would surely say the same.
If it were the person she is now.
m920174.……なるほど、そういう考えもあるわね。\n一応私も、東の国の代表扱いなわけだし―:
……I see, that's one way to look at it.
I suppose I'm being treated as a representative of the Eastern Country too――
m920174.……はは、確かに。\nしかし目指すべき姿を目の当たりにしたことで、\n女王も今、:
……Haha, you are right.
But having witnessed the ideal form of a ruler firsthand,
the Queen is now making remarkable progress.
m920174.……ふぅ、パレードも終わりましたね。\n長い旅路でしたが、皆さん喜んでくれたよう:
……Phew, the parade is over.
It was a long journey, but it seems everyone enjoyed it.
m920174.……ほどほどにな。\nまぁ、アスラハならば任せても問題ないか。:
……Don't go overboard.
But I suppose I can leave that to you, Aslaha.
m920174.……スゲェ、タツミ様、ヨシノ様、アキラ様か。\n信仰しちまいそうダゼ……。:
……Wow. Tatsumi-sama, Yoshino-sama, Akira-sama.
I might just end up worshipping you guys…….
m920174.……トラムが打ち上げて、ソラスが撃ち落として、\nホルテウスのスフィンクスがお手:
……Tram is launching him, Solais is shooting him down,
and Horteus's Sphinx is juggling him……?
m920174.……今の砂漠の国には、\n少々荷が重すぎるかもしれませんね。: ……It might be a bit too much for the Desert Kingdom right now.
m920174.……王国軍は化け物揃いだよ？\nアクラも今後はその一員になるんだけどね。:
……The Kingdom's army is full of monsters, you know?
And you're going to be one of them from now on, Akura.
m920174.……私まで帝国の守護神扱いされていない？: ……Am I being treated as a guardian deity of the Empire, too?
m920174.あぁもう、ひとりで出歩くと迷子になるわよ？: Oh, come on, you'll get lost if you wander off on your own!
m920174.ああ、それで他の連中も、\n握手会に手合わせに、伝承の講演会にと\n引っ張りだこ:
Ah, so that's why the rest of them were torn apart
between autograph sessions, sparring matches,
and folklore lectures…
m920174.あそこで観光しておられる、\n三人の美姫ヲご存知ないノカ……！:
Don't you know about the three beautiful princesses
sightseeing over there……!
m920174.あて、そんなに寝付き悪くないよ……？: Hey, I'm not that bad at falling asleep…?
m920174.あなたに手を振っているんですよ。\n手を振り返すのも、仕事のうちですからね？:
She's waving at you, you know.
Waving back is part of the job, isn't it?
m920174.あのぉ、王国式のパレードは、\n腕に覚えのある方なら誰でも参加できる、\n模擬戦:
Um, in the kingdom-style parade,
anyone with combat skills is welcome to join
a mock battle demonstration――
m920174.あはは……ゲルトルートさんは王国出向中でしたし。\nそれに何より、今回のパレード:
Ahaha... well, Gertrude is on temporary assignment to the kingdom, after all.
Besides, this parade is being held simultaneously in all our allied nations, isn't it?♪
m920174.あはは……自分でも忘れていたような、\n古い伝承を持ち出されて、\n昔話をするハ:
Ahaha… I had almost forgotten about it,
but they brought up some old legends,
and I ended up getting dragged into a storytelling session…
m920174.あはは、いいっていいって。\n模擬戦も人気闘兵パレードのうち。\nさぁさ、竜人皆:
Ahaha, it's fine, it's fine.
A sparring match is part of the Popular Fighter Parade.
Come on, dragonkin, all of you, come at us!
m920174.あはは、誤魔化されてしまいましたわ。\nそれでは、市民の皆さまを\n魅了し、喜ば:
Ahaha, she's trying to change the subject.
Well then, let's captivate, delight, and entertain the citizens♪
m920174.あー、もうっ、巻き込まれちゃいましたぁ！\nこうなったら本気で行きますよぉ！？:
Aaah, I've been dragged into this!
Well, since it's come to this, I'll go all out!
m920174.あー、やっぱり巻き込まれるんだ、あー。: Ah, I knew I'd get dragged into this, ah.
m920174.いえ、私が皇帝の座についた時の、ですよ。: No, when I take the throne of the Emperor.
m920174.いえいえ、貴重な体験でした。\n模擬戦に全力を出すというのも、\n傭兵では中々経:
Not at all. It was a rare experience.
Giving a mock battle your all is a kind of passion
a mercenary rarely gets to feel.
m920174.いやアサル、何事も\n豪勢にやることだけが祭りではない。:
No, Asar. Grandiosity is not the only way to celebrate.
By giving the people work, the economy moves.
As the economy grows, the nation becomes stronger.
m920174.うぅぅ……どうして私が王国のパレードに……。\n場違いではないでしょうか……！？:
Ugh... why am I even in the kingdom's parade...
Don't I look completely out of place...!?
m920174.うぉぉぉっ、滞空時間更新！\nもうひと勝負お願いしマスぞー！！:
Woah! New altitude record!
Let's do another round, please!!
m920174.うそなき禁止！\nそれと、マブダチっていうの恥ずかしいってば！:
No crying!
And calling me "best friend" is embarrassing, you know!
m920174.うっ……だってあの甘味屋さん美味しくて……。\nじゃなくて！ アクラ、すぐに配置:
I-it's just that the sweets shop was so delicious...
Forget it! Akura, get into position right now!
m920174.うむ、これぞファンサだ。\n先程学んだばかりの概念だがな。:
Yes, that is true fan service.
A concept I only just learned.
m920174.うむ、無理やり英雄王を招いたりしてな。\n夜会は国を動かし、祭りは民を潤す。\n:
Indeed. We even had to force the Hero King to attend.
Banquets move nations, and festivals enrich the people.
We should hold events like this as often as possible.
m920174.えぇ、おまかせを。\n主に斬るか燃やすのが得意ですが、\n鬼刃姫様の寝かしつけ役:
I'll leave it to you.
I'm mainly skilled at cutting and burning,
but I'd also be glad to take on the role of putting Kibahime to sleep.
m920174.えぇ、これからも励みなさい。\nあなたにはとても大きな期待をしているのですから。:
Yes, keep up the good work.
I have very high expectations for you.
m920174.えぇ、人気闘兵は王国主催の祝祭ですからね。\n白の帝国を大々的に巻き込むことで、:
Yes, the Popular Fighter Tournament is a festival hosted by the Kingdom.
By involving the White Empire so grandly,
His Highness the Prince is trying to help the Empire in his own way.
m920174.えぇ、存じております。\n今のは愉快な冗談というやつですよ。:
Yes, I'm well aware.
That was just a bit of fun, nothing more.
m920174.えぇ、鬼刃姫さんからは、\nどんな仕事を振っても大丈夫と伺っていますが……。:
Yes. Kibahime said
she'd be happy to assign you any task, but…
m920174.えぇっ、私！？\nはぁ、仕方ないなぁ……。\nほら、三人で握手会とかしてあげよ。:
Me!?
Sigh, I suppose I have no choice…….
Come on, let's do a group handshake for them.
m920174.えっ、あ、あの、あれだけ観客がいたのに、\n気付いていたのですか……！？:
E-eh? B-but, with so many spectators there,
you noticed me...!?
m920174.えっ、いや、全力すぎるのはダメじゃぞー！？\n手加減！ てーかーげーんー！！:
W-wait, going all out is too much!
Hold back! H-hold b-back!
m920174.えっ、いや、消し炭じゃなくて……！\nあーもう、王子ごめんね、\nちょっと大変な:
E-eh? No, I didn't mean ashes, you idiot!
Aaah, this is so embarrassing, Prince, I'm so sorry.
I think I may have brought along a bit of a handful……!?
m920174.えっ、えぇと、それは……。\nコホン。私に限ってそんなことは――:
E-eh? I mean, that's...
Cough. It would never occur to me to do something like that――
m920174.えっ、わ、私もですか？\n今日はちょっと疲れちゃって――きゃぁっ！？:
E-eh? M-me, too?
I've been a bit tired today, and—KYAAH?!
m920174.おぉ、あれは踊り子のブレリア嬢に……。\n隣を歩いているのは戦術教官殿！\nあぁ:
Oh my, is that the dancer Buleria over there...
And walking beside her is the Tactics Instructor!
Ah... what a beautiful sight they make...
m920174.おぉ、おぉ……こんなことがあっていいのか……。\n輝ける陽光の如き御髪、清浄なる:
Oh, oh… is this really happening…?
Hair that shines like the radiant sun,
arms of pure silver…
That one is, ah, ah…!!
m920174.おぉ、手を振るだけで竜人たちが幸せそうに……。: Oh, just waving makes the Dragonkin look so happy……
m920174.おぉ、見ろ！ ディアナ騎士団長に、\nマルゴット教導隊長だ！！\n亜神ヘカティエ:
Oh, look! It's Knight Commander Diana,
and Instructor Captain Margot!!
Sub-Goddess Hecatie is here, too!
m920174.おっと、では集合写真とかキメるかのぉ。: Oh, then let's all get in for a group photo.
m920174.おっと、自己紹介が遅れました。\n鬼刃姫様のマブダチ、あるいは喧嘩友達にして、\:
Oh, I'm terribly late to introduce myself.
I'm Akura, Kibahime-sama's best friend, or perhaps her sparring partner, and a mercenary by trade.
m920174.おっとそうでした。\nそれでは、ゆるりと参りましょう。:
Oh, right.
Well then, let's head over at a leisurely pace.
m920174.おや、契約更新ありがとうございます？: Oh my, thank you for the contract renewal?
m920174.おやおや、妙な縁でファンができちゃったね。\nタツミ、ちゃんと面倒見てあげるんだ:
My, my. It seems we've acquired a fan through a strange turn of events.
Tatsumi, make sure to take good care of him, alright?
m920174.おーい、アルター？ あーるたー？\n……完全に緊張でカチコチになっておる。:
Hey, Alta? A-alta?
……You're completely frozen with nerves.
m920174.お兄さまと、お姉さまが、\nもしかしたら見ていてくれないかな、と。:
I was wondering if my brother and sister
might be watching……
m920174.このアクラ、マブダチの優しさに泣いてしまいそうです。\nうぅ、ぐすぐす、うぇーん:
This Akura is on the verge of tears
from our best friend's kindness.
Mmm, sniff sniff, waaah.
m920174.この後、最後の模擬戦演武なんじゃが\n大丈夫なのかのう？:
There's the final mock battle demonstration after this,
are you sure you're okay?
m920174.これも仕事……はいっ！\nみなさーん、行ってきますねー！:
Part of the job…… Yes, sir!
Everyone, I'm off!
m920174.ご存知ダッタカ！！\nヤハリあの美貌と優れた符術、\n世間知らずのオマエでも――:
I knew it!!
Sure enough, that beauty and those exceptional talisman skills,
even someone as out of touch as you――
m920174.さぁ次は誰？\nリアファルの咆哮を聴かせてあげる！:
Now then, who's next?
Let me show you the roar of my power!
m920174.さて、どう受け取るかはお任せします。\nそれより、そろそろ模擬戦演武が始まります:
How you take that is up to you.
Anyway, the mock battle is about to begin.
m920174.そ、ソウカ！ ウォォォッ！\n今日から俺はテメェらのファンダゼェ！！:
Oh, I see! Woah!!
From today on, I'm your fan!!
m920174.その点、私は立場上\nあまり名乗らないようにしていましたし、\nそういう心配はな:
In my position, I've tried to keep a low profile
and not make much of a name for myself,
so I haven't had to worry about that.
m920174.それでは王子を真ん中に……。\n皆さん、準備はよろしいですか？:
Then, with the Prince in the center…
Everyone, are you ready?
m920174.それに、我があまり砂漠の国にいると、\nホルエスめが政治をやりにくかろう。:
Besides, if I stay in the Desert Kingdom too long,
it will make it difficult for Horteus to manage state affairs.
m920174.それにしては、まるで我が子に\n学のひとつでも\n仕込んでいるかのような物言いだ:
If that's the case, why did you sound as if you were
instilling a lesson in your own child?
m920174.それは！ ファンになってしまったというコト！！: It means you have become their fans!!
m920174.それよりアルタ、おぬしも\nやけにきょろきょろして、誰を探しておるのじゃ？:
Anyway, Alta, you've been
looking around quite a bit. Are you looking for someone?
m920174.だぁぁっ！ うるせェ！\n今度はナンダってんだヨ。:
Daahh! Shut up!
What's the big deal this time?
m920174.ちょえー！？ なんでじゃ！？\n我べつに何もしとらんぞ！？:
Huh?! Why?!
I haven't done anything special!
m920174.ちょわー！？ 何でじゃー！？\n我関係ないじゃろー！？:
Hey!? What's with that!?
I have nothing to do with this, right!?
m920174.ついでに橋を直して道をならして、\n軍だからこそできる支援もできましたし、\n今:
We also took the opportunity to repair bridges and clear roads,
providing support that only an army can offer.
We should continue this work going forward.
m920174.ですが、冥界軍との決着が付くまで、\n魔王決戦被害地の戦災復興は待っていろ、\n:
But we can't simply say, “Hold off on rebuilding the war-torn areas from the Demon King's battle
until we settle things with the Netherworld Army,” can we?
m920174.では、この後の演説は\nまずはマルゴットさんからお願いしますね。:
Then, for the speech that follows,
I'd like to invite Margot to speak first.
m920174.では、模擬戦演武も終わりましたし、\nメイン会場の、竜人の隠れ里目指して出発しま:
Well then, now that the mock battle demonstration is over,
let's set off for the main venue, the Dragonkin's Hidden Village.
m920174.では行きますよ、\nみなさーん、我らが女神の名前はー？:
Alright, here we go!
Everyone, what is the name of our goddess?
m920174.でも、皆が喜んでくれるなら、\n手合わせのひとつやふたつ、\n全員まとめて相手し:
But if it makes everyone happy,
I'll spar with a few of you—
no, I'll take on all of you at once!
m920174.ところで、本当に王国で雇ってもらえるのでしょうか？: By the way, will I really be hired by the Kingdom?
m920174.どうしたッテんだよ！\n早く教えろヨ！！:
What is it?!
Tell me already!!
m920174.どうせなら友好国を可能な限り巻き込んで、\n魔王決戦の爪痕を、迅速に癒していこう: The idea is to involve as many allied nations as possible and heal the scars left by the war against the Demon King as quickly as we can――
m920174.なるほど……。\n……まだまだ、学ぶことばかりですね。:
I see…….
……There is still so much for me to learn.
m920174.なるほど、ゆえに今や信仰対象、と。\nトラム、何がそういう心配はない、なんだ？:
I see. So she has become an object of worship.
Tram, what do you mean by “no need to worry”?
m920174.なんでじゃ！ こういうのはアキラの役割じゃろ！: Why me! Isn't this Akira's job!
m920174.なんとお美しい……。\n帝国の平和を守る、美しき女神たちだ……！:
How beautiful…….
The beautiful goddesses who protect the peace of the Empire……!
m920174.は、はい……。\nあっ、あの子こっちに手を振っていますよ。:
Y-yes…….
Ah, that child is waving at us over here.
m920174.はぁ、はぁ、間に合ったぁ……。\nまったく、アクラがずっとお団子食べてたせいだよ:
Phew, phew, I just made it...
It's all Akura's fault for eating dango the whole time!
m920174.はぁぁ～、このお菓子いいなぁ……。\n東の国に輸入できないかな……。:
Haaah~ I wish I could have some of those sweets…….
Do you think we could import them to the Eastern Country?
m920174.はぁぁ～、何をしゃべればいいんじゃぁ！？: Ughhh~, what am I supposed to say?!
m920174.はいはい、ファンサービスするわよー。\n私だけにまかせておこうとか、\nちょっと:
Yes, yes, let's provide some fan service.
Thinking you could just leave it all to me……
Aren't you a little too cocky?
m920174.はっ、えっ、トラム様ッテ実在したノカ！？\n女神トラム様ガァァァッ！？:
Huh, wait, Tram-sama is real?!
The goddess Tram-sama is—!!
m920174.はっはっは、慌てちょるのぉ♪\nディアナのヤツ、\nマルゴットが可愛くて仕方ない:
Hahahaha, you're all flustered, aren't you?♪
Diana's just
too smitten with Margot, I suppose♪
m920174.はっはっは、我に頭を下げている暇があったら、\n竜人の民に手のひとつでも振ってや:
Hahaha! If you have time to bow to me,
you might as well wave to the Dragonkin people.
m920174.はて、このアクラ、鬼刃姫様もお団子を\nおかわりしていたと記憶しているのですが…: Hmm, I seem to recall that Kibahime-sama was also asking for seconds...
m920174.ははっ、景気が良いじゃないか。\nスフィンクス、もっと高い高いしてやるがいい！:
Haha, isn't this lively?
Sphinx, throw him higher!
m920174.ははっ、王子とホルエスの行く末を見届けたら、\nという意味に決まっている。: Haha! It simply means I intend to see how things turn out for you and Horteus.
m920174.ははは、お任せください。\n隊列を組む全てのパレード参加者、\nこのアクラが消し:
Hahaha, leave it to me.
I'll turn every parade participant in formation into a pile of ashes.
m920174.ははは、そういったものは、\n私よりも鬼刃姫様の方がお似合いかと。: Hahaha, I'm afraid the stage would suit Kibahime-sama far better than it would me.
m920174.ふふ、国主代理として招かれている以上、\nしっかり歓待を楽しんでいるアピールは必:
Hehe, since we've been invited as the acting head of state,
we really need to show that we're enjoying the hospitality, don't we?
m920174.ふふ、大役ですよ、マルゴット。\n王国の民に、教導隊長の凛々しさ、美しさ、\nそ:
Heh, it's a big responsibility, Margot.
It's the perfect chance to show the people of the Kingdom the dignity, beauty,
and nobility of the Training Corps Captain.
m920174.ふふ、王国とは友好関係を維持したいですからね。\nもちろん、冥界とも\nいずれは:
Fufu, I wish to maintain friendly relations with the Kingdom.
Of course, I hope to build a friendship with the Underworld someday, too.
m920174.ふふ、諦めてください。\n帝国市民からすれば、冥界との戦いに駆けつけてくれた\n:
Fufu, give up.
From the citizens' point of view, you are the beautiful goddess who came to help in the war against the Underworld.
m920174.ふふふ、バレましたか。\nところで鬼刃姫様、あちらで\n竜人が、気持ちよく空に打:
Fufufu, was I caught?
By the way, Lady Kibahime, over there,
a dragonkin is being launched joyfully into the sky……
m920174.ふふん、トモエじゃあるまいし、\nそうそう迷子にはならんならん♪:
Hehe, I'm not Tomoe, you know.
I don't just get lost that easily♪
m920174.ほぁぁ……これが竜人の家かぁ。\nなるほど、中は涼しいんじゃのう♪:
Hoaaah…… so this is a dragonkin home.
I see, it's nice and cool inside♪
m920174.ほら、ふたりとも、\nイチャついている暇があったら手を振るといい。\n東の国の者:
Come now, you two.
If you have time to flirt, wave to the crowd.
The people from the Eastern Kingdom were doing it.
m920174.ほら、胸を張りなさい。\nそんなうなだれたまま、\n帝都の門を出ていくつもりかし:
Come now, hold your head up.
Do you intend to leave the Imperial Capital's gates
with your head hanging like that?
m920174.ま、まぁ、本人たちが楽しそうなら、\nこれも良いんじゃないかなぁ？:
W-well, if they're having fun,
I guess it's fine?
m920174.まぁ、軍に護衛をつけるというのも、\nなんともおかしな話ではあるのですが……。:
Well, having the military provide an escort is
quite a strange arrangement, but…….
m920174.まぁいいわ。\n神に夢を抱くのは、人類の権利のひとつだものね。\n――では、少し:
Well, I suppose it's fine.
Dreaming of the gods is one of humanity's rights, after all.
—Then, let me dance for you a little.
m920174.も、もうっ！ お世辞はいいから！\nそれじゃあ王子、あてはこのまま王国軍の護衛で:
M-mou! Don't flatter me!
Anyway, Prince, I'll stay here to guard the royal army,
and Akura will head over to the White Empire's side.
m920174.もぎせん、模擬戦ですね。\nアルタは大丈夫です、問題ありません。:
Mock battle, you mean.
Alta is fine, there's no problem.
m920174.やるじゃないか、竜人も。\nこれは砂漠の国も、ますます訓練に力を入れないとな。:
Well done, Dragonkin.
It seems the Desert Kingdom needs to step up its training efforts.
m920174.やれやれ、そういう\nソラスも疲れ切っているではないか。:
Oh my, and you, Solais,
look completely exhausted.
m920174.わ、わわ……えっと、えぇ……っ？\nどうしたらいいの！？:
W-w-w… um, uh…?
What am I supposed to do?!
m920174.わぁ……！\n何とカッコイイお方！\nどうでしょう、一度一緒に舞台に……。:
Oh my……!
What a dashing gentleman!
How about we share the stage together, just once?
m920174.ん、なんじゃなんじゃ。\nもしかして模擬戦かのう！？:
Nn, what's this, what's this.
Could it be a sparring match!?
m920174.アクラもお疲れ様。\nとんでもない人員ばかりで疲れちゃったんじゃない？:
Good work, Akura.
With a crew like that, you must be exhausted.
m920174.アクラ強すぎるから、傭兵業してても\n料金高すぎて中々雇ってもらえないって言って:
You said that because you're so strong,
your mercenary rates are too high for most to afford, right?
I figured the Kingdom could keep you on payroll indefinitely.
m920174.ケイティは昨日、私の舞台を観に来てくれたのですわ♪\nきっとその余韻が抜けきって:
Katie came to watch my performance yesterday, you know♪
She's probably still riding high on the afterglow of it.
m920174.コホンっ！ ほ、ほらお二人とも、\nそろそろパレード開始の模擬戦演武が始まります:
Cough! A-anyway, you two,
the mock battle for the parade is about to begin!
m920174.コラァァァァア！！ 様をつけぬカァァァァァ！！: Hey!! Don't you dare drop the honorifics!!
m920174.コレが！ 砂漠の国の！ ファンサ！！: This is it! The Desert Kingdom's! Fan service!!
m920174.タツミ様、私が肩車でもしましょうか？: My lord Tatsumi, shall I give you a ride on my shoulders?
m920174.ッテコトは……。\nあれは戦巫女タツミ、アッチは東の国のヨシノかァ！？:
So that's…….
That's the battle miko Tatsumi, and over there is Yoshino from the Eastern Country, huh!?
m920174.テメェ呼びは禁止ですぞー！？: Don't use that kind of language!
m920174.ナニィ！？ トラム様が、女神トラム様がぁっ！\n我らと手合わせ、て、ててて、手合:
What?! Tram-sama, the goddess Tram-sama
is going to spar with us?!
S-s-s-spar with us?!
m920174.パレード中はお行儀ヨク、パレード中はお行儀ヨク……！: Behave yourself during the parade, behave yourself during the parade……!
m920174.フフン、それは信仰に似てはイルが、\nマッタク異なる感情なのデスゾ？:
Fufun, it does resemble devotion,
but it is a completely different emotion, you know?
m920174.ホストたる王国が要請し、東の国が護衛につく。\n王国と東の国という歴史深い二国の:
The Kingdom, as the host, has requested it, and the Eastern Nation is providing the escort.
Is this a show of goodwill to the outside world, welcoming the White Empire into the bond between these two historic nations?
m920174.ホルテウスも、なに腕組みして見守ってるの？\nもちろんあなたたちも手合わせに参加:
Horteus, why are you just standing there with your arms crossed?
Of course you're joining the sparring matches too, right?
m920174.ヨシノぉー！ タツミぃー！ アキラぁー！！\n頼む、手合わせをしてくれェー！！:
Yoshino~! Tatsumi~! Akira~!!
Please, let me have a sparring match with you!!
m920174.ン、ンン、いったいドウシタのですかな？\n突然テンション上がったりしテ。:
Mm, hmm, what's gotten into you?
Why are you suddenly so excited?
m920174.今回のパレードは、あてたちが護衛役なんだからね。\n見物人が怪我しないように、\:
We're on guard duty for this parade, after all.
We need to keep a sharp eye out so no spectators get hurt, or you're in big trouble, got it?
m920174.今後の砂漠の国の復興にも\n色々と使えそうなアイデアばかりでしたね。:
Every one of these ideas could be put to good use
in the desert nation's reconstruction.
m920174.何っ、トラム様との手合わせは\n我々王国軍兵士の方が先に――:
What! We, the soldiers of the royal army,
should get the chance to spar with Tram-sama first—
m920174.偉大なるホルテウス様には、感謝してもしきれない。: I am deeply grateful to the great Horteus.
m920174.元々は世界樹の災いに対処する猛者を探す催し、\nそれが今や戦災復興のため、世界各:
It originally started as an event to find powerful warriors to deal with the World Tree's calamity,
but now it's a festival that serves as a pretext for delivering supplies to disaster-stricken areas around the world.
m920174.先程は思いっきり手合わせしてしまいましたからナ！\nパレード中ダケハ！ 何とかお:
I let loose a bit earlier, that's why na!
Just during the parade! I'll try to behave……!!
m920174.全員東の国の猛者じゃネェか！\nうぉぉ、こうしちゃいられネェ！！:
They're all tough fighters from the Eastern Country!
Wooh, I can't just stand here!!
m920174.兵からも民からも慕われていますからね。\nあとは、もう少し素直だとホルエスさまも:
The soldiers and the people both look up to you.
If only you were a bit more open, Her Majesty would――
m920174.勘弁してよ、この私に、\nハイドース様の後釜に座れって言いたいの？: Spare me. Are you asking me to take Hyades-sama's place?
m920174.千年前にも、やはりこういった催しを？: Did they hold events like this a thousand years ago as well?
m920174.嗚呼……竜人の隠れ里に、春が来ましたゾォ……！: Ah…… Spring has come to the dragonkin's hidden village……!
m920174.国家というものは、可能な限り全ての事柄に、\n同時に当たらねばならないのです。\:
A nation must address every matter simultaneously,
to the best of its ability.
――Margot, remember this for the future.
m920174.女王陛下ならば、きっとそう言うことだろう。\n今のあのお方ならば。:
Yes. I leave the future of the Desert Kingdom to you.
Once I am done with this, I may go on a tour of the various nations.
m920174.当たり前ですわよ？\nでも、ケイティが来ていたのなら、\n演目はもっと恋愛描写の:
Of course I did!
But if I'd known Katie was coming, I would have chosen a program with more romantic scenes――
m920174.形式というのは大切なのですよ、マルゴット。\n実際の戦力の如何は関係ないのです。:
Formalities are important, Margot.
It has nothing to do with actual combat strength.
m920174.悪意ある者は、そんなことをする余裕があるなら\nこっちを片付けてからにしろ、\n:
Those who harbor ill intent would say something pleasant like,
“Deal with us first if you have the time to spare,” but――
m920174.我が名は銀腕、亜神トラム！\n腕に覚えある強者たちよ、\n己の誇りと名誉にかけて:
I am the Silver Arm, the Lesser God Tram!
You warriors of renown,
in the name of your pride and honor, draw your swords!
m920174.我が身は最強の剣、激情を抱く未来を願われた自動人形。\n模擬戦であろうと全力でお:
My body is the strongest sword, a golem created to wish for a future filled with passion.
Even in a mock battle, I will give it my all!
m920174.我らの女神ダゾ！ 我らが先に――: She is our goddess! We should get to go first—
m920174.我ら竜人の姫君、アーニャ様に、\n自らの輝剣を授けられた、\n偉大なる女神、銀の:
It is our Dragonkin princess's savior,
the one who bestowed upon Her Highness Ania
Her own shining blade!
The great goddess of the silver arms,
our guardian deity, Tram-sama!
m920174.新顔で、東の国の代表で、\n演説を任せられるには十分な立場かと。:
You're a new face, representing the Eastern Lands,
so you have a perfectly suitable position for it.
m920174.普段の冷静なケイティさんが、\nまるで恋する乙女みたいになってるんですけど……。: The usually composed Katie is acting just like a girl in love...
m920174.民に仕事を与えることで、経済が動く。\n経済が育てば、国は強くなっていくのだ。:
……In other words, we should hold festivals that create various jobs,
even on a small scale?
m920174.煽らないでくださいよぉ！？\nうぅぅぅ、文面を考えないと……。:
Don't egg me on, please!
Ugh, I need to figure out what to say……
m920174.王国式に考えるなら、\n信者相手にファンサービス、というところか。:
If we think like a kingdom,
the answer would be to provide fan service
to the believers.
m920174.王国式の復興支援、\nこういう手段もあるのだと学ばせてもらったぞ。:
I've learned that
there are other ways to provide reconstruction support in the Kingdom's style.
m920174.神の名を物質界に残しすぎるのもよくない、\nと言っていたな、そういえば。:
You did say that leaving too much of a divine
presence in the material world is a bad thing, didn't you?
m920174.私はそんな、偉大な女神ではないわ。\nただ物質界と共にあることを選んだだけなの。:
I'm not some great goddess.
I simply chose to exist alongside the material world.
m920174.立ち聞きですか、亜神殿。\n……何にせよ、その言葉は否定しておきましょう。\n私:
Eavesdropping, are we, Sub-Temple?
……In any case, let me deny that.
I'm not at the age of seeking a successor yet.
m920174.竜人の、それも隠れ里となれば、\n古い伝承が、かつての形のまま残っていそうだもの:
When it comes to the Dragonkin, especially those from a hidden village,
it stands to reason that old legends would have survived,
preserved in their original form.
m920174.素直な気持ちを、\nそのまま話すのが良いのではないかと……。:
I think it's best to just
speak your honest feelings……
m920174.素直に話したら、お前ら大好きじゃぞ！ 終わり！\nになってしまうではないかぁ……:
If I speak honestly, I'd just say “I love you all!” and be done with it!
That's not going to work, is it……
m920174.血気盛んな竜人たちですから、\n模擬戦の相手なんてしてあげてはどうでしょう？:
Since the Dragonkin are so spirited,
how about offering them a sparring match?
m920174.言葉の端々から、絶対にやり遂げられるって\n自信が溢れかえっているように見えるわ: From the way you speak, you seem brimming with the confidence that you will absolutely see this through.
m920174.護衛役のアクラさんですね。\n竜人の隠れ里までの案内、よろしくお願いします。:
You must be Akura, the escort.
Thank you for guiding us to the Dragonkin's hidden village.
m920174.（……はっ、これがもしや、\nディアナ様の言っていた王国と帝国の\n結びつきを示:
(……Wait, could this be
the strategy Diana mentioned
to demonstrate the bond between the Kingdom and the Empire……!?)
m920174.（あっ……目があって……わ、わわ……。\n手を振られてしまいました……！）:
(Ah……our eyes met……w, w-wait……
They're waving at me……!)

m920181.――あうぅぅぅ……。\nラシティ、飛び方が雑ですわよ……。\n目が回りましたわぁ:
――Ahhh…….
Lasithi, your flying is so rough…….
My head is spinning…….
m920181.――あなたは勘違いをしています、亜神ヒュープ。\n人間の心とは、永遠の夢に耐えら:
――You are mistaken, minor god Hupe.
The human heart is not built to endure an eternal dream.
m920181.――いえ、申し訳ありません。\n作戦を前に、弱気になってしまったようです。:
――No, I apologize.

I seem to be losing my nerve right before the operation begins.
m920181.――いや、その必要はないよ。\nレフカ、ラシティ、よく戦ってくれたね。\nおかげ:
――No, there is no need for that.
Lefka, Lasithi, you fought well.
Thanks to you, I was able to observe the Prince thoroughly.
m920181.――いや、ぼくの相棒を\nそう簡単に連れて行かないでくれるかな？:
――No, I'd rather you not take my partner
so easily.
m920181.――うん……やっぱり間違いないですわ！\nレフカさん、あなた、精神支配されてます:
――Yes…… I was right!
Lefka, you are under mental domination!
m920181.――えぇ、いっぱい苦労しましたわよ！: ――Oh, I did! I had so many troubles!
m920181.――おや、強大な敵の侵攻を前にして\n玉座で待つとは、随分な余裕ですね。: ――Oh, my. To sit idly on your throne in the face of such a mighty invasion? You certainly have a lot of nerve.
m920181.――だが、その状態で\n本当に第二層へ進むつもりかい？:
—But, are you truly intending to proceed to the second layer
in that condition?
m920181.――とうとう、オリュンポスに挑む日が来ましたね。: ――So, the day we challenge Olympus has finally come.
m920181.――ふぅ。\nさぁレフカさん、じっとしているのですわよぉ……？:
――Phew.
Now then, Lefka, just stand still, alright……?
m920181.――むしろ驚きだよ。\n僕の夢の中で、\nまさか目覚めたままでいられる者がいるな:
――I should be the one surprised.
In my dream,
I never expected anyone to remain conscious.
m920181.――やれやれ、僕の夢から覚めるなんて、\n人間の中じゃふたり目かな。:
――Well, well. To wake up from my dream...
You're only the second human to do so.
m920181.――ようこそ、オリュンポス第一層へ。\nここは夢と眠りの亜神、ヒュープの寝所だ。:
――Welcome to the First Layer of Olympus.
This is the resting place of Hupe, the minor god of dreams and sleep.
m920181.――ソーマさん、もっとよく狙って。\nそれでは王子付きのメイドになれませんよ？:
――Soma, aim more carefully.
You can't be a maid to the Prince if you can't hit your target.
m920181.――届いた、のか。\n人の刃が、僕の身にまで。:
—So it reached me.
A human blade, striking my body.
m920181.――本当に、オリュンポスに挑むつもりですのね。\n亜神ヒュープさま、どう出迎えた:
???: ――So, you really intend to challenge Olympus.
Demi-God Hyup, how should I welcome you?
m920181.――王子の容態は安定しました。\n数日で復帰できるかと思います。:
The Prince's condition is stable.
I expect he'll be back on his feet within a few days.
m920181.――降参！ こうさーん！！\n参りましたですわー！！:
――I surrender! I surrender!!
I give up!
m920181.…………ありがとう、レーヴ。\nここからは、俺の戦いだ。:
………… Thanks, Reve.
From here on, this is my battle.
m920181.…………行った、か。\n力を取り戻してから、もう一度登ってくるといいさ。:
………… So, they've gone.
Once you've regained your strength, feel free to climb up again.
m920181.……ああ、そうか。\nようやく繋がった、お前があいつの子孫か！\nそれなら僕の夢:
...Ah, I see.
So you're his descendant! That explains the connection.
Now it makes sense why my dreams have no hold on you.
m920181.……おや、ここは……？\nぼくらはいったい……？:
...Oh, where is this...?
What is happening to us...?
m920181.……お前、英雄王の陣営にいた砂漠の女王か。\n僕の夢に随分な物言いだな。:
...So you are the Desert Queen who served the Hero King.
You have quite a lot of opinions about my dreams.
m920181.……これは……王子！\nだめよ！ 彼の言葉に耳をかしたら――:
...This is... Prince!
No! Don't listen to his words――
m920181.……だから時間がないんだ。\nあの泡沫の眷属は癒しの力を持ってやがるんだ。:
...That's why we're short on time.
Those bubble minions have healing powers.
m920181.……ちっ……勝手に僕の権能を明かさないでほしいな。\nまぁいいさ……人の身で、\:
...Tch... I'd prefer if you wouldn't expose my abilities like that.
But very well... In a human body,
you couldn't possibly reach my slumber...
m920181.……と、ともあれ、\n何事も王子の回復を待ってから、ですね。:
...In any case,
we should wait for the Prince to recover before moving forward.
m920181.……はぁ。\nこれは従姉妹殿も苦労したんだろうなぁ。:
...Haa.
It seems my cousin had her share of troubles, too.
m920181.……はっ！ きっとあなたは偽物ですわ！\nやっぱり夢の中のオーキュこそ本物っ！:
……Hah! You must be the fake!
The Orku in my dreams is the real one after all!
m920181.……まぁ、分かればいいさ。\n次はぼくの相棒として、\nちゃんとカッコよくキメて:
...Well, I'm glad you understand.
Next time, as my partner,
make sure to look cool, alright?
m920181.……やめておけ、アリア。\nこやつにそのような交渉は無意味だ。:
...Stop, Aria.
Negotiating with him is pointless.
m920181.……亜神ヒュープ、その優しさゆえに、\nかつて英雄王を救おうとしたのなら、\nあ:
...Minor God Hupe, if you tried to save the Hero King
out of kindness,
does that mean you were on humanity's side?
m920181.……僕は君たちに負けた。\nもう第一層が、君たちに牙を剥くことはない。:
...I have lost to you.
The first layer will no longer show its fangs to you.
m920181.……夢を、現実が超えるだと？\nありえない、そんなことが――:
...Reality surpassing a dream?
Impossible, that kind of thing is—
m920181.……彼はもう、邪魔をしてくることはないと思うわ。\n助力をしてくれるとは限らない:
……I don't think he will get in our way again.
Though that does not mean he will help us.
m920181.……戦いの亜神はこれだから。\nトラム、君が彼らをそそのかしたんだろう？\n戦え:
...That is the problem with the god of war.
Tram, you must be the one who incited them, didn't you?
Telling them to fight, to seize it, that the future lies beyond victory.
m920181.……王子、撤退しましょう。\nこのままでは亜神ヒュープの術中に――: ...Prince, we should retreat. If we stay, we'll fall right into the minor god Hupe's trap—
m920181.……考えておこう。\nトラム、お前が変われたのなら、\n僕もまた、変われるかもし:
...I'll consider it.
Tram, if you've been able to change,
perhaps I can change too.
m920181.あ、あ、あなたのせいじゃないですか！\n王子をこんな目に――:
A-aren't you the one to blame!
You've done this to the Prince—
m920181.あ、あの……そういうことでしたら、\nわたくしの翼をお貸ししますわ……！:
Ah, um… if that is the case,
please, let me lend you my wings…!
m920181.あ、あの、ヒュープさまは\n約束は守る方だと思いますわ……！:
U-um, I believe Hupe-sama
is the type to keep his promises...!
m920181.ああ……。\nしかし張り切りすぎは怪我の元で――:
Ah...
But overexertion is the root of injury――
m920181.ああ、オリュンポス第一層、\n亜神ヒュープ様の庭にて、きみたちを待っているよ。:
Ah, yes. The first layer of Olympus,
in the garden of the Lesser God Hype. We'll be waiting for you.
m920181.ああ、理解したくもないさ。\nあえて苦境に飛び込む君たちの考えなんてね。:
Ah, I have no desire to understand.
Your logic of leaping into hardship, I mean.
m920181.あいにくと、夢の中は慣れているんです。\n特にこういう酷い悪夢の中は。:
I'm used to being in dreams.
Especially terrible nightmares like this one.
m920181.あっ、もう！ 待ちなさいっ！！\nレフカ！ 絶対その夢の中の私の方が偽物――:
Ah, wait! Hold on!!
Lefka! That dream version of me is definitely the fake――
m920181.あの夢を見ることを、望んだのは彼自身だよ。: He is the one who wished to see that dream.
m920181.あの時は本当に酷かった。\nあいつ、どうみても戦士なのに魔法まで使いこなして、\:
Back then, it was truly humiliating.
He was clearly a warrior, yet he wielded magic with ease,
and he unraveled the very fabric of my dream world...
m920181.あら……？ あの翼の色は……。\nいえ、あの子が、ここにいるはずがありませんわね:
Oh……? The color of those wings……
No, there's no way that girl would be here.
m920181.あら、王子までどうしたの？\n王国も北の大国も、大きな戦争もなく、\nずっと豊か:
Oh, what's wrong with you, Prince?
Both the Kingdom and the Northern Great Power
have been prospering and thriving without a major war.
m920181.あら？ オーキュじゃありませんの。\n今日はお茶会に来たのかしら？:
Oh? It's Orku.

Did you come for a tea party today?
m920181.いいだろう。\n君たちがどうしても意地を張るというのなら、\nここからは僕が相手:
Very well.
If you insist on being so stubborn,
I shall be your opponent from here on out.
m920181.いいね、その華やかな戦いぶり。\n華やかさは大切だよ、いい夢のエッセンスになる。: How splendid. That battle was quite a spectacle. Splendor is essential, after all. It makes for a wonderful essence in a dream.
m920181.いいや、あの時はあいつを救おうとしたんだ。\n魔王との絶望的な戦いに挑むようなヤ:
No, I was trying to save him.
I couldn't just leave someone who would challenge the Demon King
in such a hopeless battle, could I?
m920181.いえ、私はきっかけを作っただけですよ。\nむしろ、王子の意志に助けてもらったくら:
No, I merely set things in motion.
If anything, it was the Prince's will that helped us.
m920181.いやぁ、よく来てくれたよ。\n僕はずっと君を待っていたんだ。:
Ah, I'm glad you came.
I have been waiting for you all along.
m920181.うぅ、だってぇ……。\nふわふわ飛んでたら、王国軍が\n侵攻してくるのが見えちゃ:
Ugh, but…….
When I was floating along, I could see
the Kingdom's army invading…….
m920181.うぅぅぅ、目が覚めているのは私だけみたいですね……。: Ugh... It seems I'm the only one who's awake...
m920181.うむ、考えないのはだめじゃが、\n考え過ぎもよくないからのう。\nさぁ王子よ、オ:
Yes, it's bad not to think,

but overthinking is bad too.

Now then, Prince! Let's begin our march toward Olympus!
m920181.えぇ、この後の模擬戦では、\n王室警護の訓練も兼ねて、\nメイドも参加することに:
Yes. In the upcoming mock battle,
the maids are participating as well,
to double as royal guard training.
m920181.えぇ。\nおふたりとも、王子の剣と槍の師匠ですからね。:
Yes.
You two are the Prince's sword and spear instructors, after all.
m920181.えっ……。\nほ、ほんとです！ 周りはアンデッドだらけですよ！:
E-eh...
It's true! There are undead all around us!
m920181.えっ……お、王子っ！？\nどうして、こんなに衰弱して……。: E-eh... Prince?! Why are you so weakened...?
m920181.おっと、そうでした。\n陛下も王子の戦いぶりを楽しみにしているそうですよ？:
Oh, right.
I hear His Majesty is looking forward to seeing you in battle?
m920181.おっと、存外早い到着だ。\nそれじゃあ、第一層の門番として、\nその実力を試させ:
Oh, you're here earlier than expected.
Well then, as the gatekeepers of the first layer,
let us test your strength.
m920181.おや、怒っているのかい？\n理想の夢を見せてもらって怒るとは、\n人類とは実に度: Oh my, are you angry? To be angry after I've shown you an ideal dream... Humans are truly an unmanageable creation.
m920181.おや、準備運動ですよクレイブ。\n王子も陛下が観覧すると聞いて、\nとてもやる気:
Oh, just a warm-up, Crave.
The Prince seemed very motivated
after hearing that His Majesty would be watching.
m920181.おや、私のことを敵だと認識していたとは。\nこうも自由に出入りさせてくれるもので:
Oh, so you do recognize me as your enemy?

I suppose that makes sense. I've been coming and going so freely that you likely mistook me for a casual friend.
m920181.おや、突然元気になりましたね？\nそれでは、本番の前に\n少し身体を動かしておく:
Oh, look at that, suddenly full of energy.
Well then, let's get a little exercise
before the real thing begins.
m920181.おやセーラ殿。\nソーマ殿の弓の訓練ですかな？:
Oh, Lady Sarah.
Is this an archery lesson for Lady Soma?
m920181.か、勘違いですのよ！？\nあの時は精神支配を解こうとしただけでー！:
I-I'm just misunderstanding things!?
I was only trying to break the mental domination back then!
m920181.きみだって、剣を振ると魔法が出るとかずるいと思うよ？: I'd think it's sneaky when your sword swings release magic, too.
m920181.きゃぁあぁっ！？\n急降下したり急上昇したり！\nずるいと思いませんの！？:
Kyaaaa!?
Diving and soaring like that!
Don't you think that's a bit sneaky!?
m920181.きゃー♪ まるで騎士物語みたいですのー♪: Kyaa♪ It's just like a knight's tale♪
m920181.きゃーっ！？\n捕まって支配されて大変なことされちゃいますの～！？:
Kyaa!?
If I get caught and dominated, I'll be in for a terrible time!
m920181.このお仕事をしているとぉ、\n毎日素敵なご褒美がもらえますの♪: When I do this kind of work, I get a lovely reward every day♪
m920181.この階層は天界でありながら、天界ではない。\n僕の夢の力で編み上げたもうひとつの:
This layer is the heavens, yet it is not the heavens.
It is another world, woven together by the power of my dreams.
m920181.これくらいで驚いていてどうするの。\nいくらこの数百年、\n王国の平和が続いてい:
What are you going to do, be surprised by something like this?
No matter how many centuries
the Kingdom's peace has lasted――
m920181.これこそが僕の理想郷。\n創造神の作り出した「夢」の階層に、\n僕の力を注ぎ込ん: This is my utopia. A layer of “dreams” created by the Creator God, infused with my power. It is the resting place of the minor god Hupe.
m920181.ご褒美に釣られて鳥人の里を裏切るとか……！\n鳥人としてのプライドが無いんですの:
To betray the Bird-Folk village for a reward……!
Do you have no pride as a Bird-Folk?!
m920181.さぁ、次なる眷属を見せてあげよう。\n泡沫の羊よ、そろそろ彼らを大人しくしてくれ:
Now then, let me show you my next familiar.
Foam-born sheep, it is time to keep them in line.
m920181.ささっとお仕事を終わらせて、\n今日もオーキュといっぱい遊ぶんですのー♪:
I'll finish my work quickly and
play with Orku all day today♪
m920181.さすがは王子、強欲で貪欲で、\n誰より強いお人好しだけあるということか。:
As expected of the Prince. Greedy, insatiable,
and the most stubbornly kind-hearted person of them all.
m920181.さて、初めましてだね。\nえぇと、王国の王子、だったかな？:
Well, hello there.
Ah, yes, you are the Prince of the Kingdom, right?
m920181.し、シビラ殿下！？\nどうしてこちらに！？:
S-Sybil?!
What are you doing here?
m920181.しかし、あの男は別だ。\n余のオリュンポスを登り、玉座に至るだけの器がある。:
However, that man is different.

He possesses the caliber to climb Olympus and reach the throne.
m920181.じゃあ、この手は届くって教えてやろうぜ。\nいくぞ王子、短期決戦であいつをぶっ飛:
Then let me show you that this hand can reach.
Come on, Prince! We'll take him down in a quick fight!
--- scene: Slumbering Demi-God (battle, end) ---
m920181.そう、みたいね……。\n気付かない？ この濃密な死の気配に……。:
Yes, it seems so...
Can't you tell? This thick aura of death...
m920181.そういうこと。\nさぁ、ぼくらにその実力を見せてもらおうか！:
That's right.
Now then, show us your true strength!
m920181.そういう時はまず報告。\nヒュープ様だって、腕試しをして、\nぼくらが実力を認め:
In a situation like that, the first thing to do is report.
Lord Hupe said that if we tested your skills and recognized your strength, you could pass through.
m920181.そうっ！ そうですわ！\n優しくしたいから、夢に閉じ込めちゃってただけですのよ！:
That's right! Exactly!
He trapped us in the dream because he wanted to be kind!
m920181.そうね、昔ならそうしたかもしれないけれど……。: Perhaps I would have said so in the past...
m920181.そうまでして、何故戦う？\n傷つき、失い、それでも何故止まらない。:
Why do you fight, even after all this?
You are wounded, you have lost so much, and yet you do not stop.
m920181.その亜神に操られてたレフカさんが言うのだから、\nあなたも相当なお人好しだと思い:
Coming from Lefka, who was under that demigod's control,
I'd say you're quite the kind-hearted one yourself...?
m920181.その後悔が君を強くしたのだろうけれど、\n同時に、自らその夢を描き出してしまった:
That regret has made you stronger, no doubt,
but by drawing that dream into existence yourself,
your mind is beginning to separate from your body.
m920181.その点で、亜神ディアスには賛同できる。\n過度な喜びも、惨たらしい悲劇もない、\:
On that point, I can agree with the minor god Dias.
He aims to bring about a world of lukewarm peace, free from excessive joy and gruesome tragedy.
m920181.それじゃあ、後は好きにするといい。\n君たちの精神支配は解いておくからね。:
Now then, do as you please.
I will release you from the mental domination.
m920181.それでも、そういう夢は自分だけのものなんです。\n叶わなくても、大切に心の中に留:
But dreams like that are meant to be kept private.
Even if they never come true, they're treasures to hold close in your heart――
m920181.それでも王子が立ち上がって、\n前に歩み続けてきた辛さも、\n私は……私たちは知:
But I... we know how hard it was for him to get back up
and keep moving forward...!
m920181.それは……本当に、王子のご先祖さまらしいですわね。: That sounds... very much like the Prince's ancestor.
m920181.それは君たちの勝手な言い分だよ。\n夢こそこの世界の真実だと、なぜ分からない？: That is merely your own arbitrary opinion. Why can't you understand that dreams are the true reality of this world?
m920181.そんなに怯えないでくださいな！？\n精神支配の魔術を解除するだけで――:
Don't be so scared, please!?
I'm only going to dispel the mental domination spell――
m920181.ただ、一度退くことになったのは辛いな。\nまた亜神ヒュープと戦わねばならんのか？:
Still, it's a shame we had to retreat.
Does that mean we'll have to fight the demigod Hupe again?
m920181.ただ、僕としては\n夢の世界だけは素敵で愉快な場所にしてあげたいけどね。:
Still, as for me,
I'd like to make the world of dreams a truly wonderful and delightful place.
m920181.ただ夢見るままに待ち続ければ、\n人は腐ちて死んでしまうのだと、\nそんな単純な:
He cannot even share the simple understanding
that if one waits in eternal dreams,
the body will rot and die. That is the nature of a minor god.
m920181.ちっ……面倒な。\n王子、時間がないからよく聞け。:
Tch... What a pain.
Prince, we don't have much time, so listen up.
m920181.つまり、ここでふたりを倒せば、\n精神支配も解除して、\n堂々とオリュンポスへ乗:
In other words, if we defeat the two of you here,
the mental domination will be lifted,
and we can boldly charge into Olympus.
m920181.ですのですのとうるさいですの！\nちょっとしか違わないのにお姉さんぶって！:
That's so noisy!
We're barely different, yet you act like the big sister!
m920181.でも、あいつは笑いながら僕にこう言った。\nいい夢だった、守るべきものがより明確:
But he just laughed and said this to me.
"It was a good dream. Now I know exactly what I must protect."
m920181.でも、わたくしたちにも敵わない、\nよわよわな感じでしたら、\nここでぼっこぼこ:
But if you are too weak to even match us,
we will beat you to a pulp right here!
m920181.ともあれ、レフカは返してもらった。\n門番というものは、\nふたりセットじゃない:
Anyway, I've got Lefka back.
After all, gatekeepers
don't work unless they're a pair.
m920181.ともあれ、元気を使い果たしていないようで何よりです。\nそれでは王子、演習場へ移:
In any case, I'm glad you haven't used up all your energy.
Now then, Prince, shall we head to the training grounds?
m920181.どうしても何も、亜神さまのお手伝いですわ？: Well, I'm just helping the Demi-God out, of course.
m920181.どうしても何も、今回の演習は北の大国との合同でしょう。\nもちろん、部隊を率いて:
What do you mean, "what am I doing"? This exercise is a joint one with the Northern Great Power.
Of course I came to lead a unit.
m920181.なぁに、こちとら最初からそのつもりじゃろ？\nどーんとぶつかって、どかーんとぶっ:
Oh, come now, wasn't that the plan from the start?

We'll smash right into them and send them flying! ♪
m920181.なっ……普段どおりですわよ！？\nレフカへのお説教は私の役割でしょう！？:
Wha…… I'm acting completely normal!
Isn't it my role to lecture Lefka?!
m920181.なにか事情があるのかもしれません。\n幸い、彼女が向かったのはオリュンポスの方角:
There may be some circumstances.
Fortunately, she headed toward Olympus.
Prince, let's chase after Lefka.
m920181.ならば、ここを通してはくれませんか？\n私たちは亜神ディアスを止めなければならな:
If so, could you please let us pass?
We must stop the minor god Dias.
m920181.ならば、その理想が無尽蔵に手に入る、\n夢の世界に閉じこもっているのが一番の幸せ:
Then is it not the greatest happiness to remain in a world of dreams,
where those ideals are endlessly within reach?
m920181.なるほど、丁寧に、優しくエスコート。\n夢の世界に至るまで、\n親切にご案内すれ:
???: I see. Politely and gently, we escort you.
We guide you kindly all the way to the world of dreams,
is that it?
m920181.なんだあいつ、うとうとしはじめやがったぞ？: What's with him? He's starting to doze off.
m920181.は、はいっ！\n――って、私なんかが王子付きなんて恐れ多いですよ！？:
Y-Yes!
――I mean, it's too much of an honor for someone like me to serve the Prince!
m920181.はぁ……うん、これは認めざるをえないかな。\nぼくも降参するよ。\n噂に違わぬ強:
Haa... Yes, I have no choice but to admit it.
I surrender too.
The Kingdom's army is indeed as strong as they say.
m920181.はぁ……精神支配されていても\nその強がりなところは変わらずですのね！:
Haa…… Even under mental domination,
that stubborn pride of yours never changes, does it!
m920181.はっ！？ しゃ、シャルロットさん！？\nやめてー！ 怖いことしないでくださいなー:
Hah!? C-Charlotte!?
Stop it! Please don't say scary things like that!
m920181.ははっ、先祖も子孫も揃って大馬鹿者とは。\nでも、あいつの系譜だっていうのなら\:
Hah! Ancestors and descendants, all of you fools.
But if you're truly of his bloodline,
you might just be able to keep me company for a while.
m920181.ひっ、ひぃぃっ！？\n何するつもりですの！？:
H-Hyaa!?
What do you think you're doing!?
m920181.ふぁ……あふ……。\n戦場に立つなんて、千年ぶりかな……。:
Phaa... Ah...
Standing on a battlefield... it's been a thousand years, hasn't it...
m920181.ふざけたことを。\n創造神の被造物たちに肩入れし、\nその子らを送り込んだのは貴:
Don't be absurd.

You sided with the creations of the Creator God and sent their offspring against us.
m920181.ふふ、英雄王の時代からの名残ね？: Hehe, a remnant of the Hero King's era, I suppose?
m920181.ふふっ、ミレイユさんと同じことを言ってますね♪: Hehe, you're saying the same thing as Mireille♪
m920181.ふふん、このわたくしが\n簡単に心を支配されたりすると思いますの？:
Fufu, do you really think
this Lefka could have her mind easily controlled?
m920181.ふむ……あの分からずやな亜神が？\nまた夢でも見せてくるかと思っていたが。:
Hm... That obtuse demigod?
I was expecting him to show us another dream.
m920181.へっ、その前にぶっ飛ばせばいいんだな！\n――って、うおおっ！？\n泡の眷属がわ:
Heh, we just have to blast him before that happens!
—Wha!? There are swarms of his bubble minions coming out!
m920181.まさか、目覚めたのか……？\n僕の作り出した夢から覚めたというのか……！？:
No way... did he wake up?
He woke up from the dream I created...!?
m920181.まさか、英雄王と戦ったことが……？: Could it be... you fought the Hero King?
m920181.まだ戦えるようだし、戦う意志もありそうだけど……。\nふふっ、理想の夢というもの: He still seems able to fight, and his will to do so remains... But hehe, an ideal dream must be quite sweet, wouldn't you say?
m920181.まったく、心臓に悪いです……。\n殿下が参加するとは一言も聞いていませんでしたよ:
Honestly, you're the death...
We were never told you would be participating.
m920181.むぅぅ、しつこいですわ！\n偽オーキュ！ わたくしに優しくない\n偽オーキュはさ:
Mmm, you're so persistent!
Fake Orku! A fake Orku who isn't kind to me
should just disappear right away!
m920181.むぅぅぅぅ！\nわたくし、そんなか弱い精神してないですわよ！？:
Mmmph!
I'm not that fragile-minded, you know!?
m920181.やれやれ……ようやく解呪してあげられますわね。\nそれじゃあ、そのままじっとして:
Well, well... at last, I can lift the curse.
Now then, just stay still for a moment――
m920181.よほど素敵な夢だったんだろうね。\n心が夢に惹かれている。\n肉体がそれを抑えき: He must be having a wonderful dream. His heart is drawn to it. His body can no longer hold it back.
m920181.わ、私もついていきますわよ！\n王子さま！ しっかりしてくださいなー！！:
I-I'm coming along, too!
Prince! Hang in there, okay!!
m920181.わたくしたちを見事倒せば、\nこの先へ進ませるようにとのお達しですわ。:
If you defeat us,
we have been ordered to let you proceed.
m920181.わっ……今度は羊さんの形の泡が……？: Wha... Now there are bubbles shaped like sheep...?
m920181.わっ、わぁあっ！？ 王子ちゃん！ 王子ちゃん！？\n大変です、意識を失ってますよ:
W-What!? Prince! Prince!?
He's lost consciousness!
m920181.オリュンポスの攻略は始まったばかりです。\n皆さんも、しっかり身体を休めてくださ:
Our assault on Olympus has only just begun.
Please make sure everyone gets plenty of rest.
m920181.ソーマさんも！\nって、ミレイユさんたちまで！？:
Soma!
Wait, Mireille and the others are here too!?
m920181.ヒュープ、これだけ\n人の夢を見つめてきたのに分からないのかしら？:
Hupe, you have gazed upon so many human dreams.
Do you still not understand?
m920181.ラシティ！ はやく！ はやーく！\nわたくしを助けてくださいなー！:
Lasithi! Hurry! Hurry up!
Please save me!
m920181.一度、物質界へ戻り給えよ。\n彼には休息が必要だろう？\nそして君たちは、彼なし:
Return to the material world for now.
He needs rest, doesn't he?
And you cannot fight without him.
m920181.世話の焼けるお姫さまだ。\nさぁ、ぼくの手をとって！:
What a high-maintenance princess you are.
Come, take my hand!
m920181.亜神に人の価値観は通じぬ。\nこやつは夢を見続けさせることで、\nこの死者たちを:
A minor god cannot understand human values.
He genuinely believes he is saving these dead
by forcing them to keep dreaming.
m920181.亜神の力に対抗できたのは、\nやはりレーヴさんの力のおかげでしょうか。:
Being able to counter the power of the demigod...
I suppose that was thanks to Reve's strength, after all.
m920181.亜神ディアス、彼らは愚かな被造物なんかじゃない。\n何しろ、理想の夢を捨ててでも:
Sub-God Dias, they are no mere foolish creations.
After all, they are the sort who can fight for an uncertain future,
even if it means abandoning their ideal dream.
--- scene: story talk 1 ---
m920181.亜神ヒュープの微睡みこそ、奴の権能だ。\n奴が眠りに近付くほど、\n敵対者――つ:
The slumber of the demi-god Hupe is his very power.
The closer he gets to sleep, the more our strength is drained away.
m920181.人とは、理想を求めて戦うものだ。\nそれくらいは分かっているよ。:
Humans fight in pursuit of their ideals.
I know that much.
m920181.人は、偽りを信じられるほど愚かではないのよ。\n失ったものが、取りこぼしたものが:
Humans are not so foolish as to believe in a lie.
That what has been lost, what has slipped through their fingers,
can simply be "erased" within a dream.
m920181.人は心を大切にする生き物だろう。\n肉体よりも心だなどと、自ら論ずるじゃないか。: Humans are creatures who value their hearts above all. You yourselves argue that the heart matters more than the body.
m920181.人類に肩入れしたつもりはありませんよ。\n娘たちはともかく、放蕩息子は\n私の言:
I have no intention of siding with humanity.

Setting aside my daughters, my prodigal son wouldn't listen to a word I said anyway.
m920181.体調が悪い時に無理をしてはいけませんよ。\nいくら国王陛下がご観覧になるからと言:
You must not force yourself when you are unwell.
No matter how much His Majesty is watching,
overexertion only leads to injury.
m920181.何がお茶会ですの！\nレフカ、どうしてあなたがそっちにいますの！？:
What tea party?!

Lefka, why are you on *their* side?!
m920181.何が酷いものか、何が悪夢であるものか。\nこれは彼が望んだ、\n決して叶うことの:
What makes it terrible? What makes it a nightmare?
This is the beautiful dream of the past
that he wished for,
one that could never come true.
m920181.何考えてるかよく分からない方ですけれど……。\nでも、なんというのか……うーん…:
I can't really understand what he's thinking, though...
But, how should I put it... um...
m920181.偽りでは満足できない、強欲な人のあり方。\n現実で叶える夢の形を、楽しみにしてい:
The way of a greedy soul who cannot be satisfied with a lie.
I look forward to seeing the form your dreams take in reality.
m920181.僕とて、創造神と志を同じくした者だ。\n被造物たる君たちが苦しむ姿は、\nできれ:
I, too, share the Creator God's aspirations.
I would rather not see the suffering of the creatures I created.
m920181.僕は亜神ヒュープ。\nオリュンポス第一層の管理者だ。:
I am the Lesser God Hupe.
I am the administrator of the first layer of Olympus.
m920181.分かっているな、王子。\nあの眷属も人型と同じく破裂するぞ。:
You understand, Prince.
Those familiars burst just like the humanoids.
m920181.助けてもらったお礼もしたいしね。\n癒し手のおかげで傷も治ったばかりだし。:
I'd like to repay the favor, too.
The Healer just finished mending my wounds.
m920181.君が何を言おうと、その声は届かないよ。\nどれだけ王子のことを想っていても、\n:
No matter what you say, your voice won't reach him.
No matter how much you care for the Prince,
his heart is now trapped within this dream――
m920181.君たちも覚えがあるんじゃないかな。\n愉快な思い出、激戦の記憶、\nそれらが混ざ: You must remember this, don't you? Have you ever had a dream where pleasant memories and the recollections of fierce battles were all mixed together?
m920181.君の夢は、本当に深く、\n君の奥深くに根ざしたものだったんだね。:
Your dream is truly deep,
rooted in the very core of your being.
m920181.変わったよ、お前は。\n亜神のくせに変わろうとするなんて。:
You have changed.
Trying to change, even though you are a minor god.
m920181.外部からの観測は強固な結界で遮られていますね……。\n魔力の一欠片たりとも通して:
Observation from the outside is blocked by a formidable barrier……

It seems not even a fragment of magic can get through.
m920181.夢の世界で叶えきれない夢だったからこそ、\nきっと、亜神ヒュープの解釈を超えられ:
Precisely because it was a dream that couldn't be fulfilled in the dream world,
I believe that's why he was able to surpass Hupe's interpretation.
m920181.夢の中で、強く感じたんです。\n王子が現実で叶えたい夢は、\n夢の世界で見せられ:
I felt it strongly within the dream.
The dream the Prince wished to realize in reality
was far greater than the illusion shown to him in the dream world.
m920181.夢の中のオーキュはそんな事言いませんー。\nさすが偽物、口がわるいですのー。:
The Orku in my dreams would never say something like that.
As expected of a fake, you have a bad mouth.
m920181.夢は純粋だ。\n肉体がなくとも、心だけで見続けることができる。\n記憶と空想だけ: Dreams are pure. Even without a body, one can continue to dream with the heart alone. They can be endlessly painted with nothing but memory and imagination.
m920181.夢を英雄王に破られ、王子に破られ、\nそして現実でも負けたのよ。\nそろそろ、目:
Your dream was shattered by the Hero King, then by the Prince,
and now you've lost in reality too.
Perhaps it's time you woke up.
m920181.天界の門経由では遠すぎる……。\nビフロストまで急いで運ぶんじゃー！:
Going through the Gates of the Heavens is too far a detour…
I'll hurry and carry him to Bifrost!
m920181.失敬だな、きみたちは。\n「彼ら」は死んだわけではないよ。\nほら、今も夢を見続:
How rude of you.
"They" are not dead.
Look, they are still dreaming, aren't they?
m920181.度し難いと言いつつ、\nそれでも王子に「素敵な夢」を見せようとする、\n貴様の方: You call us unmanageable, yet you, who try to force a “wonderful dream” on the Prince, are far more unmanageable.
m920181.強大な敵だと？ それはお前のことか？\nまさかオリュンポスの麓で足踏みをする\n:
You call *that* a mighty enemy? Are you referring to yourself?

Surely you don't mean the mortals who are still stumbling around at the foot of Olympus.
m920181.当たり前ですよ！\nもう決して叶わない願いを見せつけて、\n閉じ込めて、こんなの:
Of course!
Forcing him to see a wish that can never be fulfilled,
and locking him away... isn't that just torture!!
m920181.当然だとも。\n苦しんでいる者がいるなら、悩める者がいるなら、\n彼らこそ夢の世: Of course. If there are those who suffer, if there are those who are troubled, then they are the ones who should be saved in the world of dreams.
m920181.彼が、王子が望んでいたんだ。\n魔物も復活せず、両親も健在で、\n仲間たちと語ら:
He, the Prince, wished for this.
No monsters revived, his parents alive and well,
and moments like these, talking with his companions.
m920181.思いますわね……。\nどれだけ強大な魔力や精神力を備えていようと、\nちょっとし:
I do suppose so…….
No matter how powerful one's magic or will may be,
the power of domination slips in through the smallest cracks in the heart.
m920181.意地悪ニセオーキュちゃんといい、\nあなたといい、いい加減にしやがれですわー！:
Between that mean-spirited fake Orku and you,
can't you two just cut it out already?!
m920181.文句を言うなら、敵に捕まらないでほしかったね。\nぼくだって、もっとカッコよく\:
If you want to complain, you should have tried not to get captured.
I wanted to make a more stylish entrance
as a gatekeeper, too, you know?
m920181.暗い夢の水底で、まばゆい天頂の幻の中で、\n温かなまどろみの淵で、\n見果てぬ夢:
At the bottom of a dark dream, within a dazzling illusion of the zenith,
at the edge of a warm slumber,
in the heart of desire, praying for dreams that never end, dreams that can never come true...
m920181.永遠を生きられる亜神には理解できないでしょう。\nあなたの行為は、緩やかな精神の:
You, who live forever as a minor god, cannot understand.
Your actions are nothing more than imposing a slow, spiritual death
upon humanity.
m920181.王国は伝統的に、\nメイドが簡単な身辺警護も兼ねていますからね。:
It is a tradition of the Kingdom
for maids to also handle basic personal security.
m920181.王子、亜神ディアスはあの日、\nさらなる力を身に着けろと、\nその日まで座して待:
Prince, on that day, the Demi-God Dias said,

"Acquire even greater power, and I will wait here until that day comes."
m920181.王子、気分がすぐれないようでしたら、\n次の模擬戦は陣幕で休んでいた方が……。:
Prince, if you're feeling unwell,
you should rest behind the screen for the next mock battle.
m920181.王子が……ずっと悔やんでいたことは、知ってます。\n誰だってこうだったらいいなっ:
I know what the Prince has always regretted.
Everyone has dreams of how things could be different.
m920181.王子が夢の中で、どれだけ後悔してきたのか、\n私は知っています……。: I know how much the Prince has regretted things in his dreams...
m920181.王子さま、不甲斐ない従姉妹ですが、\n私の大事な一族ですの。\n精神支配の解除、:
Prince, she may be a disappointing cousin,
but she is a precious member of my family.
Please help me break the mental domination!
m920181.王子さま、敵に鳥人がいるようですわ！\n十分に注意なさってくださいまし！:
Prince, it seems there are Bird-Folk on the enemy side!
Please be very careful!
m920181.王子ちゃん、一度退きましょう。\nもしこのまま勝ち進めても、\n王子ちゃんの命が:
Prince, let's retreat for a moment.
If we keep pushing forward like this,
the Prince's life is at stake...
m920181.王子よ、気をつけよ。\nヒュープの眷属たる人型の泡沫は壊れる直前の夢の欠片。\n: Prince, be careful. Hupe's humanoid followers are fragments of dreams on the verge of shattering. They will burst, scattering their shards all around!
m920181.王子？ どうしてそんな辛そうなお顔を――: Prince? Why do you look so pained――
m920181.理解できない存在だけれど、\n人を虐げようとすることはない、かしら。:
He is an existence beyond comprehension,
but I don't think he would ever seek to oppress others.
m920181.登りたかったら、\n正々堂々真正面から来い、ということですのね。:
So, if we want to climb up,

we're expected to come at them head-on, fair and square.
m920181.神に挑む者は英雄でなければならぬ。\nさぁ王子よ、余に挑むだけの力を見せよ。\n:
One who challenges a god must be a hero.

Now then, Prince. Show me the strength to challenge me.

Show me that you can cut away your dreams and still press forward.
