m920181.神への不敬には、同量の罰を与えるべきかな。\n幸福な夢の世界に誘うつもりだったけ: Blasphemy against a god deserves an equal measure of punishment. I was planning to invite you to a world of happy dreams, but I've changed my mind. Come, my followers. You, the dreamers of fleeting illusions.
m920181.私たちは、それだけの実力を\n身につけられたのでしょうか……？: Have we truly gained the strength to match that expectation……?
m920181.私の従姉妹ですわ……。\nオリュンポス付近の里で暮らしていましたが、\nまさか、:
She is my cousin……
She lived in a village near Olympus,
but I never expected her to side with the enemy……
m920181.私はね、彼に救われたのよ。\nおかしいでしょう、亜神が人に救われるなんて。:
I was saved by him, you see.
Isn't that amusing? A minor god, saved by a human.
m920181.第一層、亜神ヒュープの庭……。\nともかく、進むしかなさそうですね。\n王子、気:
The first layer, the garden of the Lesser God Hype…….
In any case, we have no choice but to press on.
Prince, let's approach Olympus carefully.
m920181.絶対に手に入らない、理想の世界。\nそんな夢の中から帰ってこられるなんて……。:
An ideal world that was absolutely out of reach.
To be able to return from a dream like that...
m920181.覗き見て、再現して、閉じ込めて。\nそんなことはされたくない、とでも？:
Peeking in, recreating it, and trapping him inside.
Is that what you're objecting to?
m920181.言われてみれば、天界の息苦しさがないわね。: Now that you mention it, it doesn't have that suffocating feel of the heavens.
m920181.貴様の戯言など信じるに値せぬわ。\n神の世でも、人の世のためでもなく、\n世界の:
I find no value in your ramblings.

Not for the world of the gods, not for the world of men, but for the "side of the world" you claim to champion.
m920181.身に覚えはありますけどね……。\nでも、夢は立ち止まるためのものではないんです。: I certainly have... But dreams are not something to stop for. At least, not for humanity.
m920181.辛いだろうが、汝の指揮が必要だ。\n亜神ヒュープを退けるぞ！:
It will be difficult, but I need your command.
We will drive away the minor god Hupe!
--- scene: Foam Sheep (battle, end) ---
m920181.遅いよ、亜神トラム。\n人の子は、決して己の夢からは逃げられないのだからね。:
Too slow, Lesser God Tram.
Mortals can never escape their own dreams.
m920181.騒がしいと思って来てみれば……。\nミレイユ、演習本番の前に何をしているのですか:
I thought it was noisy, so I came to check...
Mireille, what are you doing before the exercise starts?
m920181.（……うーん、さっきのレフカさんから感じられた魔力、\nなんだか覚えがあるような:
(……Hmm, the magic power I sensed from Lefka just now,
I feel like I've encountered it before……?)

m920239.――あの注目選手の戦い、再び！\n準決勝を戦うのは……こいつらだー！: Here it is again! The showdown between these two stars! The semifinalists are…… these two!
m920239.――おい、おいおいおいおいッ！！\n誰かを忘れちゃいねェか！？\nクソ弱ぇゴミど:
——Hey, hey, hey, hey, HEY!!
Don't you think you're forgetting someone, there?!
You bunch of pathetic, worthless scums!!
m920239.――おや、また王子殿下の肩書が増えたのか。: ——Oh my, it seems Your Highness has acquired another title.
m920239.――さぁついに始まります、雪原王決定戦！\n前回開催からすでに三百年！\n当時の:
And so, it finally begins! The King of the Snowfields Tournament!
It's been three hundred years since the last one!
Not a single record from back then remains. What a delightful mess!
m920239.――しょ、勝者！ 王子ぃー！！\n雪原王決定戦、勝者は王子です！！:
――Sho, the winner! Prince!
The winner of the Snowfield King tournament is the Prince!
m920239.――そういうことなら！\nわたしたちが力になれるかも！:
??? : ――If that's the case! 
Maybe we can help!
m920239.――そういうわけで、\n王子には雪原王になってほしいんだけど……。:
――So, with that in mind,
we'd like you to become the King of the Snowfield, Prince...
m920239.――てめぇを雪原王として認めるぜ！: ...recognize you as the King of the Snowfields!
m920239.――ん、待てアヴリック。\n向こうから何かが走って……。:
——Hm, wait, Avric.
Something's running over from over there…….
m920239.――剣を取れ、王子ィ！\nテメェも負かしてオレの一族に加えてやる！:
――Draw your sword, Prince!
I'll beat you down and add you to my clan!
m920239.――名乗りは今度たっぷり聞くから！\nそれで、心当たりは？:
――I'll hear your full introduction later! 
So, do you have any leads?
m920239.――姫様、私にも労いのお言葉をいただけたりは？: ——Princess, might I have a word of encouragement for myself as well?
m920239.――情報収集は現地民の手を借りよ、か。\nすごいな、さすがは雪原に生きる者たちだ:
——"Gather information with the help of the locals," huh.
Amazing. Truly befitting those who live in the snowfields.
m920239.――王子、北の大国が動かせる、\n最大戦力を揃えたわ。:
——Prince, I have gathered the Northern Great Power's
maximum military strength.
m920239.――王子が、雪原王になること！ だよ！: ...that the Prince becomes the King of the Snowfields!
m920239.――王子を、狭間の雪原の上級王……。\nつまり雪原王にすること、だと？:
――Make the Prince the High King of the Interstitial Snowfield...?
In other words, the King of the Snowfield?
m920239.――私たちの村、雪枝の里の族長がね、\n狭間の雪原全体にとっての一大事だからって:
――Our village, the Snow Branch, has a chieftain who,
saying it's a matter of grave importance for the entire Interstitial Snowfield,
went out to ask the other settlements for their cooperation with the Kingdom.
m920239.……ああ、なるほど、そういうことか。: ……Ah, I see. That's what this is about.
m920239.……しかし、雪原王か。: ……And so, the King of the Snowfields.
m920239.……ところで、あの銀狼族の次期……族長？\nあの子はなんで王国に入り浸っているん:
……By the way, that Silver Wolf's next…… chieftain?
Why is that girl spending so much time in the kingdom?
m920239.……どうにか援軍が間に合いましたね。\n皆さん、ご無事でしたか？:
……The reinforcements arrived just in time.
Are you all safe?
m920239.……なるほど、実力は確かだが、\n色々と修行中、ということだな。\nなんとなく言:
...I see. She has the skill,
but she's still learning the ropes in many ways.
I think I understand what you're getting at.
m920239.……三百年前も、こんな感じだったのかねぇ。: ……I wonder if it was something like this three hundred years ago, too.
m920239.……獣人狩りだよ。\n毛皮を目的に、いくつかの国が\n国家規模で彼らの里を駆逐し:
……It's a beastman hunt.
Several nations targeted their settlements on a state scale,
driving them out for their furs.
m920239.……移動魔法に相乗りは、まぁ、無理だろうな。\nとなると、手がかりの一切ない拠点:
……Riding along on travel magic is, well, unlikely. 
So we have no choice but to search for a base 
with no leads using sheer manpower.
m920239.……聞くまでもなかったな。\nでは皆、雪枝の里へ向かう準備を！:
...I didn't need to ask.
Then everyone, prepare to head to the Snow Branch!
m920239.……見苦しいな。お前たちの流儀では、\n勝負に負けたら軍門に下るんだろう？ ――:
……That's unsightly. By your own code,
you should surrender when you lose a match, right? ――Hmph!!
m920239.『あーあー。聞こえるかい？\n王子っ！ うちの可愛いファオルをたぶらかした男ッ！: 『Aaah. Can you hear me? Prince! You man who toyed with my precious Faul!』
m920239.『その結果次第じゃ、ファオルは嫁にやらない！\nお前が雪枝の里に、婿に来いッ！！: 『Depending on the result, I won't give Faul to you as a bride! You'll come to the Snow Branch Village as my son-in-law!』
m920239.『よし、言いたいことは言った！\n我が名はオヴィー！ 勇猛なるジャコウウシの血族: 『Alright, I've said my piece! My name is Ovie! Of the bloodline of the mighty Musk Ox!』
m920239.『オレとクルーナに、\nお前の本当の実力ってやつを見せてもらう！』: 『You and Kluna, let me see your true strength!』
m920239.あ、あなたは……エヴェリーナ公爵閣下！\nご訪問の予定はなかったはずですが――:
Oh, you are…… Her Grace, the Duchess of Evelina!
We weren't expecting a visit from you——
m920239.あ、あの、サリエットさん。\n大丈夫ですよ、わたしたちだって、\nずっと戦ってき:
U-um, Sariette-san.
It's okay, we're warriors who have been fighting for a long time, too.
m920239.ああ、銀狼の里、次期族長の実力を見せてやりな！: Aye. Show me the strength of the Silver Wolf Village's next Chieftain!
m920239.ああ。\n彼らの力を借りて、ギルガメッシュの拠点を特定しよう。:
Indeed.
Let us use their strength to pinpoint Gilgamesh's stronghold.
m920239.あっ！ こんな所にいた！\n……あー、もしかして、もう一戦やっちゃった感じ？:
Oh! You're here! 
...Ah, did you just have another sparring match?
m920239.あとは決勝戦だね！\n勝ち残っているのは王子と……。:
All that's left is the finals!
The ones still in the running are the Prince and…….
m920239.あなたのお気に入りでしょう、という意味で言ったのよ？\nふふっ、でも頼りにしてい: I meant that she's your favorite, you know? Heh, but I do rely on her.
m920239.あはは……王子のこと気に入っちゃったみたいで。: Ahaha…… It seems she's taken a liking to the Prince.
m920239.あははっ！ そいつはいい。\n族長修行の仕上げは、南の大地の武者修行か！: Hahaha! That's a fine idea. The final step of your Chieftain training will be a journey of self-improvement in the southern lands!
m920239.あれ？ うちの族長、\nさっき旅から戻ってきたはず……？: Huh? Our Chieftain should have just gotten back from his trip……?
m920239.あんな魔物ぐらい、\nど、どかーんって、倒してみせますっ。:
We'll take down monsters like those with a big
do-do-kaaaan!
m920239.いずれも以前、妖精郷を襲った魔物に似ている。\nしかし……あの奇怪な姿は……？:
They all resemble the monsters that attacked Fairyland before.
But…… what is that strange appearance?
m920239.いつもその移動魔法で拠点に行くから、\nどこにあるかとか知らないんだよねー。:
They always use that travel magic to get there, 
so they don't know where it actually is.
m920239.うちの村民を誘拐してもらっちゃ困るぜ、お嬢ちゃん。: I'd be in trouble if you tried to abduct my villagers, miss.
m920239.うむ、ひとりでは勝てなくても、\n集団でぼこぼこにすれば勝てるからな！:
Aye, even if you can't win alone,
you can crush them if you gang up on them!
m920239.うむむーん。\n雪枝の里の戦士たちで手分けして\nあっちこっち探っているし――:
Mmm...
The warriors from the Snow Branch are splitting up
and searching all over the place, and――
m920239.うん、そのとおり。\n何より、里同士の争いを避けるために、\n過度な干渉は禁じら:
Yeah, that's exactly it.
Above all, excessive interference between villages was forbidden
to avoid conflicts.
m920239.うん。すごーく古い習わしでね、\n狭間の雪原全体に危機が及んだときは、\n最強の:
Yes. It's a very, very old tradition.
When the entire Interstitial Snowfield faces a crisis,
there's a covenant to determine the strongest Snowfield King and unite our forces.
m920239.えぇと――山賊王に、魔界のチャンプに……。\n今度は雪原王、と。:
Well—— after the King of the Bandits and the Champion of the Demon Realm…….
Now it's the King of the Snowfields, I see.
m920239.えぇと、そのお姿は、いったい何が……？: I see, and that form of yours, exactly what is……?
m920239.えっと……あ、あらためて、よろしくお願いします？: Well…… ah, nice to meet you properly, then?
m920239.えーっと……。肩書の項目を追加して、\n銀狼の里の次期族長の師匠、っと……かきか:
Um……. Adding to the list of titles,
"Master of the Next Chieftain of the Silver Wolf Village," and…… scribbling, scribbling…….
m920239.えーっと、ひとまず事情を説明してくれないか？: Well, could you explain the situation for now?
m920239.おいおい、別人になったわけじゃないんだろ？\nこういう時は、これからもよろしく、:
Hey, hey, you're not a different person or anything, right? 
In a case like this, it's "Nice to have you with us from here on out."
m920239.おぉ、谷向こうの戦士たちか！\nこれは派手な試合になりそうだぜ！:
Oh, the warriors from across the valley!
This is shaping up to be quite the spectacle!
m920239.おぉ！ さっそく選手入場です！\n最初は雪羊の里、ユキヒツジの族長！:
Oh! The competitors are entering now!
First up, the Chieftain of the Snow Sheep Village, the Yukihitsuji Chieftain!
m920239.おそらくは、黒冠の影響を受け、\n様々な特徴を合成した新種の魔物ですな。: It is likely a new breed of monster, a hybrid of various traits, born from the influence of the Black Crown.
m920239.おーいサリエット！\nメシにしようぜ！ 腹が減っちまった。:
Hey, Sariette! 
Let's eat! I'm starving.
m920239.きっとそうだメー。\n狭間の雪原に迫る危機、雪原王と共に乗り越えるメー。:
It surely was, mee.
A crisis looms over the snowfields between the valleys, and we will overcome it together with the King of the Snowfields, mee.
m920239.くっ……魔物の群れが来たぞ！: Grr…… the monster horde is here!
m920239.こほん。剣の教え子の目の前で、\n苦労するとか言わないように。: Tsk. Don't talk about hardships in front of my sword student.

m950004.おや、私たちも記録に残るのですか？: Oh? Are we going to be in the records too?
m950004.お礼に、私の力を王子さまの仲間にあげるね！: As a thank-you, I'll give my power to your allies!
m950004.お願い、王子さま！\n悪い盗賊たちから、仲間を助けてほしいの！: Please, Prince! Save my friends from those wicked thieves!
m950004.きっと大丈夫ですよ！\n王子さまは、こういう時には必ず駆けつけて――: I'm sure it'll be fine! The Prince always rushes in at times like this—
m950004.こ、来ないで！\n少しでも触ったらぶっ飛ばすわよ！: D-Don't come near! If you even touch it, I'll blast you away!
m950004.それで、助けを呼ぼうと思って、\n王国の方まで急いで飛んでる最中で――: So I tried to call for help, and was rushing all the way to the kingdom—
m950004.ちっ、こうなったら仕方ねぇ！\n野郎ども、王子を捕まえて売っぱらうぞ！: Damn it, if it comes to this… You scoundrels, we'll capture the Prince and sell him!
m950004.なっ……お、王国軍だとぉ！？\nどうしてこんな所にいやがるんだ！？: Wh—what? The kingdom's troops?! Why are you here?!
m950004.はいはい、話は詰め所で聞くからな。\n生活に困ってるなら仕事も斡旋するから、\n: Yeah, yeah, we'll hear your story at the interrogation room. If you're struggling, we can find you work—first, atone for your crimes.
m950004.ふふふ、皆さんの記録もしっかり書き残しますよ。\nそのために、王子をはじめ、\n: Hehe, we'll make sure to write down everyone's records too. That's why, starting with the Prince, we've had everyone who's off-duty today come along.
m950004.わ、悪かった！ 改心するから！\n頼むぅ、見逃してくれぇ！: Sorry! I'll change my ways! Please, spare me!
m950004.わっ……た、助けてくれたってこと？\nごめんなさい！ 敵だと思って暴れちゃって…: Whew… you saved me? I'm sorry! I thought you were an enemy and went berserk…!
m950004.アイギス神殿近くの森ですよ。\n聖霊さん、そろそろ落ち着きましたか？: We're in the forest near the Aegis Temple. Holy Spirit, have you settled down yet?
m950004.大丈夫ですよ、どちらも怪我がなくて良かったです。\nそれで、いったい何があったの: It's alright, glad neither of you got injured. So, what exactly happened?
m950004.当たり前ですよ！\n皆さんのことも記録しなくちゃ、\n王国史とは言えませんからね: Of course! If we don't record you all, it can't be called the kingdom's history!
m950004.慌てすぎてこっちに突っ込んできますよ！？: It's so panicked it might just charge right at us!?
m950004.懐かしい思い出もあれば、\n辛かったことも、悲しかったことも、\nそれ以上に嬉し: There are nostalgic memories, painful times, sad moments, and even more joyful ones—so many.
m950004.戦い……？ って、わ、わー！\n王子、大変です！ 魔物の群れが！: Battle…? Wh-what! Prince, it's bad! A horde of monsters!
m950004.王国内で悪事を働くやつがいたら、\nそいつらを成敗するのも王国軍の役目だからな！: If anyone commits crimes in the kingdom, it's the army's job to punish them! So just stay still and get tied up!
m950004.王子、どうしますか――と、\n尋ねるまでもなさそうですね。\nそれでは聖霊さん、: Prince, what will you do—well, it seems there's no need to ask. Then, Holy Spirit, please guide the way!
m950004.王子、敵が来るぞ！\n聖霊を守りながらの戦闘だ、慎重な指揮を頼む！: Prince, enemies are approaching! Fight while protecting the Holy Spirit; I need careful command!
m950004.王子と一緒に戦う中で、\nこれまで色々なことを経験しましたよね。: Fighting alongside the Prince, we've experienced all sorts of things, haven't we?
m950004.王子をって……そんなことさせませんよ！？: Capture the Prince… I won't let that happen!
m950004.私は物語を通して、みんなに力を与えられるの。\nよーし、どこかに手頃な物語はっと: Through stories, I can grant power to everyone. Let's see… a suitable story somewhere…
m950004.聖霊さんの、力ですか？: The Holy Spirit's power, you mean?
m950004.護衛に付いてきて正解だったみたいだな。\n王子、皆に迎撃の指揮を頼むぞ！: Looks like staying with the guard was the right call. Prince, I need you to command the interception!
